title: Delegator loyalty contract at stakepool reward address
problem: Bootstrapping an effective stakepool is a challenge for small SPOs. Delegation is required to generate rewards, and rewards are required to attract delegation.
solution: Our solution is a loyalty contract at the stakepool rewards address that pays delegators a fraction of the SPO configurable margin that corresponds to the magnitude and duration of their delegation.

title: Cardano Node API: a multiple protocol query interface

title: Sundae Governance + Atala Prism Integration
problem: There is currently a lack of transparency, security, and engagement in decentralized governance that can be solved by introducing a DID-based voting system.

problem: Cardano needs ONE universal KYC/AML standard, embedded in an Atala Prism DID credential. Cardano projects need to establish a minimum KYC standard so they can accept a KYC DID and preserve privacy.
solution: We'll form the Cardano Privacy Alliance, setting standards for interoperable KYC/AML checks across Cardano projects, leveraging Atala PRISM to safeguard privacy and minimize data collection.

problem: The benefits of blockchain and Cardano in particular are unknown to many social groups. Among them, book lovers stay far from web3. According to them, Cardano is probably the name of a city in Italy.

title: Open Source Mobility and Transportation Wallet
problem: Mobility sector lacks a specialized open-source wallet, limiting secure, seamless, and sector-specific interactions on the blockchain.
solution: Creating an open source Mobility specific Wallet, ensuring secure, easy-to-use, and feature-rich interactions for the mobility sector.

title: Hydrozoa: Lightweight and scalable Hydra Heads
problem: Cardano Hydra Head protocol has significant overhead to open and close heads, and support for incremental commits/decommits is complicated to implement with the current approach.
solution: Leverage lessons learned in Cardano dApp design to improve the Hydra protocol: single-step init, easy commits/decommits even while the head is open, simpler on-chain validators, and cheaper operation.

solution: We have built a Saas offering -ecoVerse is an Authenticated Data & Web 2.5 Marketing Tech Platform that helps companies simplify Web 3.0 enterprise application development.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-d27f77/png)

2. Proposed the B2E business model to bring more users to the Cardano space.

title: NFT Vending Machine – An Open-Source Faucet for Complex NFT Mints
problem: NFT creators don’t have an extensible, programmable, open-source package to mint NFTs that takes native assets as payment, handles multi-policy mints, handles inexact change, refunds, and more.
solution: The “NFT Vending Machine” is a server software platform that loads JSON files and hosts complex mints. It takes native assets as payment, mints multi-policy, can do free mints, and much more.

title: Post-quantum security for Cardano accounts 🛡
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-77fe34/png)

Cardano does not support quantum secure accounts while the quantum computing industry is scaling toward large scale machines which may compromise elliptic curve cryptography by the end of the decade.
solution: A research paper containing a complete inventory of the quantum computing vulnerabilities of Cardano as well as an analysis of the mitigations. This paper will serve as an action plan after Voltaire.

title: BLOCKTRUST production-ready DIDComm Mediator
problem: A *DIDComm Mediator* is a crucial part of the infrastructure to send messages and credentials from wallet to wallet. All existing implementations (including ours) are currently just a proof-of-concept.
solution: We aim to elevate a our existing Mediator implementation to production-level quality, complete with a user interface, tenant-based management, and support of live-delivery with *WebSockets*.

solution: Plugins for other Blockchains are available on Unreal Engine, not for Cardano, I will build a plugin that anyone can use to offer Play-to-Earn within their game using ADA, NFTs & Other Cardano Tokens

title: Open source PoolTool.io and sustain for 1 year
problem: Three essential objectives: open-sourcing all components of the PoolTool platform, eliminating ads ,and funding operations for a year.
solution: Much of the technology we have developed would be useful to other developers in the ecosystem. And making it open source the community can build features on top of pooltool more easily

solution: Due to the improved immersion possibilities, NFTs are no longer seen only as investment vehicles, but as enrichment for games. A modular version is universally applicable for new developers.

title: Clean Air Token (CAT)
problem: As prices of cryptocurrencies upsurge and user adoption increases, the amount of energy consumed by cryptocurrency firms will increase over time precipitating climate threats.
solution: The CAT token is etched on the crytocurrency blockchain which is to be developed to reduce the carbon emissions of the whole cryptocurrency network.

title: Make Earning ADA Easier for Developers
problem: Compliance is becoming critical as people/organisations earning crypto receive more attention, but there is a lack of guidance to support the accounting/reporting of ADA earned in all jurisdictions.
solution: Compile tax reporting/accounting methods from community members in multiple countries, ease onboarding & local compliance, extend knowledge base & facilitate 2023 tax reporting for developers globally

To offer a high-level study on complex networks, a scientific topic of research, and its application on the Cardano blockchain, enabling students to propose improvements in consensus and protocols.

solution: Thanks to our community, LATAM now has an adequate and frictionless way to collaborate, we need to scale our processes and tools so we can continue to push adoption and LATAM contributions further

solution: We're making a fiat off-ramp system where the change of physical currency transactions can be received in the form of cryptocurrency, one penny at a time.

title: From Trash to Treasure: Telling Stories of Impact on OpenLitterMap

solution: We are building a real-world data collection experience to unlock humanities data collection capacity, transform our relationship with technology, and empower people to tell their story.

problem: There are a lack of open-source, effective models for converting film audiences into Cardano users, and a lack of excellent film to demonstrate the effectiveness of such a model.
solution: Leverage the free release of a world-class, award-winning documentary to create a new, Film3 launchpad model that brings maximum benefit to Cardano, filmakers and their audiences.

title: NEWM - Music Rights Marketplace App - Mobile Integration
problem: Without blockchain-based IP management, major industries cannot integrate with Cardano. This is essential infrastructure that is missing from Web3 that will enable onboarding creative industries.
solution: A mobile-first music streaming IP rights platform on the Cardano blockchain, offering seamless rights management, integration with music services, and user-friendly design to drive mass adoption.

title: Collectibles Exchange: An Innovative DEX for NFTs - A Swapping Service for Non-Fungible Cardano Native Assets
problem: **Most Cardano NFT services focus on financial aspects, neglecting NFTs as collectibles. Current infrastructure lacks dedicated services for collectors to easily swap non-fungible Cardano native assets.**
solution: **We will develop Collectibles Exchange, a DEX for NFTs, enabling users to swap Cardano NFTs, with innovative on-chain, partially on-chain, and off-chain offer mechanics, increasing transaction volume.**

title: Fostering Innovation: Swiss Cardano Hackathon Series in Geneva - Inspiring collaboration & creativity for blockchain development
problem: Lack of Web3 initiatives for Builders in Romandie (French-Speaking Area of Switzerland). Strong macro-economic/global importance with great opportunities for B2B growth and activations.
solution:
Creation of a Swiss-based Hackathon series:

- Support structures
- Incentivization structures
- Collaborative structures

title: Stargazer: DeFi Yield Optimizer for Cardano
problem: DeFi yield farming is **complicated** and **time-consuming**, creating barriers to entry for many potential users. Time effort and complexity **hinder the growth and expansion** of Cardano’s DeFi ecosystem.
solution: Stargazer, a smart Yield Optimizer on Cardano, automates yield reinvestment to significantly **increase returns**, **outperforming** individual efforts and eliminating the hassle of **manual DeFi monitoring.**

title: A Zero Knowledge Proof framework for Cardano based on Hydra and ZK-SNARKS
problem: Zero-Knowledge-Proofs (ZKPs) are increasingly relevant to ensure privacy in blockchain transactions. The Cardano ecosystem currently lacks a mature tooling for implementing ZKPs.
solution: We will develop a set of tools using the Hydra protocol to adapt ZKP solutions that currently work on Ethereum, particularly ZK-SNARKs, enabling ZK-proof verifications on the Cardano blockchain.

title: Selldone Commerce SDK to Bridge Cardano and Real Commerce with Comprehensive Regulatory Compliance
problem:
**More Plugins & Services = More Problems!**

Adding real-world commerce to blockchain or meat projects is challenging as it requires numerous functionality and plugins for payment, fulfillment, and more.
solution: As part of this project, we aim to develop **SDK + components** for the community. This SDK will enable the implementation of commerce functionality, like shopping into other projects. e.g. shop in games

title: Blockchain-based Carbon Credit Solutions in Transportation

title: FluidTokens on Milkomeda [Platform + Audit + Open Source]

solution: We're creating a platform on Milomeda that facilitates borrowing and lending through NFT collateral. Our smart contract will be open source and audited, encouraging new developers to join our mission.

title: ₳ Cure for CBDCs: ADA's Official Adoption as Legal Tender Currency
problem:
Cash will soon become obsolete; financial freedom & anonymity, things of the past.

CBDCs are imminent, and all western governments & regulatory bodies have signaled their strong intentions to use them.
solution: We will launch an awareness campaign targeting those nations, primarily of the BRICS economic bloc & aspiring members, of ADA's suitability for their current debate on a reserve currency alternative.

solution: Turn the existing Demeter.run platform into a federated frontend hosting provider. Leverage the experience of existing Cardano SPOs to maintain a grid of distributed compute infrastructure.

solution: GHH Trading Post NFTs on NMKR.io: Accessible, tradeable, and verifiable eco-friendly products. Blockchain ensures transparency, trust, and a circular economy.

title: DCOne Crypto Upgrade V2

Provide project overview on Cardano & automated reporting tool

Real-time data analysis of buying/selling, swapping original assets, building project price charts

Balance Tracker & Portfolio Tracker

problem: Eliminate aid leakage due to fraud, corruption, inflexibility, administrative costs and waste when distributing aid, while adding transparency and real-time monitoring

solution: Implementing a tokenomics model with KOIOS tokens to incentivize Koios node hosting, fostering a self-sustaining, decentralized Koios infrastructure.

problem: The ecosystem of developers, artists and entrepreneurs is without a real-world home to incubate innovation, promote cross-pollination of ideas and collaboration, and broaden the reach of the Cardano.

campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Charli3 Oracles - Multi-DEX SDK : A Pythonic Gateway to Decentralized Exchanges on Cardano
problem: Lack of Python-based tools for developers to efficiently interact with multiple decentralized exchanges (DEXs) on Cardano.
solution: We will develop an open-source Python SDK to facilitate seamless interaction with multiple Cardano DEXs, enabling easy integration for Python developers.

title: Cardano Software Review
problem: Users and investors may face difficulty in choosing and trusting Cardano tools due to limited clear and reliable information.
solution: We'll create a self-sustaining platform for users to find, rate, and review Cardano-based tools, hence increasing their trustworthiness.

title: RIM, Remarkable Internet Moments
problem: a time based Wikipedia for unforgettable, iconic, remarkable internet moments/creations.
solution: The internet is filled with amazing content that goes forgotten in the pletora of material available online. I want to create a user-submitted,community reviewed, historic database of the best moments

title: Link in Bio Tool for Web3 Creators - All-in-One Link for Web3 Builders & Blockchain Projects
problem: An "All-in-One" link platform designed to meet the needs of Web3, NFT, Crypto and Tokens projects. That interacts with the functionality, scalability, security and power of the ADA Cardano blockchain.
solution: Develop a powerful "All-in-One" Link platform that aggregates all links, NFTs and Wallets of a user, specialized in solving the needs of Web3, NFT and Token projects, using the Cardano blockchain.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Adagarms.com
problem: There is no online ecommerce store that promotes Native Asset Tokens by selling merchandize depicting our favorite Native Asset Token projects while focusing on sustainability and charity
solution: Build an opensource Eco-friendly Cardano store that sells merchandize (sourced from sustainable materials) that depict our favorite Native Asset Token projects so that the community can rock cool swag

title: SYNTH PE - Unlocking Access To A Massive Crypto Market with NMKR-UPI Payments Integration
problem:
Despite UPI's adoption in Asia, with its significant transaction volume and India's growing crypto investor base, there is currently no UPI-Cardano payment integration.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-86683c/png)
solution: Integrating UPI, a popular payment system in India with more than 260 million users, offers a convenient experience for on/off ramp transactions on Cardano using NMKR.

title: Open Source Yield Optimizer on Cardano
problem: Poppy Finance aims to provide DeFi users with a secure and efficient platform to **maximize their yield-generating opportunities** by leveraging the innovative features of Cardano’s UTxO model.
solution: Using Poppy Finance, users will be able to optimize their earning capacity in a consolidated platform, without the hassle of **manually monitoring** all their DeFi activity across different protocols.

title: A peer-to-peer marketplace for trading Cardano and Cardano native assets with fiat.
problem: Complex KYC process, expensive fee structure, lack/unrecognized identification documents, unstructured escrow platforms etc has led to many people losing the tech-drive which also hinders adoption.
solution: Build an open-ended p2p crypto marketplace with collateralized arbitrators. Traders can engage in seamless, secure trades on insured spots, limited to collateral amount provided by the arbitrators.

title: New SPO revenue streams for securing bridge infrastructure
problem: Currently, the main forms of SPO revenue come from staking rewards or ISPO allocations. **SPOs should have new revenue opportunities** from **securing other decentralized infrastructure** (such as bridges).
solution: Our solution is to **build easy-tooling such that SPOs can tap into a new revenue sources** for securing and validating bridge activity between Cardano and new ecosystems.

title: Blockchain-Servitization Hub: Empowering African Startups
problem:
![african-hub-cc03e7.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/african-hub-cc03e7/png)

Absence of a dedicated incubator for African startups aiming to leverage Cardano blockchain for servitization, limiting the growth potential and innovation in the ecosystem.
solution: Launching a bilingual (English/French) incubator program to foster African startups developing service-centric solutions on Cardano blockchain, offering guidance, resources, and mentorship

title: Socious: Decentralized Referral System for DAOs
problem: Referral fraud poses a significant challenge for the growth of DAOs, accounting for [21% of all attacks,](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1297428/leading-fraud-attacks-online-merchants-worldwide/) despite [referrals being a crucial method for community expansion](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/article/go-to-market-in-web3/). [日本語](https://socious.notion.site/F10-P3-DAO-41753b7e9c3c43b8a08fb2caa93f2af9?pvs=4)
solution: A decentralized referral system that utilizes smart contracts, guaranteeing security and transparency. By combating referral fraud, the system facilitates DAO’s growth and fosters a thriving community

title: Insufficient knowledge of Cardano among university students in the city of Goma
problem: We want to solve the problem of students' lack of knowledge of cardano ecosystem and project catalyst in Goma.
solution:
Creation of videos explaining the cardano ecosystem and project catalyst (English and French).

Creation of a website on the Cardano ecosystem .awareness-raising sessions at various universities

title: Haskell Book Translation - The Way to Migrate Developers to Cardano From Other Chains
problem: Cardano's Smart Contract is built on Haskell. But there is no book or document about Haskell for developers in Vietnamese. It is a big barrier for developers in Vietnam to build Dapps on Cardano
solution: We will translate the book **"Practical Haskell"** into Vietnamese and share it to Developer communities in Vietnam. It will bring a huge amount of developers to Cardano

title: No-Code Shopify plugin to accept $ADA and other native Cardano tokens
problem: As projects expand into merchandise, their customers want to pay with $ADA/Cardano native tokens. Shopify is a leading commerce platform, yet there’s a clear lack of support for accepting these tokens
solution: We will release a no-code solution to allow anyone to accept $ADA/Cardano native tokens as payments on Shopify with maximum flexibility for store owners and a modern checkout experience for shoppers

title: SPO 4 Life
problem: There are around 3500 SPOs with no clear description and that are not well presented. New community members and even active ones don’t really know in which SPO to stake.
solution: We want to create a simple website that references the existing pools and sort them by characteristics (climate, technological innovation…), with small descriptions as well as links to their website.

title: Marlowe - Decentralized Oracle Integration
problem: Marlowe is a brand new framework for building and running financial contracts. Decentralized oracles are a mandatory component in many scenarios. Marlowe lacks integration with decentralized oracles.
solution: Integrate the existing Marlowe Runtime with feeds from well-known decentralized oracles in the Cardano ecosystem, such as Charli3

title: Cardano in Spanish 2
problem: Lack of Spanish content for the Cardano Project
solution: Provide Spanish video materials educating and keeping Hispanic community informed about the Cardano Project

title: Onboarding the Next 1,000,000 Users to Cardano! (B2C Marketing)
problem: Currently Cardano's marketing strategy is B2B focused, but individuals, such as ourselves, are the gateway to mass adoption. It’s time Cardano tactfully onboards new members to the digital revolution.
solution: We’ve helped businesses and creators gain MILLIONS of followers all across the internet. We will massively amplify the awareness of Cardano and Charles via our proven viral social media campaign.

title: How to set up a DAO: the legally compliant way - Setting up a legally compliant DAO involves choosing the right jurisdiction, considering KYC/AML procedures, and ensuring transparent governance for successful operations.
problem: The ambiguous legal status of DAOs, especially unincorporated ones, poses potential liabilities to DAO builders and members, deterring many from fully embracing the transformative potential of DAOs.
solution: A correct legal setup and a well-defined governance structure are crucial to operating a DAO. We will provide a user-friendly manual to navigate the complex DAO landscape and guide DAO setup.

title: CRCI - A First Principles Approach to DeFi Fundamental Analysis
problem:
![Card-New6-c067ab.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Card-New6-c067ab/png)

There is a lack of accessible, standardized information and fundamental analysis on Cardano DeFi projects which leads to uninformed decision-making and potential risks for investors.
solution: We will create the CRCI web application to host and share the CRCI research scores and insights on Cardano DeFi projects, promoting informed decision-making and transparency in the ecosystem.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Hands-on training on cardano-cli and the EUTXO model
problem: Starting in Cardano is overwhelming. Understanding the EUTXO model and off-chain building demands a substantial paradigm shift. The lack of practical resources hinders independent learning.
solution: A series of high quality hands-on videos paired with open-source tools to teach the basics of Cardano transactions and the EUTXO model with a focus on real world, practical examples.

title: Onboarding Young Digital Artists into the Cardano Ecosystem
problem: There is a lack of resources and funding opportunities for young digital artists in the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Our solution is to create an accessible platform offering resources, mentorship and funding for young digital artists in the Cardano ecosystem, empowering them to thrive and showcase their talent.

title: The Morphium - Add Texas Holdem to The Morphium Casino
problem: This proposal is to add additional gaming experiences to the Cardano Ecosystem
solution: The Morphium will develop a functional Texas HoldEm game, integrated in to their existing Cardano Native Casino Platform.

title: CarbonNo Verifiable Carbon Platform
problem: Carbon offsets in their present form invite fraud. We're building a fraudproof/transparent marketplace, verifiable to the kWh, using protocols that utilities use today to underwrite projects.
solution: A decentralized carbon trading platform where infrastructure-based carbon offset credits can be verified using existing underwriting protocols and verified with NFT and blockchain technologies.

title: MY CELL – resource based NFT marketplace to provide funding for micro-forests management
problem:
![MyCell-38ef6a.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/MyCell-38ef6a/png)

[More than 80% of Europe's natural habitats are degraded ](https://www.eea.europa.eu/en/newsroom/news/ecosystems-need-restoration)and are in urgent need of restauration. Forests are vital for climate change mitigation and help protect from extreme weather and pollution.
solution: Our objective is to establish native micro forests that will endure and capture CO2. Our NFT will fund the implementation and maintenance of these and serve as a way of user biodiversity sharing.

title: Documentary "We are changing the world": Cardano Developers Stories.
problem:
The Cardano community through his developers is transforming the world and yet the world is still largely unaware. Much of the work we are doing is still unseen outside of the Cardano community.

![Screen-Shot-2023-07-12-at-18.39.28-b8715b.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screen-Shot-2023-07-12-at-18.39.28-b8715b/png)
solution: A documentary series that tells the story behind the Cardano actors and its outcomes for the developers ecosystem, connecting the stories of this community and tell them to the world.

title: StuRent Chain: Blockchain for Student Rentals
problem: Students often face challenges in securing suitable, affordable housing near campuses due to lack of transparency and secure transactions.
solution: We will create a blockchain-based marketplace that connects students with housing providers, ensuring transparent rental agreements and secure transactions.

title: The Goal Mechanism and Dynamics of Incentivized Compliance for Task and Goal Achievement
problem: There is a need to incentivize toward a change in human behavior in order to increase participation, improve voting models, and achieve a better user experience with blockchain governance.
solution: The Goal Mechanism is a tool that is used to help users realize and achieve goals, holding them accountable by way of incentivized compliance to listed affirmations of their goals.

title: Cardano Dubai Hub - Inclusivity and Innovation For Everyone
problem: Dubai has grown into a financial and technology center of the world. Cardano needs a stronger presence in this area in order to remain on the cutting edge of innovation in the crypto space.
solution: The Cardano Dubai Hub will represent an inclusive community that focuses on driving adoption and innovation for the Cardano ecosystem. The creation of a DAO will ensure inclusivity for all.

title: Digital Identity Verification Interface - ( Working prototype @ did.MintMatrix.io )
problem: Lack of transmutable, transferrable digital-identity verification processes for various domains such as leasing, lending, employment, and DeFi applications.
solution: We’re building an application to issue, request, and manage digital identities. The app will be used in leasing, lending, employment, and DeFi.

title: Cardano Resource Hub
problem:
![RESOURCES-47fded.PNG](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/RESOURCES-47fded/PNG)

There is no one site where resources, tools, APIs, etc. are concentrated. of Cardano created by the community.
solution: Create a collaborative open-source platform where developers in the Cardano ecosystem can share and utilize resources, tools, APIs, etc.

title: SolarGate DAO // Cardano Renewable Energy Social Business // Empowering Communities with Solar Energy Solutions powered by @energiasocial
problem: Inefficient management of a renewable energy enterprise and administration of economic results, hindering transparency and stakeholder participation.
solution: Create a DAO and decentralized governance model for transparent management and stakeholder participation in our renewable energy social enterprise operations and economic result administration.

title: Open standard for cross-game achievement system to gamify onchain participation
problem: One of the key ways to grow player engagement is achievement systems. However, these require a common standard across games that doesn't exist yet
solution: We will create an open standard for a cross-game achievement system, create an open source platform that integrates that standard and integrate it into at least 3 games in the Cardano ecosystem

title: Easy onboarding of ADA holders to SPOs
problem:
![Andamio learning management system. Skill and contribution tracking, treasury management and smart contract capabilities.](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Andamio-LMS-square-with-drop-shadow-5a4a58/png)

Onboarding new users to Stake Pool Operators (SPOs) and helping them choose the right one is time consuming and can be confusing.
solution: A Project-based learning (PBL) program implemented on blockchain-based learning management system (LMS), to onboard ADA holders to SPOs.

title: EncryptVault, Cryptocurrency Wallet Seed Phrase (Private Keys) Encrypted QR Code Generator | Protocol and Cold Storage Device System. Safely, digitally store all your crypto seed phrases and passwords.
problem: The complexity and risks involved in self custody and storage of cryptocurrency wallet seed phrases and private keys is a major factor in the slow adoption of crypto currency. Well over $120B in loss
solution: Refine and implement my protocol, API, and hardware device system for cold storage of private keys as well as public encrypted storage of QR code card representations of crypto wallet seed phrases.

title: Summit Dubai TV Interviews
IOG Catalyst Team : Catalyst Ecosystem Accelerator (Hermes Core architecture development)
problem: The richness and connectedness of the Catalyst Experience needs to be improved. This includes addressing performance, inclusivity, speed, and parallelism, while maintaining secure and private voting
solution: Improve Catalyst infrastructure to improve user benefits across feature richness, inclusivity & speed. The new infrastructure will include fully decentralized blockchain and hyper-lite client.

title: IOG Catalyst Team : Ideascale replacement and web-browser based Voting Centre with liquid democracy aka “Catalyst Voices”
problem: Catalyst's short participation windows with fragmented UX experience and complicated manual processes frustrate and limit community engagement
solution: Catalyst Voices provides a unified experience and platform including production-ready liquid democracy, meaningful collaboration opportunities & data-driven context for better onboarding & decisions

title: Argus AI: Zero-Subscription SaaS Model For NFT Counterfeit Protection
problem: Counterfeit NFTs can be devastating for artists and new collectors, and will pose increasing problems for market veterans in the future, but few NFT marketplaces can afford to protect against them.
solution: Argus uses AI to spot counterfeit NFTs, and this subscription-free integration model for NFT marketplaces will make Argus available to their customers as an instant, on-demand service.

title: potential-robot: an optimized developer experience
problem: Building on Cardano is challenging. Getting from an idea to the first transaction has unnecessary overheads in terms of programmer time.
solution: We created an Open Source API that allows experimentation with transactions and validator logic in an emulated environment, is easy to understand and integrate into an existing programmer stack.

title: “Cardania” educative board game
problem: Despite all the blockchain education initiatives, there are no mechanisms to bring this knowledge to people with no technical backgrounds.
solution: *Create a boardgame that teaches basic concepts of blockchain in a didactic and fun way without the need for technical jargon*

title: Empowering Collaborative Stake Pools with Automated Reward Distribution
problem: Stake pools receive both pool rewards and pledge wallet stake rewards into a single rewards wallet. Rewards intended for multiple owner pledge wallets must be manually calculated and distributed.
solution: Our solution is to provide an easy-to-use CLI tool that can automate reward distribution from a single stake pool reward wallet to multiple pledge/owner wallets for pools with multiple pledge members.

title: FiDa - Risk Transfer Contracts
problem: Currently the insurance industry lacks sufficient capital efficiency and presents too much overhead and friction handling insurance contracts.
solution:
Introduce collateral-based insurance contracts (FiDa cards) that facilitate risk diversification, trading, and unlock under-collateralization for all investors.

Creating an efficient marketplace.

title: CryptoStream: Empowering Indie Video Creators - Tip, Vote & Fund via Cardano Blockchain!
problem:
**Streaming platforms offer limited sustainable income & funding options for video creators. There is a lack of community video voting platforms that have a decentralized treasury to support creators'.**

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-3ed6d6/png)
solution: **We will create a video streaming platform with a decentralized treasury and community voting to provide sustainable income and funding for independent video creators.**

title: REITCIRCLES: Decentralized marketplace for verification for real estate globally - BACKEND DEVELOPMENT for this.
problem: The core of real estate tokenization centers around verification of the real estate data. Lack of transparency of centralized providers (banks, NBFCs & lenders) leads to potential corruption.
solution: This platform will enable asset owners to drive the process of verification using automated selection of verifiers and tasks associated, leading to issuance of NFT with the results of verification.

title: The Universal Mediator - Streamlining SSI Agents for Mass Adoption by RootsID
problem:
The lack of a reliable, scalable, and transport-agnostic DIDComm v2 mediator for developers in the SSI space.

![rootsid](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/logo-rootsid-e50ab6/png)
solution: We aim to productionalize and maintain a universal DIDComm v2 mediator, reducing friction for developers in deploying identity solutions.

title: Ethereum2Cardano On-Chain Developer Dictionary
problem:
![Eth2ADA-c582f3.jpeg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Eth2ADA-c582f3/jpeg)

Currently, developers seeking to migrate from Ethereum to Cardano face challenges in accessing reliable resources and community-driven knowledge sharing platforms.
solution: Phase 2 of the Eth2Ada Dictionary will move on-chain with community-driven upvoting & downvoting tools, providing comprehensive resources for builders & users making the transition from Eth to Cardano

title: Endubis Messenger Wallet Upgrade
problem: Web3 can be confusing for people that are used to the traditional web2 world. We need new-user-friendly systems in order to onboard a large audience to the Cardano community and the De-Fi world.
solution: An upgrade of the current Endubis Telegram wallet to be available on other platforms (Whatsapp + Discord), upgrade the current User Interface and add a Dapp interaction functionality.

title: DEMU Jukebox Music Player | Phase 2 - (Cash App + Spotify)
problem:
The music business lacks transparency, efficient royalty payments& artist/fan relationships, leading to power imbalance,a fragmented ecosystem & underrepresentation of artists in developing countries

<https://youtu.be/nxho1BMNDAk>
solution:
DEMU Jukebox is Cash App + Spotify.

A media player in a digital wallet that pays the artists *directly*.

**Empowering artists to be their own**

**Bank**

**Streaming Platform**

**& Record Store. All-in-One**

<https://youtu.be/nxho1BMNDAk>

title: DRED decentralized API
problem: Lack of a decentralized API service on Cardano forces projects to use centralized services.
solution: Develop a decentralized API service on Cardano based on DRED state channels to enable traditional API services transition to the Node operator model for increased capacity and resilience.

title: SkyBrain Neurotech: Personalizing Experiences with Neurotech and Blockchain
problem:
![SkyBrain Neurotech](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/SkyBrain-Neurotech3-01-60e8ed/png)

Most neurotech solutions are limited to lab settings due to a variety of reasons. We want to solve this problem and enable users to leverage neurotech integrated with blockchain in everyday life.
solution: SkyBrain Neurotech will integrate neurotech with blockchain for personalized, secure, and immersive experiences.

title: Open Source Identity Wallet for Mobility and Transportation
problem: Addressing the lack of a standardized, secure identity management solution across diverse mobility services, to enhance user experience and trust via blockchain technology.
solution: We will create an Identity Mobility Wallet, providing a unified, secure platform for managing user identities across multiple mobility services.

title: Bootstrap DeFi Farming Rewards in ADA
problem: Lack of understanding and awareness of DeFi among the Cardano community.
solution: Create a fun and educational community farming pool where users can stake LP tokens and earn a share of the 40,000 ADA as a learning experience.

title: Research Paper on Impact in Cardano
problem: Research on the Cardano impact ecosystem is lacking and isn’t highly visible in international research journals and publications from a multidisciplinary, social sciences and humanities perspective.
solution: Complete the first Project Catalyst funded research Report submission into the [Sustainability Accounting, Management and Policy Journal](https://www.emeraldgrouppublishing.com/journal/sampj), illustrating cardano4good use cases in the real world.

title: Open Banking for DeFi from licensed AISP in Europe (Fizen.com)
problem: We are ATALA Prism Pioneer. We integrate banks in Europe with Open Banking as licensed AISP and we provide this access as Issuer and Verifier.
solution: Thanks to Open Banking people can start owning their banking identities and data in Atala Prism ecosystem. ID, Proof od addres, AML, Scoring, Proof of income, Proof of age etc.

title: Cardano NFT integrated adult games and adult games marketplace
problem: Cardano has a growing ecosystem of games but none of which covers the adult gaming sector which takes up a significant portion of gamers.
solution: The idea is to get 1 working adult game that supports Cardano NFTs and from there, build out a platform for indie game devs that are passionate about blockchain and adult gaming.

title: AI-Assisted Pharmacies with Secure SSI Authentication
problem: Addressing the shortage of pharmacists in Germany and privacy concerns in pharmacies through AI-assisted customer service and secure SSI authentication.
solution: We will develop an AI-assisted pharmacy service with Atala PRISM for secure customer authentication, addressing pharmacist shortage in Germany and enhancing data privacy.

title: Electric Vehicle Charging: Blockchain-Based Efficient Solutions
problem: Current electric vehicle (EV) charging systems face challenges in efficiency, transparency, and security, hindering the potential for peer-to-peer energy transactions.
solution: We will conduct a detailed analysis to explore how blockchain technology can optimize EV charging systems for enhanced efficiency, transparency, and security.

title: ALDEA NFT Marketplace V2
problem:
![ALDEA NFT](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/aldea_nft_logo-b2ea2e/jpg)

Although the current marketplace is already up and running, there are still many services that we would like to offer to empower our community and SPOs.
solution: Enhance smart contracts and revamp platform to support collections, bundles, NFT history, simplified minting and selling, auctions, content moderation, messaging between users and SPOs and much more!

title: Cardano NFT Support Hub: Building a Comprehensive Help Desk for NFT Creators and Developers
problem: Accessibility to technical information, standards, and best practices for the Cardano NFT ecosystem can be challenging for newcomers, especially for non-standard, unique or specific issues.
solution: We will set up and maintain an NFT Help Desk, leveraging the diverse skills of the global NFT Guild team to provide timely and informative assistance to the developers and project creators community.

title: Rookiez - Decentralized Motorcycle Racing Manager Game - Completion and release of a playable prototype
problem: I want to bring other Indie Game developers to the Cardano ecosystem, by showing them that different business models are possible. We don't need scammy P2E mechanics, nor to pay a 30% Steam tax.
solution: **Rookiez is the first decentralized motorcycle racing platform** where you can **train your riders, mint new motorcycles based on your research**, and **scout new NFT riders** who can become future champions.

title: TerraRock: Bringing DAO structure and Revolutionizing Real Estate Investments  with Crypto/blockchain Integration.
problem: Limited access to real estate investments and lack of transparency in traditional models hinder retail investors from diversifying their portfolios and maximizing returns.
solution: TerraRock provides a platform where retail investors can access real estate investments through asset-backed tokens, staking rewards, and a community-driven trust, transparency, diversification.

title: Prism support for popular SSI agents. Adding prism to Veramo and Aries Framework Agents.
problem:
Two of the most popular decentralized identity stacks, Veramo and Aries, don't have plug-ins for Prism v2 (did:prism). The Cardano identity ecosystem needs to show interoperability with Veramo/Aries

![rootsid logo](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/logo-rootsid-174562/png)
solution: We will provide two Prism plugins; one to the Veramo ecosystem and one to the Aries ecosystem and demonstrate interoperability between them and the Prism v2 ecosystem.

title: Mastering Atala PRISM Book
problem: **Atala PRISM v2** has been recently released to the public. The official documentation is a great technical reference, but developers want implementation examples and advice from experienced experts.
solution: We will write a book, for software developers, which will explain the basics, plus a deep dive into implementation details, and lessons learned from building and deploying real world projects.

title: FluxusNetwork x Scaleway
problem:
![222-d8e493.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/222-d8e493/jpg)

![2560px-Scaleway_logo_2018.svg-5727bc.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/2560px-Scaleway_logo_2018.svg-5727bc/png)

The problem we want to solve is that every application, game or otherwise, has to end up with a cloud service provider at some point, missing out on the multitude of connections and growth potential
solution: We partner up with one of the biggest cloud service provider in Europe and include parts of our ecosystem in their start-up program with vast educational options on setting up a project on top.

title: Providing Equal Access to Technology and Web 3.0 Through Resources and Education
problem: **Unequal tech access and limited web3 education leave many marginalized individuals behind in the transition, hindering their full participation in the digital economy and blockchain opportunities.**
solution: **Color the Blockchain ensures equal tech access and inclusive web3 education, bridging the digital divide for diverse participation in the blockchain revolution.**

title: Developer Studio
problem: Cardano contract development presents challenges in setup, evolving tools, and scarce documentation, requiring thorough research and adaptation.
solution: Streamline Cardano contract development kit with an all-in-one repository, automated multi-container workflow, and easy tool installation, empowering developers to focus on building.

title: Swiss-DAO Ecosystem Collaboration & Integration
problem: Little presence of Cardano in the wider-DAO ecosystem. No protocol has yet to position itself as the foundation (L1) for decentralised governance—a strong need for thought leadership and education.
solution: Integration of Cardano into the Swiss DAO ecosystem via content, events, and partnerships with local partners. Switzerland has the most clear and viable structures to operate such organisations.

title: dRepWatch - A transparency web platform for dReps
problem:
![Group-1959-60928c.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Group-1959-60928c/png)

There's a lack of a platform that ensures transparency, accessibility, engagement, and accountability of dReps, and addresses information asymmetry in decentralized systems.
solution: A platform similar to [abgeordnetenwatch.de](https://www.abgeordnetenwatch.de/) for dReps can provide transparency, facilitate engagement, and ensure accountability, addressing information asymmetry in decentralized systems.

title: AcademiPRISM: Credential Verification with SSI on Cardano
problem: The absence of a decentralized, scalable solution for verifying and sharing students' academic credentials from online courses using Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) within the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: "Developing a proof-of-concept SSI module using Atala PRISM for simulating online academic credential verification in Cardano."

title: unLearn: The Network Neighborhood (Decentralized & Autonomous Funding Mechanism)
problem: A need for a platform that not only enables individuals and groups to submit proposals and engage with the community but also provides an automated withdrawal process for approved funding proposals.
solution: Decentralized, autonomous funding mechanism for innovation and culture with automated withdrawal for approved proposals. Safe, fair, inclusive network neighborhood that empowers communities.

title: Car-Sharing DAO
problem: Inefficient and centralized car sharing systems limit user autonomy and fail to leverage benefits of blockchain's transparency and security.
solution: We will create a DAO on Cardano for a decentralized car sharing platform, improving user autonomy and harnessing blockchain's security benefits.

title: Servitization-Blockchain Accelerator: Revolutionizing Business Models
problem:
![accelerator-8f14c7.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/accelerator-8f14c7/png)

Global businesses struggle to adapt and grow due to lack of access to servitization expertise, tailored advisory services, and blockchain integration, limiting their ability to innovate and succeed.
solution: We will establish the Servitization-Blockchain Accelerator to provide partnership, advisory, and training services, helping businesses integrate servitization principles with Cardano blockchain.

title: ISPO Center - Aggregator, reviews, tech & marketing support in running ISPOs
problem: Lack of a comprehensive ISPO aggregator makes it hard to decide whether ISPO is worth participating. New teams from various chains may find it hard to start their own Initial Stake Pool Offering.
solution: Create an ISPO aggregator platform with reviews to facilitate informed participation and empower new teams in launching successful Initial Stake Pool Offerings through tech and marketing assistance.

title: dRep Educational Summit – fostering community participation
problem: The catalyst community struggles to grasp the concept of the drep role. Though novel, the community lacks comprehensive education on its significance to the governance phase of project catalyst.
solution: To host an educational summit on the concept of dRep, highlighting its significance in project catalyst to increase community participation.

solution: Develop an Asia Stakepool Alliance, open access database and framework for knowledge exchange, facilitating + increasing impact of mission driven SPOs operating in Asia and the diaspora.

solution: We will develop an open-source JSON library, including all official eIDAS translations. This resource will mitigate language barriers and minimize errors in international DID projects.

title: PlayerMint: Community PFP Battles
problem: There should be a way in which we can increase the utility of already existing NFTs and their communities.

title: Chadscore: Degen metrics on Cardano
problem: Cardano has yet to optimally keep pace with crypto's degen culture, which presents exponential opportunity for Cardano culture and ecosystem growth. On-chain mechanisms for this are needed.
solution: Chadscore ranks users according to the riskiness of their participation in Cardano projects and events. User degen behavior will be ranked & whitelists created for new Cardano projects launches.

title: MiMesa: The first restaurant booking system with blookchain technology
problem: We aim to solve the main issues that restaurants and users face such as: High platform fees, false reservations, last minute cancelations and false reviews.
solution: View real-time available tables and instantly book them with warranties. We ensure transparency, security, compensation and certified reviews. We bring blockchain closer to a daily use for everyone!

solution: Sparking Cardano's Revolution: Introduce Pop-Up Cafés to Bring Events to the People, Driving Blockchain Integration.

title: Revolutionizing Cardano Rewards Contracts: Aiken Language Upgrade for Efficiency and Functionality
problem: Inefficient and limited functionality of Cardano reward contracts hindering user onboarding and marketplace performance.
solution: Upgrade and optimize Cardano rewards contracts using Aiken language for enhanced efficiency and marketplace functionality.

title: (CaaS) Coin as a Service for SmartDev3: Copyright, coding, and web3 development tokenization
problem: For communities to flourish, compliant and permissionless smart contracts need to be employed around all aspects of a creative studio, from copyright registration, engineering and production.
solution: Coin as a Service enables copyright registration, hiring, & payments for web3 creators & devs via stablecoin & SmartDev3 dev platform. Aims to streamline web3 economies in a compliant manner.

title: Open Source Cardano API and Webhooks
problem:
![wb-750f3d.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/wb-750f3d/png)

Current solutions lack open-source webhooks. Our solution will provide an open-source Cardano API and webhooks.
solution: Our solution includes a Cardano API and webhooks to be deployed as docker containers in a Kubernetes cluster. The solution will be fully open-source support for easy customization.

title: Allow using NFTs from Cardano and other ecosystem in onchain games hosted in the Cardano ecosystem
problem: Right now games can be launched on sidechains of Cardano such as the games built by Paima Studios, but unless these games can leverage the liquidity of the Cardano L1, it is hard to monetize
solution: We'll allow onchain games deployed to the Cardano ecosystem on sidechain to access NFTs that live on the L1, as well as support NFTs from other ecosystems to encourage new users to come to Cardano

title: Cardano Node on AWS - Quick Start
problem: Many individuals and organizations want to build a Cardano node themselves. Still, the problem is creating services and apps on AWS as network, server, security, and alert system, making the system HA
solution: We propose to use CloudFormation (Infrastructure as Code) to set up the infrastructure. We will modularize the sources to make them easier to inherit and extend later.

title: A Permissionless, No-code needed Staking App for Native Asset Farming Pools & Rewards
problem: Cardano lacks a no-code needed staking platform that supports the permissionless creation of native asset staking pools. Staking is an important building block in a healthy and liquid DeFi ecosystem.
solution: We will make a no-code needed, no-setup fee staking platform that is non-custodial and permissionless to provide the community with a robust DeFi tool for creating native asset staking pools.

title: Automated Rewards mechanisms for projects on Cardano
problem: Ticketing solution have a limited scope to their usefulness, limited to check-ins. There are very few options for event organizers or services to offer additional value with their current options

solution: Rensa games can offer a marketplace for game developers to offer their assets and have them participate in gamejams with AAA companies. Resulting funds are smart contract destributed to the devs.

title: Incorporating Cardano blockchain into student scientific research projects
problem: Our university plans to introduce blockchain as a subject next year, exploring various technologies. Integrating Cardano blockchain into student research enhances its appeal to the younger generation.
solution: Lecturers were formed to enhance their understanding of Cardano and were encouraged to integrate Cardano into students' scientific research topics. Last year, our 5 Cardano-related topics got awards.

title: Building a financial ecosystem through digital identity and stablecoin for maximal social impact
problem: The project aims to address the lack of access to financial services and identity documents. Today, around 2 billion people are unbanked and 850 million are unidentified.
solution: Leverage blockchain technology to provide digital identity and stablecoin, effectively "Identifying the unidentified" and "Banking the unbanked". Foster financial & social inclusion.

title: InfinityPools - Empowering NFT and FT Staking with an Advanced Rewards Management & Distribution Platform
problem: Limited accessibility, project requirements, and a subpar user experience present significant challenges to widespread participation and value creation in the NFT and FT staking realm.

title: Exhibit Largest Blockchain EXPO(JP)：Cardano is hardly recognized in Japan. Therefore, we will exhibit at one of the largest trade shows to raise awareness and encourage developers to enter the market.　日本でカルダノは未だ認知不足の為、最大級の展示会に出展し多くの参加者を巻き込み開発を促進します。

title: Shinkai Visor Cardano Indexer integration (vector DB)

solution: We propose developing a Shinkai Visor connector for Cardano's data to convert this information into embeddings that LLMs can use for efficient querying, enhancing AI's interaction with Cardano.

title: ADAcrow - Decentralized, and P2P Escrow App
problem: Current business transactions suffer from issues of insecurity, exclusion, high costs, and lack of anonymity, primarily caused by centralized intermediaries and the absence of decentralization.
solution: Create decentralized escrow and dispute resolution on blockchain for secure, inclusive, cost-effective transactions, tackling issues caused by centralized intermediaries and lack of decentralization

title: Adafro Labs Uganda - Cardano First principles Hackathon
problem: There is a need in Uganda to jumpstart, inspire and showcase what developers & entrepreneurs can build on the Cardano blockchain.
solution: Host a one-day hackathon event in Kampala, Uganda to bring together our community members and software developers within the country focusing on building simple Dapps to drive the adoption of Cardano.

title: Invoicing SDK
problem: Generating verifiable invoices at zero cost is an unsolved problem. I prototype a standard and solution which can be used & understood by further financial technology.
solution: This will be an MVP of a new invoicing technology with enchain data structures. These can be satisfied uniquely according to programmable conditions, enabling a cornucopia of fintech innovation.

title: Exchange App from Ada to USD via Mobile Money in Africa
problem: African countries face obstacles when it comes to exchanging the ADA they receive into USD for local use, which explains their reluctance to use the ADA cryptocurrency.
solution: A user-friendly web and mobile App that enables seamless exchange of ADA to USD in Africa through Mobile Money. The App offers a complete solution to the problems described in the previous section.

solution: We will produce **five high-quality videos explaining Cardano's consensus mechanism, comparing it with Ethereum**, and highlighting the benefits for Cardano . **We aim to promote Cardano's adoption.**

title: Venster: On-Chain Generative Art and Open Publishing
problem: The Cardano community would benefit from having a suite of creative self-publishing tools, including a generative art platform offering support for on-chain generative tokens.

problem:

![Stacked-Circle-Blue400px-1-030bc5.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Stacked-Circle-Blue400px-1-030bc5/png)
solution: Build a dedicated Cardano native tokens data market aggregator on YallaCap, providing real-time data, ESG ratings, market insights and analytics

title: Empowering Dreams: The Cardano Comic Revolution
problem: Webtoon comic market worth about 5 billion dollars in 2022 and will reach 30 billion in 2028, yet artists suffer due to lack of resources and income. Let's bridge this absurd gap and empower creators!
solution: Revolutionary blockchain platform empowers webtoon comic artists, resolves financial woes with Cardano SPO. Fuel dreams, connect creators with eager audiences. Embrace the future now!

title: Integrating Cardano on ROVI.money - Simplest, Mega Fun Daily Use Crypto Wallet for Masses - Think "Metamask+GPay+Social Gaming" in 1 wallet."
problem: Current Web3 non-custodial wallets are just not simple enough for masses and adoption at scale. Wallet need to be made super simple, and super fun with daily usage utlities to unlock scale.
solution: A Non-Custodial, Social Login wallet, accesible on a simple link and shareable on Messaging/Email, supports Crypto and Fiat, with social gaming and payments as utility. Think "Metamask + GPay + Hago"

title: FiDa - AML KYC Support
problem: Integrating with TradFi includes regulatory compliance, and our risk transfer protocol must prove its participants meet Regulatory requirements for each jurisdiction a policy contract is issued in.
solution: We plan to integrate Atala Prism into our solution to provide on-chain proof of compliance for each participant in a given insurance policy contract on its respective jurisdiction.

7.3 kg of electronic waste generated per person each year and only 12.5% being recycled.

20% of people worldwide dispose of e-waste in unsorted trash. Cardano can help solve this and get new users
solution: Easy turn in Recycling Vapes, Gadgets, Electronics, Bank Cards, Other E-waste & Get a reward in form of NFT by #impact2earn CleanTech Chat Bot with built-in Social-Fi and Game-Fi elements

title: Staking Baskets Platform - Incentivizing Cardano’s Decentralization
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-8199f7/png)

Due to the A0 parameter, multi-pool groups have formed offering the same rewards as single SPOs with more pledge. This doesn’t incentivize users to delegate towards decentralization.
solution: Staking Baskets are a smart contract that allows users to deposit their ADA and delegate to multiple Stake Pools and receive extra token rewards from the Basket’s creator.

title: Cardano Over Coffee - Brewing Success for the Cardano Community by Empowering SPOs and Builders
problem:
SPOs & builders in Cardano struggle with marketing and outreach, and social media engagement is short-lived, making it difficult to keep up with the latest news, project developments and innovations.

![COC-382600.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/COC-382600/jpg)
solution:

title: SPOs Spanish Community - Workshops, Webinars, Events and Networking, fostering the development and evolution of the ecosystem with personalized support and education to operators and developers.
problem: There is no Spanish-speaking community or institution in Southern Europe that supports, helps, and encourages the development of the SPO ecosystem and its applications.
solution: Establish a physical and digital community in Europe that develops workshops, webinars, and events to educate, inform and support the development of the Hispanic SPO ecosystem and its applications.

title: To develop the means to introduce blockchain technology to the construction trades workforce. Using blockchain to create efficiencies in purchasing and scheduling.
problem: Construction sites are hit with material delays and staffing shortages that cost the industry millions of dollars every month globally. I want to find ways to expedite these problems using Cardano.
solution: Using the Cardano bloackchain, a secure network of companies could use it to find efficiencies in material costs, shipping, timelines etc. A data base would be setup to streamline orders, sellers.

title: cardano-node typescript implementation
problem: So far Cardano relies on a single implementation of the protocol (node); this is concerning from many points of view and is not something that can be solved directly by the founding entities.
solution: We propose to implement a feature-complete cardano-node in typescript; opening the development of the protocol to typescript developers and the use of the software to non-UNIX users.

title: Integrating ADA into multichain crowdfunding platform [Charity Impact]
problem: Currently, there are numerous crowdfunding platforms available for fiat or single cryptocurrencies, and very few multichain solutions, creating arduous administrative tasks for nonprofit organizations
solution: Charity Impact leverages DeFi to empower the worldwide charity network. Its multichain platform mitigates barriers established by traditional financial systems, such as international transfer limits.

title: Creating Conditions for DeFi Success in California
problem: DeFi tools are not KYC compliant. The lack of compliance will limit DeFi’s growth and potential unless clear regulations are created to integrate dApps with traditional compliance frameworks.
solution:
Three things:

- Generate a bill the California legislature can pass into law.
- Create a governance framework for developers to build on.
- Publish an open-source package so other states can replicate it.

title: Peerhive : Empowering SMEs with Real-World Asset Financing (RWA)
problem: SMEs need fast, affordable financing. PeerHive offers blockchain-based solutions for secure lending and investment opportunities.

title: Dims: Distributed Idea Management System
problem: Though collaboration is encouraged, the current ideation process in Catalyst incentivizes siloed competition. How can we make collaboration and convergent solutions the naturally beneficial choice?
solution: Dims: The research and development of a tool for building and merging structured graphs of knowledge and code. Highlighting how efforts overlap between different projects and individual interests.

problem: We aim to address the absence of a systematic, transparent, and community-driven process for funding, promoting, and ensuring the maintenance of innovative initiatives within the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Two-phase approach: continue and improve the established effective Catalyst Fund operations, then optimizing the process. This includes a sustainable funding model and consistent maintenance.

problem:

2\) Good marketplaces on Cardano and minting services are rigid and only accept ADA or single fungible assets.
solution: By integrating a dex-aggregation API on NFT makers existing API we will facilitate both minting and NFTs trades in all native but also non ADA assets. All while ensuring sellers are paid in ADA.

title: 9 DAO sample project – DAO or decentralized governance now everywhere in blockchain world. But there are few people participate in this activity. The reason is…
problem:
• The hardest thing when developing decentralized governance is education.

• There are no general documents, comparing the differences between decentralized governance models.
solution:
• Create documentation on decentralized governance models in many forms.

• The variety of forms here includes articles, short clips, livestreams, and quizzes.

• Will share and educate in our communities

title: CardanoPress NMKR Gamification Whitelist Integration
problem: Whitelisting can be a manual process and a boring one for users. We want to integrate CardanoPress with NMKR's API to enable more interesting and seamless whitelisting processes for projects.
solution: We'll integrate & automate the whitelisting process via gamification on CardanoPress. Projects can build interesting mechanics on their WP site to engage & whitelist users for upcoming mints on NMKR.

title: Development of a Cardano DApp and extensive documentation of each step along the way
problem: Many people learn very well by example. Currently, there are no e2e projects that can be used as educational resources in the Cardano community. This slows developers education and Cardano adoption.
solution:
Through this project I propose to deliver a DApp open source and extensively documented for didactic purposes.

I will document in detail all the stages of analysis, development, testing and release.

title: Cardano Kubernetes Orchestra: A decentralized end-to-end blockchain indexer API for Cardano
problem:
![Cardano-Ochestra-bcb347.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Cardano-Ochestra-bcb347/png)

Deploying your own Cardano data provider is time consuming and complex. It’s insufficient to simply run a Cardano node. You must carefully index the blockchain and build an API to query data.
solution: Orchestras will enable to run your own blockchain indexer and foster the decentralization of dapp data providers. Simply apply the Kubernetes Orchestra and access onchain data.

title: aiArt Plugin
problem: NMKR would benefit from the creation of AI-generated artwork. Simplifying the process would empower artists and developers to easily produce aiArt high-quality NFTs on the Cardano blockchain.
solution: An open-source plugin to connect AI models to NMKR for streamlined NFT generation. Upload input image, type a prompt, select the model, set parameters, then receive 100s of ready-to-mint NFTs.

title: Sports Crowdfunding system attached to Funclub application based on Cardano chain
problem: The absence of practical adoption examples poses a significant challenge for the Cardano system. Developing a viable product based on real-world applications is imperative for sustained profitability.
solution: We are set to develop a novel sports funding application for "FC Tokushima," the football team, utilizing the Cardano chain and CNFTs. The application will incorporate a robust CNFT and token system.

title: Spreading Cardano in Turkiye
problem: Cryptocurrencies are widely known and invested in Turkiye, but Cardano is barely known, and there are very few builders. Lack of resources and community hubs for Turkish creators stifle growth.
solution: Create a community of Turkish Cardano creators, share useful resources, help community members get into Cardano as builders and participants.

title: Cardano Global Outreach: Enhancing Adoption Through Engagement and Education
problem: Lack of awareness & understanding about Cardano among web3 communities is hindering growth & adoption
solution: Launch multi-channel educational campaign to promote Cardano, comprising virtual events, podcasts, YouTube, Twitter, and physical web3 event presence.

title: Advancing QR code technology and its blockchain utility to onboard Web 2 services to Cardano.
problem: Onboarding non-web3 businesses to the blockchain is often a struggle. This may be due to a lack of understanding, security concerns, or their challenges adapting to less tangible mediums.
solution: QR codes connected with items and the blockchain will improve proof of ownership protocols. QR codes are popular amongst non-web3 industries, hence is not new technology for such companies to learn.

title: KottoChain: Digitizing and NFTizing Antiques on Cardano to Revive and Enhance the Vanishing Heritage
problem: The heritage of antiques is vanishing due to the proliferation of counterfeits in the industry. Valuable items are often judged to be worthless as a result.
solution: We digitize antiques as NFTs, clarify authenticity and ownership, and contribute to saving the heritage. We are kicking off our global mission with Japanese antiques.

title: Cardano Campus Incubation Hub
problem:
Most tertiary students aspire to be entrepreneurs but lack the resources and guidance for their dreams.

How do we create awareness among students that their dreams can be fulfilled through cardano
solution: This project seeks to scout for student entrepreneurs in selected tertiary schools in Ghana and assign them to industry experts for incubation and onboard them onto the cardano community as well.

title: DCOne Crypto API for Open Source Developers
problem: The problem we want to solve is to provide developers and businesses with easy and reliable access to the Cardano blockchain infrastructure. So developers can focus on developing your app.
solution: We built a Cardano Node, Cardano DB Sync system. Then we provide API service systems for developers to access and use.

title: Space Trains and Metadata: Scaling our Communities of Trust
problem: The concept of preserving and transferring useful metadata between organizations is largely unexplored using blockchain. We lack standards for publishing emergent reputational value on-chain.
solution: We will initiate research and experimentation of using on-chain metadata to pass emergent reputational value from different communities along a Space Train and publish a CIP to make it a standard.

problem: Cardano projects and developers often lack branding and marketing skills/resources. This limits visibility and impact of both the project and broader ecosystem.

title: Inkuba: Unlocking the full potential of French Speaking African youth Through Blockchain and Innovation
problem: There is a lack of plateforms for innovation in Africa and even the few ones that exist are restricted, centralised and often do not encourage collaborative innovations.
solution: To put in place a space for innovation where talents can be empowered to collaboratively create/improve on and implement blockchain related solutions to different sectors of activities.

title: 45B - SPO Spotter - Delegation suggester based on Open Source interchangeable algorithms to rank Stake Pools
problem:
![45B-SPOtter-2-2f6ffb.jpeg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/45B-SPOtter-2-2f6ffb/jpeg)

As a Delegator, current UIs to choose a Stake Pool to delegate to are confusing not user friendly. Good UIs and ranked SP suggestions could greatly help in the overall health of (Single) Stake Pools.
solution: Instead of creating strictly defined ranking criteria, SPOtter aims to be a framework and set standards for obtaining and processing the Stake Pools data. The Delegator sets his ranking preferences.

title: Make NFTCDN Free To Use
problem: NFTCDN is an end-to-end service to display NFT media content at lower costs & minimal development. Budget constraints limit projects leveraging our capabilities, stifling Cardano's adoption & growth.
solution: Make NFTCDN’s APIs free for all to use enabling projects to display NFT media content effortlessly & efficiently on their websites/apps, returning an ROI of 20x & driving Cardano’s adoption & growth.

title: BLOCKTRUST Identity Wallet (PRISM) v1.0 for Android and iOS
problem: Trust on decentralized systems requires verifiable credentials. A generally available identity wallet for Cardano doesn't yet exist, and even if one did, a healthy ecosystem requires options.
solution: The Blocktrust Identity Wallet products for Android and iOS will be developed, and they will help dApps and enterprise projects accelerate, since they help build trust through verifiable credentials.

title: DIDs for DAOs: 1 person 1 vote Leveraging Atala PRISM SDK for Enhanced DID management on Agora
problem: Limited interoperability between Agora and Atala hinders seamless integration of Decentralized identifiers (DIDs)
solution: Integration of Agora with Atala to enable seamless cross-platform communication and interoperability for dApps.

title: NuNet: Running OSS ChatGPT alternatives on decentralized network // Enabling cheap and reliable Open Source chatbots alternatives on decentralized hardware supporting independence from big tech solutions.
problem: Recent hype around AI has seen a consolidation around big players in terms of accessibility to models and computing power. To secure diversity we need to provide access to decentralized computing.
solution:
NuNet will enable training, running and inference of various Open Source chatbots on decentralized hardware. NuNet's solution is all-inclusive for users and providers.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-custom-field-image-1daf3b/png)

title: Staking Basket Ecosystem Contract + Audit - Incentivizing Cardano's Decentralization
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-0e5202/png)

Due to the A0 parameter, multi-pool groups have formed offering the same rewards as single SPOs with more pledge. This doesn’t incentivize users to delegate towards decentralization.
solution: Staking Baskets are a smart contract that allows users to deposit their ADA and delegate to multiple Stake Pools and receive extra token rewards from the basket’s creator.

title: Erlang SDK for Blockfrost API
problem: Erlang developers are missing tools to fully enjoy Blockfrost.io, a service that provides free and public Cardano API to developers.
solution: We want to build an open-source SDK (Software Development Kit - a set of tools, libraries and documentation) for Erlang developers.

title: Upgrade CardanoSharp Library: Cross-Platform Compatibility & Optimized Coin Selection
problem: Lack of advanced features and cross-platform functionality in CardanoSharp, limiting development within Cardano ecosystem specifically with gaming / native desktop apps.
solution: Upgrade CardanoSharp by adding composable minUtxo outputs, Aiken Compilation, Ex Unit calculations, coin selection algorithms, provider support, and ensuring multi-platform .NET compatibility.

problem:

solution: Nucast will develop & launch mobile applications for seamless decentralized video streaming on Android and iOS, bringing mass adoption to Cardano.

problem: Limited large-scale adoption of web3 hampers its potential. Democratization and accessible platforms are key for widespread integration.

title: DLT360: Bridging Privacy & Law Enforcement based on Zero Knowledge Proof
problem:
**Cybercrime is damaging, but balancing investigations & privacy is challenging. Excessive user data aids crime, too much government interference endangers human rights. Striking a balance is crucial.**

![Screenshot-2023-07-11-at-12.11.15-8653e6.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-11-at-12.11.15-8653e6/png)
solution: **Collaboration with regulators and law enforcement can help build bridges between privacy and cybercrime investigation. This project outlines opportunities, secure solutions, and tools in this area**

title: Car-Sharing Platform
problem: The rise of connected vehicles necessitates improved security and data privacy. However, contemporary car-sharing services continue to utilize centralized platforms.
solution: We propose the development of a Cardano-based car-sharing solution, offering superior privacy and security.

title: Biometric crypto wallet
problem: With the future of crypto resting in proving humanness, wallets lack the nuance to store cryptographic data for the age of AI. Without biometrics, esp brain, cybersecurity risks loom large for crypto.
solution: Due to the sensitive nature of biometric data, a standalone biometric crypto wallet will be created. A proof-of-concept/prototype hardware wallet will also be designed.

title: Teaching Turks Cardano Through Online Workshops, Youtube videos, and Community Building
problem: To involve Turkish youth and young adults in the project, Cardano and Project Catalyst will be utilized to overcome language and resource barriers.
solution: My solution is to improve the Cardano and Project Catalyst knowledge of students and young adults in Turkey through Youtube videos, online workshops and events.

problem:
PlutusTx and PAB were seemingly designed to scare as many developers away as possible.

We want a low-friction on-ramp for developers to sandbox, prototype, and deploy their ideas for Smart Contracts.
solution:
A test-centric smart contract off-chain framework.

A fool-proof API for transaction building.

A Swiss-army-knife command line app + wallet for managing contracts and environments.

Problem statement

problem: Creation of smart contracts & dApps on Cardano is too difficult for most software developers. There is no framework for applying strong architectural patterns for flexible, evolving contracts
solution: We created Stellar Contracts - a library for creating dApp components with advanced architecture using multiple on-chain contract scripts, along with their off-chain code, all from the browser.

problem:

problem: The limited availability of user-friendly ADA platforms and insufficient support mechanisms are hindering its widespread acceptance and utilization.

title: DirectEd- Coding Schools and Employers Governance Framework in Africa

solution: Empowering Animal Welfare and Conservation through technology-driven solutions.

problem: Job seekers’ private information and career credentials are commodities that Big Data aggregators exploit - thereby making online recruiting expensive, inefficient, and unsubstantiated for employers.
solution: A decentralized identity solution securely lets job seekers own and self-manage their career credentials. It removes intermediaries - increasing trust, efficiency, and financial rewards for all.

An application that simplifies and streamlines the registration of exchange processes, connecting the "why" (the need for reliable registration) with the "how" (our user-friendly platform).

problem: Dominant competitors using fiat money in online lodging marketplace lead to high rental rates for hosts and customers.
solution: Web app with novel crypto payment, reducing fees in lodging marketplace dominated by competitors. Kirkstone ecosystem enhances stability, utility, and token value.

title: Cardano Summit 2023 NFT Hoodies - Verifiable Ownership Of Real World Merch
problem: Cardano Summit 2023 is taking place in Dubai. There are currently no brands which are offering products for this event that provide verifiable ownership using Cardano technology.

solution: We will create an open-source, stable, self-hosted, customizable, and developer-friendly solution for database synchronization on Cardano.

solution: We have submitted a CIP 68 royalty standard for review. This proposal ensures adoption by finishing that standard, creating a reference implementation, and adding support to open source libraries.

title: Neuralprint: EEG & biometrics R&D
problem: Enabling a brain-empowered web3 requires R&D on various human states of mind. A survey of common brain states and hardware dev are needed in order to create a library of biometric data for web3 use.
solution: Expert R&D on brain and biometric states relevant to use cases and everyday life, suitable for web3 use, e.g. authentication. Development of key algorithms and integration with hardware EEG headset.

2. Traditional event platforms are not Cardano-ready
3. Tools and platforms for events are too fragmented
solution: Plats is developing an all-in-one event platform that facilitates seamless crypto rewards and crowd sponsorships for the Cardano Ecosystem. Our product is offered on a Web Service and a Mobile App.

title: A Blockchain-Based System for Due Diligence
problem: Preventing real estate fraud and ensuring transparency in transactions through secure verification using Cardano Blockchain.
solution: We will develop a secure verification system using Cardano Blockchain to prevent real estate fraud and ensure transparency in transactions.

problem: Visually impaired individuals face significant challenges in independently identifying and distinguishing different denominations of currency in 3rd world countries.
