solution: We're building an all-in-one interface that teaches the user about blockchain and seamlessly displays their tokens, NFTs, and staking data.

title: Catalyst4Carbon: A Gamified Mobile App Encouraging Reduction of Personal Carbon Footprints Through the Cardano Ecosystem.
problem: Climate change is a global crisis. Many individuals lack an engaging way to measure and lower their personal carbon footprints.
solution: We're creating 'Catalys4Carbon', a gamified mobile app that calculates personal carbon footprints, incentivizes reductions, and donates to environmental causes using ADA.

title: Engaging Early Adopters: Incentivizing PRISM-based Educational Credentials for IT Professionals in Recruitment and Establishing a Governance Framework
problem:

problem: Addressing the problem of data integrity in scientific research and improving accessibility in Cardano's NFT ecosystem through advanced API integrations.
solution: We will create a platform on the Cardano blockchain integrated with NMKR Studio API called Tokenized Research. Our goal is to ensure research data integrity and advance NFT accessibility.

title: Tekmirio Non-Custodial NFT Staking Platform
problem: The current NFT Staking solutions are too expensive charging NFT projects 5,000 to 15,000 ADA per project. Examples include solutions from [CardanoLands](http://cardanolands.com/) , [Mutant Labs](https://labs.mutant-nft.com/) and [Anvil Dev Agency](http://ada-anvil.io/)
solution: An App that tracks every NFT in the wallet and accumulates rewards for the user. Free for all users with a for pay subscription membership option that includes a 25% boost in rewards.

title: eIDAS 2.0 EU Regulation Guideline
problem: Lack of comprehensive, accessible resources on the upcoming eIDAS 2.0 EU regulation, leading to ill-preparedness in the Cardano community
solution: We will develop an online comprehensive guide on eIDAS 2.0, engaging with policymakers and the Cardano community, for enhanced regulation understanding and readiness.

title: 🌿Carbon Credit Accountability Initiative: Illuminating the Path to Verifiable Emissions Reduction
problem:

There are very few mainstream industries that adopt and integrate blockchain technology, let alone Cardano. However, there are industry needs for transparency and immutability of information.
solution: We will conduct a feasibility study for the use of the Cardano blockchain in the Carbon Credit industry to promote transparency in project development methodologies, data collection and lineage.

title: Graphic Tx Builder and Viewer
problem: We will develop a webapp that will allow end-users and developers to visualize and build transactions in a graphical way.
solution: We will develop a tool that will allow any user to navigate in a graphical way the Cardano blockchain.

problem: Compared to traditional finance, where structured investment products provide diverse trading options, yields, and protections, crypto traders are constrained by limited choices.

solution: Token Allies, the first Decentralized VC in Cardano, revolutionizes investing. Democratizing access, dismantling barriers, redefining VC through inclusivity, transparency, and mutual benefits.

problem: E-commerce lacks exclusive token-gated access and loyalty rewards powered by blockchain.

problem: Metastate aims to solve is the lack of transparency, inefficiency, and limited accessibility in traditional real estate transactions, hindering global property ownership and investment opportunities.
solution: Platform that leverages tokenization to make real estate transactions secure, transparent, and accessible globally, unlocking new opportunities for ownership, investment, and property transactions.

title: Open Source Python Tool for Linkage Finance Smart Contract Interaction
problem: Unlocking Linkage Finance's potential by enabling seamless integration with bots and DApps for limitless possibilities.
solution: Developing an open source Python tool to directly interact with Linkage Finance smart contracts, empowering bots and DApps for frictionless integration.

title: Unleash creativity in player-built multiverse.
problem: Current player-built metaverses use box-like structures due to technology limitations, requiring expensive devices and limiting the market. Blockchain games focus on finance, neglecting gamers.
solution: Miverse offers a captivating experience with thousands of game genres to enjoy. Our metaverse is a limitless world where you can do anything, and explore multiple planets with diverse concepts.

title: Wada Ghana Resource Center. Empowering African Youth in Web3 and Cardano Blockchain Development.
problem: Lack of resources hampers African youth in web3 & blockchain development and their ability to compete on the global stage. A dedicated center can empower them to contribute to the digital landscape.
solution: Use the Wada Ghana Resource Center to facilitate comprehensive training, mentorship, resources, partnerships, and job placement to empower young Africans in the web3 and blockchain development space.

title: AgroTechnology Cardano: empowering Food Security & Sovereignty with Tokenization, Real-Time Traceability, Sovereign Identity, Quality Certificates NFTs, IoT Sensors, AI, Data Science, Precision Farming, Smart Contracts, and R&D.
problem: Agricultural producers lack technology in their crops, leading to challenges in traceability, data analysis, certifications, financing, market connectivity, climate uncertainty, and government support
solution: We will tokenize farmland using a Technology Ecosystem for traceability, IoT sensors for environmental monitoring, and AI models for productivity. All this will be possible by token sale proceeds.

title: KarbonMap - Scalable, Authenticated, Traceable Carbon Credit & Payment Distribution on Cardano
problem: Carbon certification process is complex & costly, leading to the exclusion of local indigenous communities and small projects. Investments in carbon projects are also unavailable to retail investors.
solution: Democratise carbon MRV (Measurements, Reporting, Validations) process by enabling the community to participate in ground truth data collection, bringing all sizes of projects to carbon accreditation.

title: Cardano NFT Integration in Death-Race Game, Project: Hermes
problem: Cardano and Web3 face the challenge of limited gaming integration, depriving users of *high-quality*, immersive gaming experiences and hindering the growth of decentralized gaming ecosystems.
solution: GENUN solves the AAA quality Cardano adoption in gaming with Project: Hermes integration, accelerating adoption and expanding the boundaries of gaming into WEB3 and bringing AAA experience.

title: T Minus One (T-1): Token Creator Platform for Cardano
problem: Cardano's complex process for token mint and sales, requiring knowledge of smart contracts and standards, can lead to errors and discourage potential entrepreneurs, hindering ecosystem growth.
solution: T-1 will streamline Cardano token launches via simplified creation, minting, sales, and systematic distribution. Their platform's smart contracts manage post-sale liquidity on decentralized exchanges.

title: Xerberus Powered Catalyst Analytics Dashboard
problem: There is a critical lack of transparent on-chain analytics specifically tailored for Catalyst voting and funding usage.
solution: An analytics dashboard is designed to **explore proposal votes** and **monitor the flow of funds** from Project Catalyst to the funded projects.

title: Lenfi V2 Aiken Audit + Bug Bounty
problem: Cardano lacks a diverse list of open-source lending protocols compared to other ecosystems. This restricts user adoption because of the general uncertainty regarding smart contract security.
solution: Lenfi will deploy a safe-to-use and battle-tested lending protocol on Cardano written in Aiken. The protocol smart contracts will be open source to promote ecosystem growth and build trust.

title: Spectrum Network | Cross-chain Messaging Protocol
problem:
![Square-post-47d98d.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Square-post-47d98d/jpg)

Cardano lacks a decentralized mechanism that enables programmable cross-chain communication with other blockchains. E.g. it is impossible to make a smart contract to swap native ADA for native ETH.
solution: Spectrum Network protocol serves as a trustless programmable cross-chain layer that allows cross-chain messaging between Cardano and any other connected blockchains or general data source.

title: Liquidity Efficient DEX Models for Cardano
problem: Inefficient liquidity use and impermanent loss in Cardano's DEXs due to the unsuitability of the current AMM model for Cardano's eUTXO model, hindering DeFi growth and decentralization.
solution: Research and propose liquidity provision models optimized for Cardano's eUTXO model to address inefficient liquidity use and impermanent loss in DEXs.

title: Youth Blockchain and Crypto Entrepreneurship Program
problem: Lack of access to quality blockchain education and resources for young entrepreneurs.
solution: Establish a comprehensive Youth Blockchain and Crypto Entrepreneurship Program to provide education, mentorship, and practical experience.

title: Sculptor art marketplace & NFT-Tool for artists' websites: Crown Shy Continuum
problem: Established sculptor artists exhibit and sell their artwork in moving exhibitions. They are looking for a professional and easy to use solution to create and sell NFTs, integrated in their websites.
solution: Using NMKR we develop a marketplace for sculptor artists specific: Crown Shy Continuum (CSC). Beyond Artists can integrate their NFTs it into their own websites using the same NMKR framework.

title: We’re a one-stop high integrity carbon data platform for companies, project developers and investors, leveraging 7-year blockchain supply chain traceability leadership and global clients
problem: **Existing opacity in the voluntary carbon market due to lack of traceability (ex ante and ex post) of projects lifecycle. Data is not centralised and can be easily modified across the value chain.**
solution: **CrystalTrade will enhance transparency and trust for corporate buyers and investors through carbon project end-to-end traceability, data aggregation from multiple sources and data immutability.**

title: DAO Treasury & Protocol Parameter Management via On-Chain Governance - By MuesliSwap
problem: Outcomes of on-chain governance votes on Cardano should directly trigger on-chain events (e.g. treasury txs, protocol parameter updates, etc.). This is essential for truly decentralised DAO operation.
solution: We will develop a treasury smart contract, and protocol parameter update mechanisms, and integrate both with on-chain voting solutions, including necessary SCs, backend infrastructure, and frontend.

title: Blebox: Retail Reimagined for the Digital Age
problem:
![IASYNT logo](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/WhatsApp-Image-2023-07-17-at-13.52.31-2be43c/jpg)

Current supermarket systems lack transparency, efficiency, and personalized experiences. Centralized models limit innovation and customer trust in product authenticity.
solution: We will develop a decentralized supermarket platform using blockchain for transparency, IoT for efficiency, and AI/ML, AR/VR for personalized, immersive experiences.

title: Stoa Smart Contract - User Account NFTs
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-12c672/png)

Users don’t have an account NFT that smart contracts can read. Existing account NFTs are minted by centralized parties/servers and don’t store user data on-chain.
solution: The Stoa contract mints two NFTs with names that can’t be copied. One matching NFT is stored in the contract, and holds user datums such as XP, display name, bio, social accounts, friends, and more!

title: MLabs - Cardano-Transaction-Library Evolution
problem: Cardano-Transaction-Library (CTL) went from prototype to production quickly, and the codebase requires several improvements, as well as updates and support.
solution:
Proposed changes:

- Modularize & split the codebase
- Simplify the constraints interface used for transaction building
- Update dependencies and tooling software

title: CryptoCampus: Revolutionizing Student Marketplaces with Blockchain
problem: Students face difficulties in securely and efficiently buying and selling items like textbooks, furniture, and electronics within their campus communities.
solution: We will create a blockchain-powered marketplace to enable students to buy and sell items securely and efficiently, leveraging smart contracts for trust-building.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: DirectEd- Crowdfunding & Milestone-Based Smart Contract Primitive and Audit
problem: The high development cost for projects seeking to implement on-chain milestone-based distribution of funds and decentralized approvals mechanisms.
solution: Open source and audit a smart contract primitive that enables multi-party milestones-based distribution of funds to projects or individuals.

title: Statur: Reputation Model for Web3 Ecosystem that encourages positive behaviour
problem: Complete transparency can sometimes complicate discerning trustworthiness. Users often exercise caution due to potential fraud and malevolent activities.
solution: Reputation scores enable informed decisions, reduce fraud risk, promote accountability, reward trust, resolve disputes, and enhance blockchain trust.

title: Minswap Aiken Stableswap Audit + Bug Bounty
problem: The problem to be solved is the current lack of an open-source Stableswap on Cardano and the low liquidity for stable assets (in particular stablecoins) in the DeFi ecosystem.
solution: Minswap Labs will build an open-source Aiken-based Stableswap to enable Cardano DeFi users to trade stable assets in the most efficient manner. This will strengthen stablecoin liquidity on Cardano.

title: Anastasia Labs - Streamlining Development: A User-Friendly Smart Contract Library for Plutarch and Aiken Design Patterns & Efficiency
problem: There are a ton of design patterns that address many of the most difficult problems for smart contract development, but they are so unintuitive that barely anyone knows about them.
solution: Two wrapper libraries for Plutarch and Aiken smart contracts, that streamline development by abstracting unintuitive design patterns.

title: Docufi3d - A Decentralized Platform for Web3 SSI Credential-Based Digital Document Signing and Verification
problem: The lack of a decentralized system for reliable document/content authenticity verification and legally binding signatures hampers trust and enables fraud.
solution: Develop a decentralized and secure platform for reliable document authenticity verification and legally binding signatures that enhances trust and prevents fraud.

title: DEMU Protocol | Phase 3 - Music Rights Management
problem:
Music licensing & royalty distribution are complex and inefficient, hindering growth and innovation in the music industry & for music app developers. Solving it on Cardano accelerates its adoption.

![demu_FINAL-212398.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/demu_FINAL-212398/png)
solution: We'll develop the DEMU Protocol to offer on-chain & off-chain APIs for app developers to access & add licensable music, fostering a music ecosystem on Web3, with royalty settlement powered by Cardano

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Open-Source NFT Swap Infrastructure: 1-Click Deployment Templates (Phase 2)
FetaChain: Hardware-Backed Secure Supply Chain Tracking
problem:
Existing supply chain tracking on Cardano lacks secure hardware integration, compromising data integrity and trust. We aim to address this by developing a reliable hardware solution for data tracking

![fetachain_diag-bbfa41.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/fetachain_diag-bbfa41/png)
solution:
Develop a specialized hardware solution for secure and reliable supply chain tracking on Cardano, with separate sensor and compute layer, ensuring data integrity and enhancing trust in the ecosystem.

![fetachain_diag2-80a241.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/fetachain_diag2-80a241/png)

title: DirectEd- Funding Progress Tracker, Dynamic NFTs for Impact and Editable Metadata
problem: Lack of a dynamically updating progress bar for NFT sales, seamless holder-editing of pre-specified fields in the NFT metadata, and dynamically updated impact data contained in the NFT.
solution: Plug-and-play integration to display real-time progress, purchasers metadata modification functionality, and an ability for impact organizations to update donors NFTs based on NMKR Dev APIs.

title: Contract Explorer
problem: Addressing the lack of clarity and accessibility in Cardano scripts, mitigating blind trust and reducing reliance on technical expertise for understanding.
solution: We will create a website with AI analysis, user reviews, and source code retrieval for Cardano scripts, promoting transparency and understanding.

title: Research: Unique Pseudonymous Identification of DReps through Joint Content Creation
problem: Allowing DReps to remain anonymous has value, but there are some dangers to fair governance if very large whales decide to game the system. DReps should be encouraged to consider diverse perspectives.
solution: Research detailing how community discussions can not only help DReps broaden their perspectives, but also be used to validate DReps as unique individuals, making things like quadratic voting possible.

title: AdaLens: A Next-Generation Cardano-Powered AI Camera with Neuromorphic Intelligence and Privacy Capabilities
problem:
There is a growing concern of camera hacks, data insecurity, identity faking, and risked privacy in modern security cameras. AdaLens uses Cardano-powered hybrid cameras to solve these issues.

![nusneuro-3bc4d2.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/nusneuro-3bc4d2/png)
solution: Revolutionizing surveillance with AdaLens: A Cardano-powered AI camera combining neuromorphic intelligence and privacy capabilities for unparalleled identity management, security, privacy and control.

title: European Cardano Community Town Hall - Operation
problem: Absence of a platform hampers collaboration, information sharing about EU regulation and steps for ensuring compliance, language barriers, growth, and adoption in European Cardano community incl. SPO.
solution: A multilingual European Cardano Community Town Hall for collaboration of SPO and projects, addressing region-specific challenges, and driving Cardano's growth and adoption in Europe.

title: Add Fresh Engineering and Science Graduates to Developer Ecosystem
problem: There is a shortage of qualified developers for Cardano Blockchain worldwide. India has 2 million Developers with less than 0.5% on all the Blockchains.
solution: To increase developers in India, bring awareness, identify fresh engineering graduates and train them on Plutus and Haskell and assist them to work on live projects.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: IMPACT MEASUREMENT SYSTEM FOR RATING CARDANO NATIVE TOKENS WITH ESG, SDG, IRIS AND UNIQUE DIGITAL ASSETS STANDARDS.
problem: ESG ratings fall short for digital assets. Unique criteria in decentralized ecosystems require a new approach. Introducing IMS: A complete evaluation for social, governmental, and environmental impact
solution: A rating impact system, with detailed methodologies and global frameworks that will help rate digital assets in order to empower stakeholders for informed decisions and drive positive change.

title: UMAMI, a token incentivized restaurant review platform
problem:
With our project we want to improve the restaurant review landscape.

A token incentivized platform to guarantee accuracy, trustworthiness and consistency!
solution:
Web3 platform built on Cardano for transparency, immutability and temper proof.

Token incentive as reward for quality reviews.

Reputation system to reward consistency, accuracy, trustworthiness.

title: Bring the Web3 universe to your Discord server
problem: Delivering community development solutions on Discord with the aim of making it available to everyone, promises to make it easy for new users to get the web3 universe and create interesting activities
solution: Build a discord bot that allows users to perform operations with the cardano network such as transferring crypto, nft, token. and reward mechanisms through active discord

title: Cardano NFT Licenses
problem: Ambiguity and lack of standardized licensing framework for Cardano NFTs, lead to confusion, disputes, and limited legal clarity for NFT creators, buyers, and the wider Cardano community.
solution: Introduce Cardano-specific licenses, providing clear, standardized guidelines for NFT ownership, rights, and permitted usage, enhancing transparency, security, and legal certainty.

title: Typhon Wallet Mobile App
problem: A mobile wallet that supports all features and is user-friendly, secure, and fast, connects with Ledger, and Trezor; is a must for users. Cardano lacks mobile wallet options for greater adoption.
solution: Create a user-friendly UI/UX non-custodial Cardano Wallet mobile app that enables users to transact, connect with DApps, engage in seamless staking, browse Assets/NFT gallery, and do a lot more.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Block Bounty Protocol & API Specification with JS Code Examples
problem: Cardano needs a bounty management system that has open source protocol and API documentation to be more accessible to developers and community members.
solution: We will create open source protocol and API documentation for Block Bounty to make it more accessible to developers and community members.

title: Simple Node Sharing on Cardano
problem: Initiating and configuring a Node can be a time-consuming task, presenting challenges especially during infrastructure transitions and for novice users or developers eager to experiment.
solution: We will develop a toolchain to enable the sharing of the Cardano Node Socket between different machines over various channels (SSH,HTTP,UDP,etc).

title: Fluxion - An Efficient, Flexible and Decentralized Custom Query Solution for Cardano
problem: Users of Cardano blockchain require a more flexible query solution that goes beyond a fixed schema and avoids the need for expensive infrastructure to run the underlying db-sync stack.
solution: Fluxion provides a custom and flexible query solution for Cardano, enabling efficient querying, indexing and interaction with the blockchain, eliminating the need for expensive infrastructure.

title: PlayCardano.com ADA Prediction Game
problem: Gamers don't have a gaming destination to spend and win ADA coins. There is also a need for an easy, fast, and fun game everyone can play.
solution:
A proven and successful sports prediction game at a new gaming destination: PlayCardano.com

Spend and win ADA on all prediction games on the platform. It can be customized by sport and event.

title: Delegation gate (login) for popular web frameworks
problem: A website is a baseline marketing tool. Authentication is a basic website feature. SPOs need a readymade solution to deliver exclusive content to their delegators.
solution: Our solution is AEGISauth, a simple delegation gate (login), compatible with the most popular web frameworks (express, nextjs, vite, laravel, django, flask).

title: Stories, Tea, Art, and Coffee (STAC)
problem: Adoption of Cardano and blockchain using digital solutions and products continue to be slow among non-natives to the web3 ecosystem. What if we try the adoption of Cardano through everyday use cases?
solution: We are using stories, tea, art, and coffee as elements to attract new users and adoption to the Cardano ecosystem, by using these known elements to explain their unknowns about blockchain and Cardano

title: Conserving Gorillas through NFT Sales: A Campaign for Wildlife Preservation
problem:
![Nnabanga, a back sliver in Kahizi-Biega Park](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/_MG_6302-ae6e9b/jpg)

There is an urgent need for innovative strategies to protect ***gorillas*** due to habitat loss, poaching and illegal wildlife trade. Traditional funding is insufficient, so we need innovative **solutions**.
solution: The proposed solution is to leverage ***Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs)*** as a fundraising and awareness tool for **gorilla conservation**.

title: Nucast : Multiplatform TV App - The First Cardano-Based TV Dapp
problem: The Cardano ecosystem lacks a decentralized video streaming solution that can be used across TV platforms, limiting access to a smooth decentralized video streaming experience on TV.
solution: We will develop and launch a Television app (Nucast) that delivers seamless decentralized video streaming for Android TV, iOS TV & more. This will bring Cardano into every home.

title: RatsDAO I Plutus Smart Contracts for decentralized Raffles.
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-a8db45/jpg)

There are currently no open source Plutus smart contracts in Cardano that would allow Raffles to be carried out.
solution: Our solution is to develop open-source Plutus smart contracts for conducting raffles on the Cardano blockchain, providing a transparent and decentralized platform for fair and secure raffle events.

title: Grassroots Governance Community Forums
problem:
![Grassroots Governance Community Forum](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-from-2023-07-11-15-04-19-53795a/png)

Decentralised governance requires diverse participants to convene, discuss, and resolve our shared governance challenges but there are not many existing spaces to have these discussions
solution: Organize and deliver four Grassroots Governance Community Forums to bring together diverse individuals and projects across Cardano and other web3 ecosystems to address pressing governance questions

title: [Fimi] IOG’s Research Paper for Vietnamese Developer
problem: Developers and members of the Cardano Vietnam community have language difficulties when reading long and specialized research papers published by IOG.
solution: We will translate [IOG's research papers](https://iohk.io/en/research/library/) into Vietnamese, explain difficult terms, and post them on [cardano.vn](https://cardano.vn/docs/News/tech/tai_lieu_ky_thuat) to create a knowledge library for developers and members of the Cardano Vietnam community.

title: Web3 NFT Tokengated for eCommerces, Sites, Landing Pages & Conversion Pages - Bringing eCommerce to the Cardano blockchain
problem:
![9dcf283b58e125e8f85b7441c0fcf161-891fd9.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/9dcf283b58e125e8f85b7441c0fcf161-891fd9/png)

Unlock the **super powers of Web3 to online stores and e-commerce with *NoCode* (plug & play)**. Enabling eCommerce platforms/stores to make online brand experiences more unique with the power of the NFTs
solution: The NFTs as the future of e-commerce. The app that allows any store to launch showcases closed by NFTs with a feature for brands to make their stores unique and personalized for each NFT holder user.

title: [C2VN]: Cardano developer courseware in Universities
problem:
University students are promising blockchain developers but these developers can't afford formal basic and blockchain programming courses.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-ec04ea/png)
solution: We aim to create 02 coursewares: Fundamental blockchain and Cardano Blockchain for developers then we will implement these curriculums in the classroom as mainstream subjects in Universities.

title: Transparent reviews and ratings
problem: Blockchain review system fosters transparency, trust, and informed decision-making, overcoming feedback limitations. Boosts Cardano ecosystem growth.
solution: Developing a blockchain-based review system for Cardano, ensuring transparent and reliable feedback, promoting trust and informed decision-making.

title: Wada documentary distribution
problem:
![Wada_poster-A4-v2_smaller-ea10eb.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Wada_poster-A4-v2_smaller-ea10eb/jpg)

The documentary "Chasing The Wada Dream" about blockchain education in Africa lacks wider distribution.
solution: We plan to submit the movie to the film festivals across the globe. We plan to travel with the movie across Africa to show the opportunities Cardano is bringing to the continent.

title: Mental Health DAO - A Mental Health and Wellbeing focused DAO bringing people together through art, dialogue and collaboration.
problem:
![ONEIRICREFLECTIONS - The unknown path of reason By https://twitter.com/LuetasNFT](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Luetas-969ec4/png)

Mental health challenges, burnout and isolation are growing issues worldwide. **Suicide is a leading cause of death** for **men** under 50. How can we address this complex problem with a Cardano4Good force!
solution: Create a mental health focused DAO. Welcoming those affected and suffering from mental health challenges. Enable, empower and inspire people through art, poetry, music, dialogue and collaboration.

title: IndieHUB x FluxusNetwork
problem:
![222-05851f.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/222-05851f/jpg)

![indie_hub_logo_w-1-e2aeef.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/indie_hub_logo_w-1-e2aeef/png)

We do not have enough eyes outside the Cardano ecosystem to judge how much positive development is fuelled by Cardano.
solution: The IndieHUB (Games/Technology Centre in Germany) offers us the opportunity to present our projects and introduce the Cardano brand to a broad network in Central Europe

title: BitFins: Augmented Reality Mobile App For Displaying & Interacting With Digital Assets
problem:
Many users in blockchain currently don't have many ways to use the assets they purchase, if any.

Digital collectibles specifically on Cardano in general lack platforms supporting their use-cases.
solution: We are building a mobile app through BitFins that allows users to design, view, and share augmented reality galleries of their digital assets anywhere they go. This would work for all standard assets.

title: To address the scarcity of development tools and resources for Helios, a functional Domain-Specific Language (DSL) implemented in Javascript, my proposal is to enhance it by incorporating additional templates, examples, videos, docs and tests.
problem: I want to eliminate delays in Cardano Smart Contract development. Increase Cardano developer base and tools adoption by simplifying and improving Helios ecosystem tools.
solution: I will create more testing code, documentations, examples, templates and videos to make it easy for new developers to work in Cardano.

title: Cardano For the M₳sses - Japanese Book
problem:
Knowledge of Cardano is mainly in English. So **it is difficult for the Japanese who want to learn about Cardano, affecting Cardano's ability to reach new users.**

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-46ddf2/png)
solution:
Publish the book “Cardano For the M₳sses” in the Japanese version to help the Japanese understand Cardano better and attract more newcomers.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-custom-field-image-6a777f/png)

title: Carnada, the first digital magazine about Cardano
problem:
My proposal solves the problem of limited Cardano content for Spanish speakers, tapping into a vast market of 543 million speakers.

![12-8131b5.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/12-8131b5/png)
solution: Digital magazine format enables creation of written and visual content, including original articles and translations, easily shareable through various platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, email).

title: AI and Blockchain for Efficient Pharmacy Management
problem: Addressing challenges in real-time personalized medication advice, potential interaction checks, and efficient inventory management in pharmacies.
solution: We will develop an AI-powered, Cardano blockchain-based software that provides real-time, personalized medication advice, interaction checks, and inventory management for pharmacies.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Extending CENT Basic smart contracts repository (1-click deployment and open source)
problem: Free, open source smart contracts that can be deployed by anyone should be easily available. The Cardano community need access to ready-made smart contracts without having to buy from developers
solution: CENT already provides a repository of reusable and easy to set up smart contracts and a concept dapp we call public micro drive (PMD). We propose to extend this with even more basic contracts

title: The GOMA Wada Hub onboarding Students program
problem:
![photo_2023-07-09_21-10-25-7d20c4.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/photo_2023-07-09_21-10-25-7d20c4/jpg)

Most of students in Goma/Dem. Rep. of Congo are not aware of blockchain technology and its opportunities. Cardano can support their oboarding though our existing program.
solution: Enlarge the actual Goma onboarding program to reach more students. Three months of workshops on blockchain technology, Cardano, Project Catalyst.

title: Logyq Protocol - Social commerce and Digital Product Passport
problem: E-commerce in Africa has the potential to be a **huge market** but it is hindered by a lack of trust that severely hampers its growth.
solution: We will build a social commerce app that builds trust with its users through the use of blockchain tracking, DIDs and of an AI personal assistant.

title: Fund 6 months of part-time student internship at Harmonic Laboratories
problem: Students often struggle to find an entry-point into the Cardano ecosystem via startups, due to the former's lack of experience and the latter's lack of disposable resources.
solution: In the spirit of the challenge (point 2 of the challenge description), we propose an internship in one of the emerging startups in Cardano, focused on smart contract & infrastructure development.

title: Africa Stakepool Alliance
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-c5793e/png)

Africa is the world's youngest continent with 60% of the population below 25 years old. A Stakepool Alliance supporting single SPOs in Africa to promote decentralization of the network is lacking.
solution: Develop the Africa Stakepool Alliance, open access database and framework for knowledge exchange, facilitating + increasing impact of mission driven SPOs operating in Africa and the diaspora.

title: Writers' Safe on Cardano
problem: Plagiarism is a serious problem writers are still suffering from in different exposures.
solution: We can resolve that issue by developing a dApp that ensures confidentiality and restricted access to their creative works or documents they made a lot of effort.

title: Multi-chain NFT Marketplace & Launchpad with Staking
problem:
Limited access to diverse NFTs & funding for projects; our platform connects creators, collectors & investors across multiple chains, fostering innovation.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-a729ac/png)
solution: Multi-chain NFT Marketplace & Launchpad with Staking: Empowering creators, investors, and collectors with seamless access to diverse NFTs and funding opportunities.

title: Alternative Assessment Process R&D and Experimental Implementation
problem: Voters are overwhelmed. Proposals receive roughly equal scrutiny. Reviews are not meaningful because community reviewers are not adequately incentivised to conduct deep critical investigations.
solution: R&D and experimental implementation of several alternative assessment/QA models for Catalyst funds distribution, one of them being the 2-stage proposal assessment process,

title: Functionality Options For NMKR Campaigns
problem: While NMKR makes it easy for anyone to create NFTs, consumers and projects want on-page, web3 utility for those tokens and there is no UI to add utility to tokens.
solution: Provide token gating as-a-service to NMKR with a partner API library. Each NMKR campaign will feature a new Functionality menu where on-page utility can be designed without code, for any website.

title: Embracing Cardano DAO in Liberia
problem: Liberia faces a significant knowledge gap regarding DAO and DLT, particularly Cardano, which hinders the country's ability to appreciate the power of blockchain for Social development.
solution: To cultivate a supportive community of DAO, blockchain enthusiasts, learners, and developers in Liberia, fostering knowledge sharing and collaboration through online and offline platforms.

title: Blockchain and Spirituality - Integrating blockchain into the human experience.
problem: Lack of integration between blockchain technology and broader goals and philosophies hinders its constructive impact and adoption.
solution: Offer a series of 6 free workshops that delve into the spiritual significance of blockchain and provide practical guidance on integrating blockchain tech into our daily lives.

title: [MAYZ Protocol] Decentralized Asset Management Infrastructure
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-91f152/jpg)

The lack of smart contracts that allows to create, manage and invest in Cardano Funds in a decentralized, permissionless, and non-custodial way.
solution: We're developing a DeFi solution to offer users expert-curated investment funds for diversified exposure to Cardano native tokens.

title: Platform: CIP-1694 DReps Transparency, Community Governance & Directory Site
problem:
![CIP-1694-Directory-45a4e8.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/CIP-1694-Directory-45a4e8/jpg)

Where to find a complete & transparent directory with **CIP-1694 DReps information**, aligned with community governance & a power database explorer that has thousands of monthly sessions of Cardano users
solution: A power directory with complete & transparent information of CIP-1694 DReps, integrated in CardanoFeed.com, with thousands of monthly sessions, bringing greater governance to the Cardano ADA community

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: MLabs – Enhancing and Evolving the Plutus Simple Model (PSM) Test Library
problem: PSM provides a mock model blockchain for straightforward unit testing. However, it could more closely track the state of the main chain. Refactoring and an extended feature set will accomplish this.
solution: We propose enhancing Plutus testing by advancing PSM's features and refactoring its codebase. This will result in a more effective simulation of the Cardano ledger and its most advanced capabilities.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: React Component Decentralized Wallet
problem: Cardano dApp developers have to rely on third-party wallet extensions or mobile wallet support for their dApp to gain access to the blockchain, or difficult-to-learn serialization libraries or SDKs.
solution: This component has UI/UX and all the logic of a regular wallet for developers to use in their project without wallet extensions or mobile wallets and supports use of local node/indexer infrastructure.

title: Project Catalyst as Main Stage Sponsorship for Rare Evo 2024/25
problem: ~20% of the Cardano holders participates in Project Catalyst governance. Rare Evo wants to bolster those numbers by bringing awareness to those in our community and beyond via a mainstage sponsorship.
solution: Allowing Project Catalyst to assume our Main Stage sponsor, providing clear representation during the event and our live stream to the masses. This will gain mass exposure toward on chain governance.

title: TADAStake - A Distribution Platform
problem: 60% of SPOs have not had a chance to sign a block. It wastes resources and consumes significant amounts of electricity each year. We aim to build a platform to improve their block-signing abilities.
solution: Build an automated platform between pool operators and delegators looking to maximize profits and get potential tokens. Connecting the community of SPOs and token owners to distribute possible tokens

title: Catalyst Explorer 2.5: Accessible Catalyst Data & Tools
problem: The Catalyst Explorer is a massive improvement for proposal discovery & research, but there is more to do. Certain data sets are still missing, & the interface can be improved by a UI/UX professional.
solution: Do for other data what we've done for proposals! Create tools for researching Users, Companies/Groups. Draft Ballots support on the voter tool. Prototype ballot submission directly from the explorer!

title: Catalyst RiSE. An open-access, credit-bearing University module positioning Catalyst as a funding option for Research Academics and Entrepreneurial Undergraduate students.
problem: Funding and grant opportunities for scholarly work seeking to contribute new knowledge by exploring innovative blockchain applications are limited, challenging to access, and poorly documented.
solution: Develop a credited onboarding curriculum that positions Catalyst as a research and development funding source for academic research and development in innovative blockchain work.

title: Developing a Secure, Blockchain-Based Voting System
problem: We aim to solve the issue of lack of transparency and potential security breaches in traditional voting systems, using blockchain technology.
solution: We will create a decentralized voting platform on Cardano's blockchain, ensuring secure, transparent, and efficient electoral processes.

title: Fractionalised Renewable Energy Assets (FREA) - rewarding affordable renewable energy asset holders through a sharing economy.
problem: Current solutions for investing in renewable energy bring significant limitations, including affordability (high min. spend), illiquidity and being contract-bound (e.g. must become utility customer).
solution: Zero Citizen will tokenise and fractionalise renewable energy assets, meaning greater affordability and opens investment to a wider audience. Asset owners will be rewarded for electricity generated.

title: NuNet: Bioinformatics simulations with Decentralized Computing // Enabling cheap and reliable simulations on decentralized hardware for Bioinformatics via frameworks. Bioinformatics is essential for management of data in modern biology and medicine.
problem:
The recent rise in AI and ML has resulted in the lack of affordable and available GPU and CPU computing power on the market for bioinformatics/medical/physics research.

![GPU-market-share-43b68d.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/GPU-market-share-43b68d/jpg)
solution:
NuNet is a decentralized, open source, p2p computing network utilizing latent computing resources of the world and will enable bioinformatics/medical/physics simulations to run via its network.

![NuNet_-Bioinformatics-simulations-with-Decentralized-Computing-BLOG-d31bcd.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/NuNet_-Bioinformatics-simulations-with-Decentralized-Computing-BLOG-d31bcd/png)

title: RatsDAO I Staking Platform Improvement
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-0f9a90/png)

The limited availability of open source staking platforms in the Cardano ecosystem. This restricts users' choices and hinders the growth and decentralization of the network.
solution: We will enhance and open source Rats DAO Staking Smart Contracts to provide more open source staking options in the Cardano ecosystem, addressing the limited availability problem.

title: Koios SPO Tools development (CNTools, gLiveView, topologyUpdater)
problem:
[![Koios Cardano's Decentralized API](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Catalyst_Koios_logo-748351/gif)](https://koios.rest)

title: Blockfrost multi-provider transaction submit plugin
problem: Blockfrost submit servers are processing a big percentage of Cardano transactions, which is not good for decentralization. We need to increase the choice of providers to promote decentralization.
solution: We need to build a multi-provider transaction submit plugin to Blockfrost open source backend and deploy it across the platform.

title: SJG TOOLS V2 - Stake Pool Setup & Operation TUI Tool in Japanese
problem: Setup a stake pool by executing commands requires expertise and is time consuming to install. In addition, mistakes can occur in daily operations.
solution: Create a TUI (Terminal User Interface) to enable Cardano node/CLI installation, dependency automation, pool registration, and daily operations.

title: ⚡Turbo Powered Dubai Cardano Community Social Meet Ups 🔥
problem: There are no meetups for lovers of Cardano in the pro-crypto, work hard, party hard, city of Dubai. All other major cryptos have a regular meetup. Its time for a Cardano meetup worthy of this city!
solution: Unleash an epic Cardano meetup in Dubai - a fun filled regular event to connect Cardano enthusiasts & fill the gap the crypto scene. The meetup will be hosted in clubs and hotels of this great city.

title: Certificates for Custom Jewellery
problem: Owners of Custom Jewellery Pieces benefit from holding digital copies of their creations with an image & 3d model. If part of a collection, see how rare each piece is and trade on the secondary market
solution: Integrate a Cardano NFT minter into the production process. A customer designs the jewellery online, the piece is sent to production, and the customer receives a certificate with a 3d model + metadata

title: Introducing Cardano Laboratory: A Development and Testing Environment for Cardano
problem: There is a need for a pro-development and testing tool for Cardano. The laboratory can create, sign and submit transactions of any combination and parameters of choice. A Swiss Army knife for devs.
solution: A user-friendly web-based laboratory that is a development and testing environment for the Cardano. Generate key pairs, and fund accounts, and perform all possible kinds of transactions on Cardano.

title: CRM Quote-to-Cash: Blockchain Enhancement with Cardano
problem: Existing CRM quote-to-cash systems lack transparency, data integrity, and seamless automation. Our project aims to address these inefficiencies by leveraging the properties of blockchain technology.
solution: We will develop a blockchain-based solution, integrating Salesforce's quote-to-cash process with Cardano, to ensure data integrity, transparency, and automated workflows.

title: Powering Cardano DAOs with AI
problem:
![chatbot-demo-gif-hd-336574.gif](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/chatbot-demo-gif-hd-336574/gif)

DAOs use a myriad of tools, which leads to inefficient access to information and knowledge sharing.
solution: Bonfire enables DAOs to centralize information into an AI-powered knowledge base. It also empowers the creation of customized chatbots, like onboarding or governance assistants, trained on DAOs' data.

title: Impact Measurement of SPOs
problem: A key challenge with projects and funded proposals is tracking project progress with clear impact measurements, especially with complex frameworks like UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
solution: Creating the Impact Measurements Tool & Proof of Impact Platform to help SPOs define KPIs, measure and report them, with a focus on UN SDGs impact.

title: PsychDAO: Psychology DAO for mental health & P2P Learning
problem:
Lack of P2P learning platforms for psychology students and free support systems in the ecosystem.

[Mental health needs are high but responses are insufficient and inadequate.](https://apps.who.int/iris/bitstream/handle/10665/356119/9789240049338-eng.pdf#page=17)
solution: I am building a community, with the vision of becoming a DAO in the [DeSci](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aQC6zn-eXflSmpts0XGE7CawbUEHwnL6o-OFXO52PTc/edit#heading=h.arcrgw3lu7wt) movement, for P2P learning of psychology students and supporting Cardanians seeking psychological support.

title: Secret Book for Travelers to Encounter Life Enriching Wisdom: Co-creating New Signposts to Elevate Quality of Travel Together with Successors of Local Cultures
problem: The world is full of local cultures with wonderful traditions and wisdom. However travelers often only experience commercialized, stereotypical cultures, which is a great loss of opportunity for them.
solution: We are developing a Cardano-powered platform called the "Secret Book" that will allow travelers to discover hidden wisdom that truly enriches their lives beyond what existing guidebooks can offer.

title: Influxe - NFT Hub for Streamers & Influencers on Cardano
problem: Influencers and streamers struggle to connect with global fans, lacking a unified platform to effectively engage, monetize content, and manage fan communities across borders and languages.
solution: Our solution is a user-friendly NFT platform for content creators, streamlining fan engagement, community management, and fostering global connections in the Cardano ecosystem.

title: Socious: Decentralized Escrow and Dispute Resolution
problem: Direct employer-remote developer contracts can lead to disputes and payment issues. However, using centralized escrow services can be expensive, and their decisions may not always be fair. [日本語](https://socious.notion.site/F10-P1-a1a5ac0e30fd474db0dd0d48a928eb52?pvs=4)
solution: A community-managed decentralized system for dispute resolution and escrow services can protect remote developers and hiring organizations with a fair dispute resolution process and lower fees.

title: Ride-hailing (Uber-like) Platform
problem: Despite the widespread use of ridesharing apps, data privacy, security, high fees, and centralized governance remain key issues.
solution: Our solution is a blockchain-based ride-hailing platform on Cardano, ensuring superior privacy, security, and user governance compared to traditional services. It's like Uber but on the blockchain.

title: Catalyst Fund Operations by IOG Catalyst Team
problem: To fully unlock the power of Catalyst, new features, infrastructure and tools are needed to assure funding opportunities and project success by transparent and responsive administration and oversight.
solution: Appoint IOG Catalyst Team to develop and deploy new tools and features to take operation and oversight of Catalyst to new levels and act as administrator and operator of Catalyst for the next 12months

title: Maternal Mortality Crisis - DoulaID: An identity solution bringing caring support for the most at-risk mothers
problem: US Medicaid eligible mothers are 3x more likely to have negative birth outcomes. Doulas are proven to help high-risk birth outcomes. DoulaID guides doulas through the difficult Medicaid registration ![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-2142c5/png)
solution: [DoulaID](https://www.doulaid.com/) is a [RootsID](https://rootsid.com/) app addressing the maternal mortality disparity crisis in Baltimore City. DoulaID has teamed with community doula organizations to enroll culturally congruent doulas with Medicaid

title: Pathform ReFi: Nature, (Plastics) Circular Economy, Wellbeing & Mindset Shifts
problem: Wellbeing and nature are both linked, and there are some efforts to tokenize each separately. The cross-pollination of data between the mind and nature does not yet exist in web3.
solution: The proposed project will build a bridge between Nature 2.0 (ReFi) tokenomics and future 'ecologies of mind', leveraging blockchain & mind-hacking to allow humans to communicate with ecosystems.

title: Eternl - Accessible Cardano knowledge base - F10
problem: Cardano needs to be more accessible and known to the public. We are building a wiki that explains the basics to new users (in special regard to Eternl).
solution: Cardano needs to be more accessible and known to the public. We are building a wiki that explains the basics to new users (in special regard to Eternl).

title: Cardano Node Management Tool
problem: Setting up, running, maintaining, and updating Cardano Nodes is complicated. SPOs would benefit from tools that simplify the running of nodes in a reliable & repeatable manner.
solution: We will Open Source a tool that allows SPOs to define their network & VMs which this tool will then use to build, deploy, configure, & run Cardano Node software in a safe and reliable manner.

title: Journey of Hope: UNHCR NFT Collaboration by TheFairies
problem: Limited sustainable fundraising avenues hinder UNHCR and Cardano. An innovative Fairy NFT Collaboration presents a positive solution, fostering sustainable fundraising and growth.
solution: Initiate a pioneering Fairy Collaboration for NFTs: Develop awareness for UNHCR by fundraising through NFTs, setting a foundation for future campaigns and spreading positive awareness

solution: An information terminal contemplating real-time news, market quotes and videos to maximize your investments with artificial intelligence. Platform will be created to deliver information very quickly.

title: Ekival: Empowering Decentralized Non-Custodial Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Crypto-Fiat Exchange for Financial Inclusion
problem:

No accessibility to decentralized and non-custodial crypto-fiat exchanges hampers financial autonomy on Cardano, hindering seamless cryptocurrency-to-fiat currency exchanges.
solution: Ekival - A global decentralized P2P marketplace for secure, privacy-focused, non-custodial crypto-fiat exchanges, fostering financial autonomy.

title: Empowering Content Creators with Cardano: A Decentralized Platform for Fair Compensation
problem: Content creators struggle with unfair pay systems on centralized platforms. They receive less money than they should, and this makes it hard for them to progress.
solution: We're building a decentralized content creation platform on Cardano's blockchain to ensure fair profit distribution, foster creativity, and enhance transparency for creators.

title: USDM: Fiat-Backed STABLECOIN - by Mehen: Cardano's Premiere Fiat-backed Stablecoin
problem: **Cardano URGENTLY needs a NATIVE FIAT-BACKED STABLECOIN to accelerate its decentralized finance ecosystem, enable payments, and bridge capital into the Cardano DeFi ecosystem.**
solution: **Mehen is actively building USDM - A 1:1 USD licensed fiat-backed stablecoin with oversight, & decentralized reserves verification; prioritizing integrity, transparency, and reinvestment into Cardano.**

title: Callisto - Cardano Mobile SDKs for iOS & Android platforms
problem: Android and iOS developers using Kotlin and Swift don't have the capability to integrate Cardano into their apps. This proposal aims to deliver the necessary libraries for drop-in Cardano support.
solution: Deliver an open-source native iOS SDK written in Swift 5.9 and a native Android SDK, written in Kotlin 2.0 for developers and companies to integrate Cardano into their Apple and Google applications.

title: CineWealth: Innovative Revenue Based Financing - A Real-Fi Platform Built on Cardano
problem:

title: Ride-hailing (Uber-Like) DAO
problem: Current ride-hailing services are highly centralized, leading to excessive fees for drivers and a lack of control for the community. A decentralized alternative is needed.
solution: We will create a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) for ride-hailing on the Cardano blockchain, empowering drivers and reducing fees.

title: COPY & PHYGITAL - Phygital Twin creation between NFTs and animated 3D lenticular badges for the fashion industry.

title: Measuring Funded Proposal Impacts
problem: Catalyst faces challenges in evaluating the outcomes of funded proposals, thus leaving voters without a reliable source of information to determine which are valuable proposals and which teams do Good
solution: Develop an application to aggregate all funded proposals from Fund1 to Fund9 and future, update monthly reports including the results of the implemented proposals and their post-completion impact

title: + Cryptocurrency lawmakers
problem: Currently, legal regulation is the main challenge that cryptocurrencies face. That is why it is necessary to harness the power of our entire community and elect our own legislators
solution: Elect our own legislators within our community. For example, if there are over 50000 Catalyst members in a country like Colombia, we can vote and choose 1 senator to help create favorable regulations

problem: DAOs' governance should include aspects such as ethics, processes and guidelines that need to be documented, but there are no tools for wide scale collaboration in documents creation.
solution: Consenz: Agreements Building Platform will allow DAOs communities to discuss, edit and form consensus around governance documentation (such as a constitution) in an easy, productive and scalable way.

title: Automation and Scaling of current funded Catalyst Developer Mentorship Program using Andamio learning management system and Cardano Blockchain capabilities
problem: Mentorship programs for tech companies are very demanding in terms of human resource and time, limiting access for companies and the scale of programs available.
solution: A blockchain-enabled, project-based learning platform, that enables Dev’s and tech companies to access Edify’s proven, powerful suite of business mentoring tools and frameworks, at scale.

title: Customizable Staking Baskets Platform - Incentivizing Cardano's Decentralization
problem:

Due to the A0 parameter, multi-pool groups have formed offering the same rewards as single SPOs with more pledge. This doesn’t incentivize users to delegate towards decentralization.
solution: The Customizable Baskets Platform allows any user to easily create their own Staking Basket with unique pool compositions and their own Cardano Native Token reward incentive.

title: Cardano-Mendix plugin by the Landano team

title: Enhancing Cardano Adoption Through Targeted Industry Conferences and Speaking Engagements
problem: Insufficient representation of Cardano at different industry conferences, specifically in the Family Office, investment, and government sectors.

problem: [Hyperledger Aries](https://www.hyperledger.org/use/aries) and [CL Anoncreds](https://www.hyperledger.org/use/anoncreds) are one of the most mature and adapted solutions for SSI. title: The path to minting more blocks in Africa, For a more resilient Cardano protocol.

solution: Integrate blockchain and gamification to enhance credibility and technology adoption in the chocolate industry

problem: Complex and multi-step process for converting Ethereum to Cardano inhibits user adoption, creating a barrier for individuals seeking to transition between the two blockchain ecosystems.

title: Decentralized (Index) Funds: Native Assets on Cardano
problem: Cardano's growing ecosystem attracts numerous projects. A challenge for investors! Researches and DEX fees increase
solution: A Decentralized (Index) Fund approach can save investors money and time by minimzing research time and fees. Funds simplify the process of investing in the promising Native Asset market.

title: Optim Finance Vaults / Tranche Structures - DeFi Building Blocks for Cardano.
problem:
![Optim-Vaults-0580db.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Optim-Vaults-0580db/png)

**Cardano DeFi needs tranche structures, a pillar of modern finance.**

RealFi & DeFi won't scale without the ability to pool return generating assets and structure risks & returns for participants.
solution: Optim Vaults provide an on-chain tranche structure that enable users to deposit assets & structure junior and senior tranches -- deposit/withdraw windows, collateral, risk & return for tranches, etc.

title: Cyber Awareness Course
problem: Clear and structured role-based Cyber Awareness Training for the community is not readily available for our teams or community members.
solution: We are going to create two publicly available training courses (video modules): General "Web2" Training and General Blockchain ("Web3") Training.

title: BLOCKTRUST Identity Wallet (PRISM) v1.0 for Browser, with Shared Features
problem: Trust on decentralized systems requires verifiable credentials. A generally available identity wallet for Cardano doesn't yet exist, and even if one did, a healthy ecosystem requires options.
solution: The *Blocktrust Identity Wallet* for desktop browsers is being developed, and it will help dApps and enterprise projects accelerate, since it helps build trust through verifiable credentials.

title: Facilitated disscussions for increasing Cardano's economy
problem: Catalyst open campaign seeks to grow Cardano Economy and inform future funding by exploring the gaps. This proposal will achieve it through partnership with recently approved innovative EU project.
solution: We will use online interactive discussions. Besides, we will create audiovisual content on our website to inform learners. Online discussions are open-source to reach a more diverse group of learners.

title: A study on Network Nations
problem: Blockchains capacity at creating real distributed nations is omnipresent in the collective mind, but not truly addressed yet. We need also to explore new forms of relationships with states.
solution: A community study on network nation's potential.The production of a dedicated paper and research corpus on the subject.

title: NFT Guild Shorts: Condensed Insights and Essential Learnings
problem: The comprehensive nature of our NFT Guild Roundtables can be overwhelming and restricts community access to valuable insights.
solution: We will produce 'The NFT Guild Shorts', concise, digestible videos extracting key insights from our hour-long NFT Roundtable technical sessions, facilitating quicker knowledge access.

title: Sundae Labs Automated Price Discovery
problem: DAOs launching tokens face high early volatility due to limited price discovery tools, often resorting to centralized pricing methods.
solution: We propose a Cardano-based decentralized platform for automated price discovery, enabling DAOs to conduct token sales with less volatility and improved liquidity.

title: Cardano Zen: Creative Mindful Gatherings for Creators where we express soulfully, onboard on Cardano and practice mindfulness
problem: **Lack of offline inclusive creative events that contribute to the creative connection and well-being of the Cardano community and for creatives who are interested in onboarding Cardano.**
solution: **We will organise 2-day mindful gatherings 3 times over 6 months to help the creators delve deeper into discovering their creativity, themselves, the community of Cardano, NFTs and the blockchain.**

title: Better Cardano Blockchain Insights
problem: There is a need in our ecosystem for a project that offers clear data about the Cardano's blockchain health and growth, benefiting a wide array of people, from investors to dApp developers.
solution: A tool to help users understand the blockchain by exposing its network effects, feeding investor analysis, and serving educational content.

title: Facilitating SPO Travel & Media Production at High Value Blockchain Events Worldwide
problem: This day in age, travel & lodging costs are at an all time high, making it impractical for key stake holders, specifically SPOs, to participate in high value blockchain events worldwide to see an ROI.
solution: We will facilitate the itinerary, travel, lodging, food/beverage per diem, & media production, for 2 SPOs per trip to join our team & offer high value networking opportunities via 5 trips per year.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Cardano's Headless Community Events Hub
problem:
![sirwolcott_a_headless_distributed_software_application_ca467cc8-1e10-4340-b26f-1635f11b72c1-d6f4c2.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/sirwolcott_a_headless_distributed_software_application_ca467cc8-1e10-4340-b26f-1635f11b72c1-d6f4c2/png)

We have a NOISE PROBLEM. An individual Cardano Community member will NOT see all ecosystem's virtual and in-person Events. It is near impossible to manage notifications from Everywhere.
solution: A distributed event aggregator using git to collect & syndicate events. Cardano Community Events Hub lets anyone display their events, filter or subscribe to calendars with significantly reduced noise

title: dRep Community Governance and Explorer
problem: Existing tools lack the capability to empower dReps in making informed and representative decisions on behalf of their delegators.
solution: Create a dashboard providing dRep profiles, voting history, and interactive polling capabilities, empowering the Cardano community to research and delegate their votes based on transparent information

title: Zero Knowledge Proof Of Competence
problem: Lack of trust in the gig/hiring industry forces employers to demand samples and other proofs of competence before giving jobs. Unfortunately, bad actors capitalize on this to exploit and discriminate
solution: We are building a zero-knowledge proof of competence platform where employers can validate the competence level of their potential employees without resorting to any exploitative/discriminating avenue

title: Cosmex– Level 2 ⚡-speed Cardano Native Assets Order Book Exchange
problem: COSMEX combines ⚡-speed of centralized order book exchanges and ownership guarantees of decentralized protocols. No slippage fees, fast off-chain trading, L1 settlement, provable solvency.
solution:
COSMEX uses multiple star-shaped two-party Hydra-like state channels.

You trade off-chain on an order book exchange, then settle on-chain. You can always withdraw. Can't lock your funds.

title: Cardano blockchain course for hispanic speakers
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-fd8624/png)

There are scarce amount of educational resources accessible about Cardano Blockchain in Spanish.
solution: To develop a user-friendly learning course with interactive tutorials, simulations, and tutoring opportunities.

title: Witzil: using the Cardano Blockchain to bring decentralized, collaborative change to Mexican urban enviroments
problem: Mexico suffers from a **disparity in focus** between the care of public and private areas. This is due to corruption and **misuse of funds**. Witzil will tackle **the issue of public development** through Cardano
solution: Witzil has gathered a group of **conscientious professionals** with expertise in architecture, design, biology, geography and blockchain tech to team up and **change the way we see and develop** public spaces

title: Cardano PhD Lab: Pioneering Blockchain Research for the Future
problem:
![cardano-lab-c767f3.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/cardano-lab-c767f3/png)

The Cardano ecosystem lacks a dedicated research platform for PhD students, limiting innovation and the progression of blockchain-based solutions.
solution: We will establish the "Cardano PhD Lab", a dedicated research platform empowering PhD students to drive innovation within the Cardano blockchain ecosystem.

title: Showcase The Cardano Ecosystem and promote Cardano Summit 2023 at Blockchain Expo Dubai 2023
problem: The Cardano ecosystems vibrancy, depth and quality is not being discovered or acknowledged by the larger crypto community and would be investors.
solution: To promote the ecosystems depth and quality at a cross chain event attended by the larger crypto Community and investors.

title: CRM Sidechain: Empowering Decentralized Business Transactions on Cardano
problem:
![CRM-sidechain-b1983a.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/CRM-sidechain-b1983a/png)

Addressing the lack of GDPR-compliant, scalable business transaction platforms on blockchain with use-case-specific sidechains on Cardano.
solution: We'll create a CRM sidechain on Cardano, offering GDPR-compliant, decentralized transactions with Salesforce integration, fostering business web3 adoption.

title: Engaging The French Students in a Blockchain Kowledge-Based Competition to Facilitate Their Insersion Into the Ecosystem
problem: There are many Blockchain and crypto enthousiasts amongst the students in Burkina Faso but they lack confidence to interact in the Cardano community due to language barrier.
solution: The project consist of a three-round blockchain knowledge-based competition that will get the French speaking students in Burkina Faso engaged and facilitate their insertion in the Cardano community.

title: appy.market Local Shopping – Crypto powered local marketplace to collectively leave fiat behind
problem:
Local brick-and-mortar businesses are vital for local commerce, but they are losing while e-commerce thrives. **We combine local with e-commerce through a map-based shopping platform on appy.market**.

![on appy.market you shop on the map](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Shop-Billa-on-Map-aa8aac/jpg) ![A university could sell courses and used hardware locally, for example](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Shop-FH-on-Map-d2271f/jpg)

![A shop with offers and events](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Bildschirmfoto-2023-07-13-um-11.08.37-AM-2cdbca/png)
solution:
appy.market revitalizes local communities with a map-based shopping platform. **Guide Admins connect businesses to online shoppers, facilitating local product & service sales**. Cardano brings secure tx.

![Shop Admin View](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/SA_View-313661/png)

title: Birth Chart NFTs on Cardano
problem: Astrology is widely popular and millions are paid each year for astrology consultations. There are no blockchain solutions that profit from this market.
solution: A portal to book astrology consultations to give birth chart readings. Birth charts will be converted to an NFT and will be given to the customer.

title: MLabs – Streamlining Cardano Deployment with Enhanced NixOS Modules
problem: Cardano Nix services often lack accessible upstream NixOS modules, complicating use. Nix simplifies complex installs, but this killer feature isn't fully used on Cardano.
solution: We propose creating new NixOS modules where none exist, and a repository for “super modules” (using pinned versions) that will import them thereby simplifying complex interactions.

title: iRate barbers (Booking & payment system for mobile services) DAO
problem:
**![8E865ACC-E2E2-4C4A-9383-DD9A7AC4F86A-e6577d.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/8E865ACC-E2E2-4C4A-9383-DD9A7AC4F86A-e6577d/png)**

**Due to centralized shops and booking platforms, barbers who make up the industry lose on average 50% of the income they generate to shop commissions, and receive no incentive from booking platforms.**
solution: To build a decentralized booking platform for mobile barbers, so barbers can avoid shop fees and keep 90% of the income they generate. With a reward system for barbers and customers to earn tokens.

title: Decentralising Market Making Tools
problem: There is no many market making tools in Cardano for retailers, hindering their competitiveness against centralized market manipulators and limiting liquidity provision in decentralized exchanges.
solution: Our algorithm-based system tracks high-frequency bots on centralized exchanges, providing liquidity zone graphs for $ADA. Retailers can make informed decisions when providing liquidity on DExs.

title: Open sourced Farm land verification, evaluation, tokenization - fractional NFT framework to support transitioning to regenerative agriculture
problem: Many farmers transitioning to regenerative agriculture in India face limited access to finance and markets and often do not get a fair price for the products they sell.
solution: We propose to build a smart contract governed platform that enables smallholder farmers and landowners to have access to finance and information for transitioning to regenerative agriculture.

title: Cardano Mempool Explorer
problem: How fair is Cardano blockchain? Are there attacks like front running, censorship happening? The answer lies on the mempool analytics which is neither transparent nor accessible to normal people.
solution:
Mempool explorer is a visual explorer designed specifically for mempool analytics. Mempool analytics uncovers the evidence on fairness, censorship and other attacks happening on Cardano.

![Cardano mempool explorer](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-13-at-09.33.35-b78286/png)

title: Empowering Student Entrepreneurship through Cardano-focused Innovation Pitch Program at Mizzou
problem: Limited access for college students to education, resources, and funding for launching Cardano-based businesses.
solution: We will establish a pitch program at University of Missouri offering education, mentorship, and funding to empower students to build scalable businesses integrated to Cardano.

title: [Vcoincheck.io – Scaling community milestone] - Scale-up ten of thousands vietnam Cardano community and sharing all of our knowledge to official Cardano sources.
problem:
- Most Cardano community development projects stop working after a period of time
- New community-building projects are increasing but not yet effective
- Well-run projects need extra support to keep growing
solution:
• We want to continue to maintain current platform operations.

• Continue to develop the Cardano community in Vietnam.

• Train and support the community to build teams like us.

title: "Exploring Multilingual Engagement Frameworks in Decentralized Blockchain Communities: A Case Study of the Cardano Catalyst Community"
problem: The catalyst community like most large decentralized communities is often challenged with language barriers for participants in the community, thus hindering inclusion and effective participation.
solution: Researching and developing multilingual engagement frameworks for decentralized blockchain communities, with a case study on the Cardano Catalyst community, to enable inclusive participation for all.

title: All currencies exchange
problem: Please start an exchange for all investors and provide all currencies to exchange at low rate
solution: it is a big door to allow the investors to follow this project and invest a maximum amount with safety

title: Tor hidden service for Blockfrost
problem: To enhance privacy and security, we aim to create a Tor hidden service endpoint for Blockfrost, an API service for Cardano, enabling users to access it anonymously from anywhere.
solution: We'll set up a Tor hidden service that routes requests to Blockfrost's API, acting as a privacy-respecting bridge. This allows anonymous, secure access to Cardano services.

title: Industrialists As ADA Holders in GHANA
problem: Small Scale Industrialists in Ghana are NOT aware of Cardano and ADA; they are NOT aware that they can keep ADA as savings; saving in the normal banks is not encouraging due to low interest rates.
solution: My project is geared towards making these Industrialists aware that they can keep ADA as their savings towards future investments; Yoroi wallets will be opened for them and educate them on Cardano.

title: Cardano Native Script editor and Multisig-wallet
problem: People are not taking advantage of Cardano's Cardano native scripts. Setting up a multi-sig wallet for security, or as a common treasury are simple use cases outside the reach of most users.
solution: Extend the transaction editor with collaborative transactions to also cooperatively create native scripts, providing a simple and always available service for users.

title: rewrite it in zig - cardano-ledger
problem: Onboarding new developers is easier when they have tools they can use in their favorite language.
solution: We propose the realization of such tools in the modern language of [Zig](https://ziglang.org/) ([interoperable with C/C++ codebases](https://ziglearn.org/chapter-4/)), which will serve as a base for performance-focused applications.

title: Merits of a Proposed Idea for Cardano
problem: Digital communities such as DAOs traditionally rely on often chaotic human mediation and dispute resolution, opening all processes to problems such as cognitive biases and basic misunderstanding.
solution: Promotes automated conflict resolution and informed decision-making in communities like Cardano, and facilitates AI alignment through structured, tagged discussions.

title: Minswap Aiken V2 Audit
problem: Minswap Labs is to release an open-source Version 2 of the DEX Smart Contracts with new features and throughput improvements. To ensure the highest security, two security audits are needed.
solution: Minswap Labs is to release an open source V2 of the DEX AMM. Funding is required to contract two different firms to rigorously test and verify the security of the Smart Contracts before deployment.

title: Surf Watch - Surf to Earn + Loyalty Service
problem: Limited Cardano adoption in web-2 established apps due to lack of awareness and accessibility, hindering growth & integration. Integration of Cardano is not commercially viable for apps and devs.
solution: Utilise an established app and user base (Surf Watch) to build and roll out a gamified loyalty system powered by Cardano and Cardano NFTs, and white label the solution for other app developers.
