campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Empowering Individuals: A Decentralized Data Governance Marketplace for Personal Data Ownership and Control on Cardano Blockchain
problem:
Lack of ownership, control, and fair compensation for personal data in the centralized data landscape.

Decentralized data governance marketplace empowers individuals, ensures transparency,promotes
solution: Our solution is a decentralized data governance marketplace on Cardano that empowers individuals with ownership, control, and fair compensation for their personal data.

title: [MeetProposer] - Let CRs And Experts Approach The Proposers To Deep More Understand The Project They Will Assess
problem: CRs and experts do not have enough information about the projects that they will assess, based on the info on submitted proposals. So the Assessments are not c accurately.
solution: Host a series of Meets where the proposers present their ideas in detail that they will submit in the next fund, so that CRs and experts have time to think about the project before making assessments.

title: Low Molecular Weight Inhibitors (procyanidins and polyphenols) as sustainable nutraceutics for blood glucose regulation in diabetes mellitus and metabolic syndrome, powered by Cardano and Catalyst
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-8b420d/png)

Diabetes and metabolic syndrome are common diseases, together affecting more than 1,5 BILLION people worldwide (IDF, 2022) and drastically affecting their quality of life and well-being.
solution: We will create natural food supplements based on extracts high in Low Molecular Weight Inhibitors (LMWI) to safely lower blood glucose levels in diabetes and metabolic syndrome patients.

title: Sustainable Goals Token Research into Proof of Impact Token Integration
problem: There isn't a Cardano based user-friendly, transparent way to impact invest towards impact driven businesses and organisations, and track/verify their impact.
solution: Developing off our SGT whitepaper, we plan to develop a token for impact investing, measurement, verification and education. Connecting you to projects by tracking, and evaluating their impact

title: MITHR PoP - Rewarding Planet Care for LATAM & our Planet
problem: Get trustworthy, honest, and immutable proof of participation (PoP). Help with deforestation, wildfires, unsustainable energy, water depletion, undervalued resources, and cryptocurrency adoption.
solution: Blockchain platform:environmental education,giving rewards in Tokens & NFTs 4 sustainable actions & reforestation,redeem 4 eco-friendly products,support environmental projects & Proof of Participation

title: Cardano NFT Integration in Fighting Card Game, Uppercut
problem: Cardano and Web3 face the challenge of limited gaming integration, depriving users of *high-quality*, immersive gaming experiences and hindering the growth of decentralized gaming ecosystems.
solution: GENUN solves the limited Cardano adoption in gaming with Uppercut integration, accelerating adoption and expanding the boundaries of gaming into WEB3 and bringing AAA experience.

title: MAV100: Using Cornucopias "Custom Dome" NFTs to build metaverse “Alliance Campuses” for student education and enrichment. Building more powerful alternative learning platforms to help add resiliency to the education system during disruptive events.
problem: In the last 3 years the education system suffered an event that set many students back years in their education. We need a robust environment where instruction can be accessed unhindered by students.
solution: Cornucopias custom domes provide a safe, secure, and engaging medium for students to learn about Cardano. They also provide exciting ways to develop a community that can lead us into decentralization.

title: PRISM MARKETING BLITZ - MARKETING CAMPAIGN FOR ATALA PRISM
problem:
![jg-2448f6.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/jg-2448f6/png)

Many Cardano users are unaware of Atala Prism, how to use the product. There is not enough Marketing, Lets fix it with a marketing blitz.
solution: The proposed solution will include a full marketing blitz to promote understanding and opertunities of the Atala Prism program. Complete PRISM course, governance workshops and then develop a pilot.

title: Treasure Chain
problem:
![Treasure Chain user interface](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-04-17-121304-6650e0/jpg)

A simple game engine for users to turn their creations into an NFT game. A platform for creators and collectors to build worlds together.
solution:
![TC_Neural_Net_1-179380.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/TC_Neural_Net_1-179380/png)

Treasure Chain is an art network where users can assign rules about how their NFTs can interact with each other. With these rule templates the NFTs can act like a giant neural network of art.

title: Supporting OpenLitterMap Events
problem: We have emerging partners, but no resources to help them facilitate workshops, cleanups, and community events.
solution: We need resources to help our partners showcase the real-world potential of our technology and make contributes to its future direction

title: Anastasia Labs - Open Source Production Grade DApps
problem: We lack available open source smart contracts, hindering dApp development, innovation, and ecosystem growth. Teams must build from scratch, duplicating work already done by closed source projects.
solution: We will provide and maintain a set of generic open-source production ready DApps that users can either build upon, or use as reference material to learn best practices and design patterns.

title: OneWeekSprints.com - UX/UI design classes for a Decentralised Supermarket (dSuper) - Working towards an ADA in the city economy.
problem:
![dsuper-aa7b38.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/dsuper-aa7b38/png)

Cardano misses a unified UX design method, a standardised experience mapping approach, and a standardised user-friendly interface approach, blocking an ADA in the city economy.
solution: Give the educational UX/UI Design Live Classes that guide groups in creating Experience & Story Maps, resulting in a new Web3 conversation design method, working towards an ADA in the city economy.

title: VAULT3 plugin for NMKR Studio to enhance RealFi utility for Cardano native assets.
problem: The NMKR ecosystem is missing a token-gating service. Creators need an easy and accessible solution that is directly integrated with NMKR to offer RealFi utility to their communities using NFTs.
solution: We will build an NMKR Studio plugin to integrate VAULT3, so that creators can easily share exclusive data with their communities using their minted NFTs as keys.

title: Cardano Techmarket Care –– an Eco-Friendly E-waste management
problem: The rising level of e-waste poses environmental risk in Africa due to the lack of licensed e-waste collectors and repair services leading to indiscriminate dumping of these devices, causing pollution.
solution: Develop a dapp marketplace that connects ewaste collectors, repair experts, and device users.This will ensure easy repairs, and eco-friendly disposal, curbing e-waste while benefiting the community.

title: Enable apps and games built in the Cardano ecosystem to leverage ZK cryptography for privacy and scalability
problem: Many apps like DIDs, require private data for compliance reasons, and they are also useful for gaming where fog-of-war is important. However, there is no good way to use zk in the Cardano ecosystem
solution: We will release a system to allow using zk proofs inside apps and games in the Cardano ecosystem by leveraging Paima Engine and Zeko

title: Onboarding App, introducing investors/artists to the Cardano Ecosystem
problem: There is a knowledge barrier to entry on Cardano. Initial interaction as an investor or creator can be daunting. This App can help educate and provide a step by step onboarding journey for anyone.
solution: A Mobile web app which is live for use. This provides a user friendly onboarding journey starting with intro to ADA, wallets, staking and then a view of market places, projects and key communities.

title: GateKeeper: Reports, Multi-Event Support, & UX/UI Refinement
problem: GateKeeper is a ticketing admission system built on the Cardano blockchain, which does not currently have reporting or multi-event support.
solution: Update GateKeeper with an improved reporting system and a multi-event support while improving the overall UX/UI experience.

title: Bottlenoses.io | A participative and evolutive NFT collection that mixes generative art, experiences, education and social impact through dynamic NFTs (CIP 68)
problem: How can Cardano appeal to a larger non-crypto audience? Through money over IP, better UX/UI and financial rewards -certainly, but also through education, emotionally rewarding benefits and experiences
solution: Our project will reach out to all, but mostly to the under-explored crypto audience in and outside of Cardano (i.e. women, seniors, all age segments, global) and the non-crypto audience (incl. kids).

title: Atrium Profile Minting & Customizing - User Account NFT
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-429c77/png)

With the development of Stoa, an updateable user profile contract, there currently isnt an easy way for non-technical user to engage with the contract, create profiles and update their information.
solution: We are building a front end for users to mint and update a user profile using the Stoa contract Users can customize the NFTs datums such as display name, bio, social accounts, friends, and more.

title: E2E Encrypted and Decentralized Web Market for Real-life Product Listings
problem: I want to address the issue of online goods selling, which constantly involves reliance on third parties, is subject to ever-changing terms of service, lacks transparency, and incurs increasing fees.
solution: I will develop a self-contained locally-run dApp for browsing and interacting with Cardano-hosted stores, with all communications E2E encrypted. Promoting decentralization and privacy in e-commerce.

title: MITHR Crowd DAO - Open your ideas to the world!
problem: We coordinate code collection,version control & evaluation of challenge submissions on the blockchain, radically accelerating the time to transform prototypes into real products with DAO Crowdfounding
solution: Platform to streamline workflow, internally/externally through challenges.Assist organizations, companies, universities, government agencies, or NGOs in developing, managing, and promoting challenges.

title: Powering onchain game functionality using Cardano stakepools
problem: Currently onchain games do not have as many users indexing or operating compared to DeFi use-cases. We want to enable stake pools to run gaming infrastructure to boost decentralization
solution: Paima Engine is the largest framework for creating onchain games and autonomous worlds in Cardano, and we will make it aware of pools and delegations so that pools can run gaming infrastructure

title: DRep Gov Jury Duty
problem: managing and overseeing development is a complex and difficult task. As domain experts Dreps are perfectly positioned to collaborate in managing funds release similar to catalyst, but for 1694
solution: Dreps should have a role in overseeing reporting development of funded proposals (CIP1694), this will be assigned randomly to avoid bribery and coercion as best as possible

title: Landano: Decentralized Land Administration with Identity Management using Atala Prism
problem: Address the challenge of integrating identity management in a decentralized land administration system on the Cardano blockchain, bridging technology and stakeholder engagement.
solution: Develop a proof of concept for a blockchain-based land administration system, with an integrated identity management solution, fostering stakeholder coordination and tech interoperability.

title: Oracle for Agriculture: Integrating Satellite Imagery with Cardano
problem:
![Screenshot-2023-07-16-at-15.47.17-c2bde4.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-16-at-15.47.17-c2bde4/png)

Satellite imagery is used in agriculture for many decision making processes (eg: yield forecasts). RealFi protocols in Cardano are getting attention. Connecting the two is untapped potential.
solution: Build an Oracle that provides quantitative agricultural analysis over geographic locations from satellite imagery, to serve as potential input for RealFi protocols (eg: prediction markets, lending)

title: Launching Atala PRISM: A Billion-User Blueprint -> Land-Backed Credit Communities
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-file-url?url=aHR0cHM6Ly9tZWRpYS5saWNkbi5jb20vZG1zL2ltYWdlL0Q1NjIyQVFHMmhlRU5oTjl6b1EvZmVlZHNoYXJlLXNocmlua184MDAvMC8xNjg5MDEwNTA4MjE2P2U9MTY5MjIzMDQwMCZ2PWJldGEmdD15N21JVF9XeVNZRzJjMzc5Wmw4Ulg5WXA4VDdKY01qSmpzUlN3SWI5OU13)

solution: [Our solution](https://www.commonlands.org/common-hour/commonlands-app-reveal) links social-bonds & collective land arrangements to create foundational economic identities & immutable land registries, giving communities & investors ways to create impact together.

title: Cardano Ghana Community.
problem:
The Cardano community in Ghana is increasing growing since 2021. However, there is no local community to house these members making access to information difficult for most of the community members.

![IMG_1355-4ee3e2.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/IMG_1355-4ee3e2/jpg)
solution: To create an online community for Cardano innovators and newbies in Ghana to drive Cardano adoption and community growth, via; Content creation, translation, Cardano meetups and Community management.

title: Cardano Smart Contracts with Helios (2nd Edition)
problem: Helios is a developer-friendly way of writing both on-chain and off-chain plutus smart contracts. The first edition of Cardano Smart Contracts with Helios is out of date and needs to be updated.
solution: Create and release a 2nd edition book with revised examples and use the latest version and features of Helios. Also, rewrite any previous backend examples using cardano-cli with Node.js.

title: rewrite it in Zig - ouroboros mini protocols
problem: Onboarding new developers is easier when they have tools they can use in their favorite language.
solution: We propose the realization of such tools in the modern language of [Zig](https://ziglang.org/) ([interoperable with C/C++ codebases](https://ziglearn.org/chapter-4/)), which will serve as a base for performance-focused applications.

title: dSAFARI - Zambia - Decentralized Tourism by local communities and artists who know the places you want to visit!
problem: Accessing tourism markets is difficult for local communities who live near places of interest and many tourists yearn for a local perspective on the places that they visit.
solution: dSAFARI aims to create local tourism networks for communities, artists, and creators to showcase their cities, communities, national parks and artwork to international and local tourists.

title: Cardano Animated Series: Can we grow the value of Cardano's ecosystem by growing the value of its homegrown intellectual property (IP)?
problem:
![AniMints_Cardano-Animated-Series-Poster-d4ac15.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/AniMints_Cardano-Animated-Series-Poster-d4ac15/jpg)

**Hello all!** Cardano has a lot of **unlocked potential** **in the characters developed** through it over the years. What if we could **harness this IP in Rick and Morty style content** to **grow the "ADA economy"**?
solution: We will create Cardano's first animated series using the characters within the ecosystem, to explore if something bigger could become of its homegrown IP that would positively impact the ADA economy.

title: [C2VN]: Cardano Blockchain training center for non-native English communities developers
problem: Eastern Hemisphere countries and Vietnamese in particular, there are close to zero **Cardano blockchain centers** where interested developers could quickly emerge into the ecosystem.
solution:
![Blockchain-center-f9657a.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Blockchain-center-f9657a/png)

We are forming a **Cardano blockchain blended learning cente**r, starting in Vietnamese, then used as a prototype for non-English communities to adopt all courses and translate into their own languages.

title: Verified Creator Portfolio (VCP)
problem: Lack of mechanisms for students and creators to authenticate their portfolios, leading to challenges in proving ownership for potential buyers and employers.
solution: Build and launch Verified Portfolio, a platform that allows students and creators to prove the authenticity of their work, aiding employers and buyers in making informed decisions.

title: Scarab - a cardano-node client implementation in functional Scala
problem: As a network aiming for complete decentralization, a single node client developed by one entity is limiting. Diversity in node choice improves the robustness of the network for all participants.
solution: This proposal is to fund development of a cardano-node client in functional Scala (a JVM language) in order to address client and platform diversity of Cardano while maintaining the rigor of Haskell.

title: Creating the world's first decentralised digital field boundary identity for smallholder farmers in Kenya and Tanzania (Oracle) using super-high resolution Satellite data at 1 meter resolution.
problem: Current problem is outdated & inaccurate agricultural field boundaries which are created by manual digitisation and managed centrally by national governments.
solution: Automatic detection of field boundaries, planted area and long-term yield using super-high resolution SatEO across all of Tanzania and Kenya's crop land area (72 million ha's) to smallholder farmers.

title: Catalyst School : Chapter Indonesia in collab with Gadjah Mada University (UGM)
problem:
**Indonesian university students** are hesitant to submit proposals due to lack of Catalyst exposure, language barrier and <u>daunting prospect of being scrutinized by a global community</u>.

[![Gadjah Mada University official logo. Top 3 university in Indonesia and top 50 in Asia.](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Lambang-UGM-87f98f/png)](https://www.instagram.com/ugm.yogyakarta/?hl=en)
solution:
- Translate Catalyst developments
- Integrate **Catalyst Incubator** into Catalyst School
- Integrate Catalyst School as a UGM extracurricular
- Educate UGM students via workshops
- Provide QnA forums for UGM students

Awareness the philosophy and technology of OSD, benefits and opportunities, which integrate the Cardano Blockchain platform and ADA.

title: 45B - Pragmatik Extracts - Open-source community built Solution to get Accounting Extracts from Cardano for free
problem:
![45B-Pragmatik-Extracts-2-881607.jpeg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/45B-Pragmatik-Extracts-2-881607/jpeg)

Communities and SMBs on Cardano shouldn't have to pay hefty prices for accounting extracts. There is no standard and free community built tool for this, integrating with common accounting software.
solution: We'll start an open-source community around a solution to export Cardano transactions in a format to be imported into standard bookkeeping software, facilitating your bookkeeping and asset management.

title: Quidli - Rewards Discord App for the Cardano Catalyst Community
problem:
Web3 orgs faced challenges regarding their community growth and retention such AS:

- Lack of community engagement.
- Lack of community loyalty.
- Low community growth and acquisition.
solution: Our mission is to offer a composable and user-friendly tool for organizations to use, share and access crypto/web3 as micro-rewards with little-to-no friction.

title: Automating royalty payments to student athletes with NFT's.
problem: The disproportionate number of opportunities available for NCAA student athletes to earn from their Name, Image, and Likeness.
solution:
**Digital NFT sports cards**

- wide accessibility for student athletes.
- large preexisting demand for product.
- automated royalty payment at point of sale.
- dynamic NFT's track real world performance.

title: Online Makerspace
problem: There are no platform that helps Maker's and their DIY projects around incentivizing ideas, or info back to the industry on what products have been used for after they are sold.
solution: We develop an online rapid prototyping platform that will incentivize the Makers and provide a red thread back to the industry, where Users are able to turn their ideas into a Blueprint NFT.

title: Project Catalyst Learning management system for skill-acquisition and contribution tracking.
problem: There is a significant issue with Catalyst around skills and members' contribution, such as proposal reviewers. Still, it could also be for other tasks, i.e., Dreps or milestone support.
solution: A Blockchain-based learning management system with skill and contribution capabilities to acquire skills and contribute to the Catalyst process.

title: On Demand Crypto Dictionary For Busy People
Infinity Wallet & Web3 Browser - A one-stop ecosystem for all a users crypto, payment, DeFi, NFT and Web3 needs!
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-db4d89/png)

We seek to solve the user difficulties related to onboarding and usage of self-custodial crypto, DeFi and Web3.
solution: An all-in-one self-custodial super-app and first of its kind Web3 Browser, with a strong focus on providing a one-stop streamlined user experience to enable use by all types of users.

title: Evaluating Democratic Pluralism Security via Catalyst Testnet
problem: Catalyst has no means to improve the decentralized security of its decision-making process. A lack of flexibility prevents plural to democratic voting. Sybil resistance is the bottleneck requirement.
solution: Complete Catalyst testnet experiments evaluating the security of a range of voting methods from corporate, pluralism, and democracy. Communicate results with scientific presentations and publications.

title: Nucast: Live-streaming Protocol Revolutionizes The Streaming Space
problem:
The current live streaming landscape (Twitch, Youtube, etc.) is hindered by centralized intermediaries, which restrict creators from directly monetizing their content and engaging with their audience

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-6230e7/png)
solution: Build a live streaming protocol that empowers streamers to monetize their content and connect with their audiences directly through crypto-based tipped chats powered by smart contracts.

title: Extend NFT sale & drop tools to support dropping more complex assets as required for onchain games
problem: Currently NFT tools to sell and drop NFTs work well for single-NFT use-cases. However, onchain games require more than just a single NFT - they often contain multiple assets including fungible tokens
solution: We'll create a way to encode more complicated state like Kickstarter rewards into a single stateful NFT that tracks the user's cumulative backed amount that can be redeemed when the game is released

title: Cardano Community Meetup Series
problem: Limited opportunities for Cardano community members to connect and engage in person.
solution: Organize a series of local Cardano community meetups to facilitate networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration among Cardano enthusiasts.

title: Sequential Squares - Open Source Decentralized Music Publishing Tools Built for ADAO
problem:

Music NFT Publishing Platforms are often overcomplicated and not very user-friendly. Musicians need more autonomy over their releases, not more complex agreements with digital middle-men.
solution: Sequential Squares will automate the process of publishing music NFTs with a range of useful features like royalty distribution rights models, fan perks, project stems, event access, and more.

title: Impact Web3 - The Ecosystem where Impact Measurement, Investing, and Verification collide and empower positive change through the Cardano Blockchain
problem: The Cardano community is lacking a one stop shop web3 grassroots led, research informed and education platform connecting the dots between Cardano, sustainability and the wider web3 impact ecosystem.
solution: Develop the Impact Web3 structure with resources, media, and bridges that facilitate onboarding of newcomers to web3, veterans and enthusiasts of Cardano and the wider blockchain4good ecosystem.

title: Onboarding Education Platform
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-764915/png)

It’s not easy to learn about Cardano as a beginner. It requires multiple websites, resources and tutorials to guide you through often jargon filled processes.
solution: Our onboarding educational platform sits at the heart of every tile on our interface. Simple motion graphics will explain core Cardano elements to users, making onboarding a smooth process.

title: Breaking Language Barriers: A Proposal for Expanding Global Accessibility through Comprehensive Language Support
problem:
Language barriers hinder global accessibility and onboarding of global citizens into the Cardano ecosystem.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-e3ec7c/png)![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-93fd7c/png)

Increasing accessibility through three key methodologies.

1. Translated onboarding documentation.
2. Onboarding YouTube videos with subtitles.

title: [C2VN]: Marlowe- Everyone can code smart contract
problem:
We aim to provide an easy entry for everyone who wants to write smart contracts without technical expertise. Yet there is a scarcity of motivating educational content for Marlowe.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-4f4ecf/png)
solution: Launching a learning platform where there are introductory lessons, instructional videos, exercises, workshop and live-coding sessions to empower non-coders to use Marlowe in local languages.

title: SPO Online Business Academy
problem: SPOs are critical to the successful growth of the Cardano project, but they often lack the business skills and processes necessary to reach viability through organic growth alone.
solution: Deliver our proven SPO incubator at scale, via a blockchain enabled, project based learning platform. Equipping SPO’s with tools & frameworks to help them build sustainable stakepool operations.

title: Unlocking the Power of cNFTs with Charity
problem: The lack of external financial stimulus into the Cardano ecosystem hinders it from sustainable growth and further adoption.
solution: Charity model with real property classification of NFTs assets to perpetuate resources for causes, tax credits, and associated royalties for NFT projects introducing new finances to Cardano ecosystem.

title: Development of Cardano Index API
problem: The problem we want solve is the absence of a user-friendly API that provides seamless access to real-time Cardano token market data, hindering developers from efficiently tracking the Cardano market.
solution: Our solution is to develop a standardized Cardano Index API that offers easy integration of market data, empowering developers and users to track and analyze Cardano token performance effortlessly

title: Community CIP Editor: 1 year budget (continued)
problem: Like all top blockchains, Cardano has a standards process to support developers and new applications: Cardano Improvement Proposals (CIPs) require daily, intensive review by a small number of editors.
solution: Robert Phair has 2 years experience as a Community CIP editor (not employed by Cardano core companies). A further year budget will ensure Cardano's standards process keeps driving our ecosystem value.

title: Cardano Cycling Tour
problem: Events showcasing the Cardano apps to the outside world and their ability to solve real-world problems. Users of DApps need to perform relatable activities to gain the trust of the non-crypto public.
solution: A bike tour to showcase Cardano’s capabilities run apps that solve real-world problems to the media and the local business community.

title: Cardano for 100,000+ Ethiopian students
problem:
Lack of awareness about Cardano blockchain technology among high school and university students in Ethiopia, leading to a lack of contribution from Ethiopian students in the blockchain ecosystem.

![1-12textbooks1-d30e58.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/1-12textbooks1-d30e58/png)
solution: Empower Ethiopian students by integrating Cardano-related contents into our educational mobile app with 100k+ users and organizing meetups to bridge the knowledge gap and advance Cardano participation

title: CatalystCon 2023
problem:
![CC23-510155.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/CC23-510155/jpg)

There is no community-run Catalyst event that spans across all funded proposals.
solution: An annual conference that highlights the achievements of Catalyst and notable projects.

title: AdaQuest Mobile - Tournaments
problem:
![AdaQuest Tournaments](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/tournaments_logo-5f095e/png)

After releasing our mobile ARENA Alpha we need to <u>onboard </u>more People, upscale and monetize our F2P approach. In order to finally be able **to act independently** in economic terms!
solution: This brings <u>F2P Basic Player & Items Integration</u> including our first monetization mechanic. We will implement Free and Premium **TOURNAMENTS!** As well as the <u>game's shop system</u> for gadgets & Basic Items.

title: Elixir of Life: A Decentralized, Tech-Driven Algae Cultivation Enterprise
problem:
![Screenshot_2023-07-17_154550-removebg-preview-3e437e.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot_2023-07-17_154550-removebg-preview-3e437e/png)

Lack of scalable, sustainable, and decentralized solutions in algae cultivation hinders its potential for high-value product creation and carbon sequestration.
solution: We will create 'Elixir of Life', a Decentralized Autonomous Enterprise leveraging IoT, AI/ML, and blockchain for efficient, sustainable algae cultivation and product development.

title: Translation, localization and implementation of the Gimbalabs’ Plutus Project-based learning program.
problem:
![Andamio Learning Management System with skill and contribution tracking, treasury management and smart contract capabilities](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Andamio-LMS-square-HD-sm-ed668d/png)

For non-English speaking communities, Cardano’s steep learning curve is exponentially steeper due to a lack of learning resources and developer onboarding programs in other languages.
solution: Provide the Gimbalabs’ Plutus Project-based learning (PBL) program in five other languages besides English.

title: ADA Cashback - Buy Online 5,000+ Top Stores and Earn $ADA Crypto Rewards
problem:
![ADA-cashback-871235.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/ADA-cashback-871235/jpg)

How to **buy online at thousands of virtual stores** that you already buy from and instead of receiving cashback in Fiat currency you **receive cashback rewards in $ADA crypto token at your favorite stores**
solution: A powerful online rewards platform that gives you $ADA cashback when you shop online at your favorite stores and eCommerces. Do what you do today by shopping online with Fiat & earn $ADA crypto.

title: Promoting Cardano in Mainland China
problem: Promote Cardano development tutorials to blockchain developers in China
solution: Establish the first Cardano developer website in China, and publish various development tutorials and news about Cardano every day.

title: Cardano for STEM Brazilian Students
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-9572e0/png)

There is a lack of courses/tutorials on Blockchain, Cardano and Catalyst in Brazilian Universities leaving our students out of this technology. Besides that, most educational contents are in English.
solution:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-custom-field-image-f6b6a6/png)

We will offer a free course on Blockchain and Cardano technologies in Portuguese to Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) undergrad and graduate students, and a tutorial on Catalyst

title: Cardano App for Slack
problem: The problem to address is the lack of seamless integration between blockchain technology (specifically Cardano) and popular communication platforms (like Slack) used in business settings.
solution: The solution is to develop a Slack App that integrates with the Cardano blockchain, enabling querying, real-time notifications, and interaction with Cardano.

title: Cardano Token Engineering Lab - A place to understand, model and help token engineering design mechanisms that make projects sustainable and enrich protocol and governance decision-making.
problem: As DeFi and DAOs mature on Cardano, understanding how to model and simulate decisions around token incentivization will help governance and protocol decisions for any project's sustainability.
solution: Developing a community of modelers and analysts to help work to research eUTXO model problems, work with active projects, and publish open source models for the community and projects to improve.

title: Cardano Governance book
problem: There is little introduction literature on Cardano Governance. With the introduction of CIP 1694 governance and Catalyst testnets with treasury voting and management, this is a problem worth solving.
solution: I will write an introduction to Cardano governance and invite co-authors to discuss more advanced topics such as quadratic voting, social choice theory, and theory on decentralization of governance.

title: Decentralizing the Music Industry: Empowering Artists through NFTs, AI-Enhanced Creation, and Decentralized Crowdfunding
problem: Transforming the music industry by providing artists with blockchain-based tools for rightful ownership, fair monetization, and fan engagement.
solution: We're building a blockchain-based platform enabling artists to retain control of their work, connect directly with fans, raise funds via decentralized crowdfunding, and monetize with NFTs.

title: Efficient atomic cross chain swaps between Cardano and other blockchains
problem: Currently, the DeFi ecosystem is fragmented across different blockchains. We want to research new solutions for swapping between Cardano and other blockchains without needing a bridge.
solution: This can be realized in multiple variants of atomic swaps proposed over the past years in the BTC community. The approach is generic and doesn't require smart contract support on the other blockchain.

title: Decentralized Voteaire Ballot Counter
problem:
![Voteaire-cf9e40.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Voteaire-cf9e40/png)

Voteaire votes are committed to the blockchain, the spec is open source, so they can be manually counted by anyone. To truly decentralize, individuals need the capability to count votes independently
solution: We will create the capability for anyone running a node to be able to count votes for Voteaire ballots and thereby verify the votes and weighting posted by Voteaire.

title: Urban Farmer Education Series
problem: There is a lack of tooling and educational resources available to protect against food insecurity for individuals living in food apartheid.
solution: This project will create a series of educational videos that will teach viewers everything they need to know about indoor hydroponic farming. The videos will be published into the Urban Farmer dApp.

problem:
Decentralized networks like Cardano require decentralized social media engagement and decentralized participation in audit and research to truly realize its vision and potential.

The GHH dApp offers a user-friendly interface that allows individuals and businesses to list their sustainable products and organic foods to show their commitment to environmental stewardship.

title: DripDropz Open Source Voting Gated Polling
problem: Cardano does not currently have an easy to use polling system that accepts survey inputs based upon community proofs such as NFT ownership.
solution: DripDropz will add gated polling features to its existing Open Source Voting stack.

title: Cardano Lounge by BrazilPool – A Cardano Dedicated Coworking and Events Venue in São Paulo
problem: ![cardano-lounge-logo-proposal-ff746b.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/cardano-lounge-logo-proposal-ff746b/png)🇧🇷 **Cardano Community lacks a permanent physical location for community engagement in São Paulo, the largest and wealthiest city in South America.**
solution: Establish a co-working style physical location in São Paulo for the Cardano community, addressing the problem of lacking a consistent engagement space, fostering collaboration and networking.

title: Ledger Live Integration Maintenance
problem: The Cardano Ledger Live integration needs resources to maintain its open-sourced codebase and integration to continue to be operational for the next 12 months.
solution: This Proposal asks the Cardano Community to enable maintenance budget for the Cardano - Ledger Live integration

title: NFT Staking Smart Contracts
problem: Cardano lacks noncustodial, trustless, decentralized, and open-source NFT staking and utility token distribution.
solution: **On-chain** and **open-source solution,** enabling noncustodial and trustless NFT staking, empowering NFT projects to distribute utility tokens, enhancing their Project value and overall decentralization.

title: Concentrating informations about dReps
problem: There are few dReps in the ecosystem, but they’re not well described. This could lead to a lack of interest from voters about dReps, as they don't know which dRep to choose to delegate their vote.
solution: We want to create a simple website that references the existing dReps and sort them by expertise (climate, technological innovation…), with small descriptions as well as links to their website.

title: C.A.M.O. / The Cardano Alliance for Military Outreach - Unleashing the Potential of Cardano: Empowering Veterans with Blockchain Technology
problem: CAMO addresses the lack of understanding and accessibility of Cardano through veteran education and engagement to foster adoption and showcase Cardano's potential in addressing real-world issues.
solution: CAMO will enhance the understanding of the Cardano blockchain among veterans, using education to drive adoption, showcasing its applications, and driving wider acceptance in the general population.

title: Empowering Academia through Catalyst Ecosystem
problem:
Researchers and professors need more awareness and understanding of the potential benefits and opportunities of the Cardano Blockchain and the Catalyst ecosystem.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-5fc66e/png)
solution: <https://youtu.be/Z3MzK8CVSVQ>To present the Cardano and the Catalyst platform opportunities to academics. To educate and inform Researchers and Professors about how Blockchain can enhance their research, collaboration, and funds

title: An Educational Content and Media Support Plan for the Cardano Community
problem: This aims to fund the development and maintenance of comprehensive educational materials and graphics and video editing support tailored specifically for the Cardano community.
solution: Develop beginner-friendly Cardano guides, tutorials, and resources. Create graphics for use across platforms. Provide video editing to support educational and promotional videos.

title: Production of young computer Professionals
problem: There is a lack of young people with computer skills in-demand in the city of Goma
solution: We are going to make an IT and entrepreneurship initiation center

title: GreenPulse // Cardano Carbon Footprint Calculator // Measure. Act. Make an Impact powered by @energiasocial
problem: Lack of awareness, tools and incentives for individuals to quantify and reduce their carbon emissions.
solution: Providing users with a user-friendly app that quantifies their emissions and environmental impact and incentivizes emission reduction through a blockchain-based carbon credit system using ADA rewards.

title: Catalyst Project-based learning (CPBL): Onboarding users to Project Catalyst’s Voting and Governance Tech Stack
problem: Project Catalyst’s tech stack includes many components. To ensure its adoption, it requires comprehensive documentation and a high-quality user onboarding program.
solution: Implement a Project-based learning (PBL) program on a blockchain-based learning management system (LMS) built on Cardano specifically designed to onboard users to Project Catalyst’s tech stack.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Mithril - Open-source contributor
problem: Mithril is a promising tool that will enable new use-cases in the Cardano ecosystem. It’s a great example of an open-source project, but it has little involvement from contributors outside of IOHK.
solution: Assign a Rust dev from outside IOHK team to become a part-time open-source contributor to the Mithril project for 6 months to accelerate the roadmap and introduce an outside perspective.

title: Blockfrost SDKs refresh
problem: Blockfrost SDKs maintenance support window had been reached a year ago, making various SDKs to lag behind and miss features available in the latest version of the Blockfrost API.
solution: Update top 5 most used Blockfrost SDKs to reflect the current state of Blockfrost API and provide updates to its dependencies.

title: Mafoc: a composable chain indexer framework
problem: Have a *composable* framework to index on-chain data. The currently available indexers are either monolithic (cardano-db-sync) or index a fixed set of data (Kupo).
solution: Have a Haskell framework where indexers could be composed mechanically: any state that the fold (reduce) requires is shared automatically, making composition easy.

title: Supporting Catalyst Systems Design with a Data Perspective
problem: If we want to collectively decide on how to improve the system we need multiple independent participants providing analyses and insights into the current actual functioning of the system
solution: Contribute directly to the knowledge and insights of the current system through data analysis, reports and discussions and developing modular solutions for others to use

title: Ethereum2Cardano University
problem:
![Eth2ADA-2bb3fc.jpeg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Eth2ADA-2bb3fc/jpeg)

Lack of an all encompassing online tooling and educational resources for developers transitioning to Cardano.
solution: Create the go-to innovative online portal and webinar platform to support developers and community members in transitioning to Cardano.

title: Experimentation of Data Contribution Token Rewards for a future PositiveBlockchain DAO
problem: Lack of incentives for Data Contributors to ensure the ecosystem of impact blockchain (SDGs), a.o. built on Cardano, is properly mapped and up-to-date, offering knowledge to both web2 and web3 actors.
solution: PB aims to experiment a decentralized coordination & reward system to mobilize Data Contributors (individual, researchers) around our database. First stage leading to a potential DAO in the future.

title: Mobility and Transportation Sidechain
problem: Current Layer-1 blockchains can't cater all use-cases, specifically mobility sector needs, concerning scalability, privacy, and GDPR conformity.
solution: An EVM sidechain, PeakChain, with Cardano as its root of trust, focused on mobility, offering scalability, privacy and GDPR compliance.

title: Establishing a Blockchain Research Laboratory at the University of Lagos: Empowering Education and Innovation through Cardano Technology
problem:
![University of Lagos](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/t_500x300-d04941/jpeg)

Limited Opportunities for Blockchain Education and Research in Nigeria's Higher Education System.
solution: Establish a dedicated Blockchain Research Lab at the University of Lagos to provide education, resources & research opportunities, fostering blockchain expertise and innovation in Nigeria.

title: Rookiez - Decentralized Motorcycle Racing Manager Game - Graphics and Infrastructure updates
problem: I want to bring other Indie Game developers to the Cardano ecosystem, by showing them that different business models are possible. We don't need scammy P2E mechanics, nor to pay a 30% Steam tax.
solution: **Rookiez** is the first **Motorcycle Racing Manager game on Cardano**, but it is in the prototype stage and uses temporary assets, graphics, and backend technology. Improvements will attract more attention.

title: PRISM Verifiable Credential badges
problem: Distinguishing trustworthy websites and projects from shady ones is a challenge — especially in crypto. We need some way to share our credentials and endorsements on the web and make them verifiable.
solution: A toolkit to embed *Verifiable Credentials* into your website or profiles for everyone to see and verify even without the need of an identity wallet. Think of it, like *GitHub* build-status-badges.

title: Wolfram Blockchain Integration Framework - Enabling Simultaneous Access to Blockchain Ecosystems
problem: There are many blockchains in existence and each one operates differently. For a researcher, accessing each blockchain individually limits their ability to explore, research and derive insights.
solution: Our integration framework solves this data accessibility problem with simultaneous access to each integrated blockchain, enabling researches to derive valuable cross-chain ecosystem insights.

title: Building a Learning, Verification and Job Placement Platform that will will enhance verification of identities by different independent entities such as corporates, 3rd party organizations and learning institutions.
problem: Web3 industry in Africa lacks a skills-based learning platform with verified learning process and content and also insufficient job platforms for recruiting hiring skilled developers
solution: The Decentralized Learning, Verification and Job Placement platform will enhance verification of identities by different independent entities e.g corporates, organizations and learning institutions.

title: Db-Sync Enterprise: high-availability setup of Cardano’s Db-Sync to run queries and access on-chain data as a service
problem: Running Cardano’s Db-Sync pipeline is expensive and thus out of scope for small and medium sized projects on Cardano. This project’s goal is to provide an affordable & reliable solution for them.
solution: We are developing and maintaining a high-availability infrastructure running Db-Sync to minimise downtime. Cardano projects can be hooked up to our Db-Sync Enterprise solution in short time.

title: Multisig Wallet Connector (CIP-30 expansion)
problem:
We do not have a way of connection Multisig wallets to Dapps Safely .

This is holding back institutional adoption.
solution: By creating an alternative CIP-30 standard that conforms to the requirements of a multisig wallet, we can make the use of Dapps safe and efficient for multisig wallet users.

title: Risk Monitor for SPOs
problem: Cardano SPO block-creation is susceptible to byzantine (block-withholding) behaviors depriving delegates of funds expected from the protocol. SPOs have no decentralized capabilities to detect such.
solution: A Risk Monitor tool suite empowers SPOs with decentralized means to detect whether network-wide block production aligns with expectations from protocol so that reward distribution remains honest.

title: Liquidity 4 Virtual Assets (L4VA) - Building the 1st AMM for NFTs, enabling users to instantly sell for the floor price on Cardano
problem: Non-fungible token (NFT) markets lack liquidity and it is impossible to INSTANTLY sell an NFT for a fair price.
solution: We are building an automated market maker (AMM) protocol to provide instant buy-side liquidity to NFT and NVA markets, allowing owners to instantly sell assets at the market floor price.

title: Cardano RealFi Consortium - Coordinator Role: Streamlining Synergies for Real World Blockchain Solutions
problem: Lack of resources and support for businesses looking to use Cardano to solve real-world problems. Lack of awareness, coordination and pooling of resources to solve problems shared by RealFi problems.
solution: Establish a dedicated Coordinator to conduct business outreach, manage day-to-day operations, marketing of RealFi projects, foster synergies, and facilitate collaboration within the CRFC.

title: Community outreach program on Cardano blockchain technology education in Nigeria
problem: To raise awareness about Cardano blockchain technology, provide access to education and resources, and encourage adoption to address Nigeria's lack of awareness, slow adoption, and limited access.
solution: Creating a Cardano blockchain resource centre and online platform to address Nigeria's limited access to education and resources, promoting awareness and adoption.

title: NEWM Academy - Learn-to-Earn Education Platform
problem: Most non-crypto users actively avoid blockchain-based products because of false perceptions of crypto, high-risk investment, and a lack of incentives to pursue education around the actual technology.
solution: Our solution is NEWM Academy, a Learn-to-Earn platform offering courses on Cardano and Web 3.0 projects, where users earn points, badges, and tokens for completing educational objectives.

title: Open Source Minting Platform for FTs and NFTs - With Payment Gateway and Wallet integration
problem:
![nft-mint-open-c654fa.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/nft-mint-open-c654fa/png)

There isn't an open-source minting platform for developers to build their products on top of it. We will open source Tangocrypto’s minting platform with payment gateway and wallet integration.
solution: We will provide an open-source minting platform with a payment gateway, wallet integration, and support for **CIP25** and **CIP68**. Available as Docker containers ready to be deployed in a **K8s** environment.

title: Space Ape Club Video Game - Funding for Updates and Expansion
problem: The problem I want to solve is the lack of real-world applications available in the Web 3 world that attract crowds to Cardano or introduces the culture of Cardano to the broader audience.
solution: Free to play space ape survival video game for Space Ape Club to provide an engaging real-world application that introduces the culture of Cardano, driving adoption and exploring its potential.

title: Cardano Education for Ethiopian Universities
problem: **Lack of blockchain education and awareness in Ethiopian universities; bridging the knowledge gap and promoting Cardano adoption.**
solution: Blockchain & Cardano education initiative: seminars, workshops, and networking events to educate, empower, and foster adoption in Ethiopian universities.

title: plu-ts - 0 to full Cardano dApp tutorial/documentation
problem: There is a lack of documentation and practical examples for new developers
solution: We propose a series of videos to be uploaded on youtube explaining the technical concept of it assuming no background experience in blockchain (though targets are developers)

title: Blockchain Education Alpha Program for Vietnamese
problem: Removing the language barrier, bring the Cardano Foundation’s education course to Vietnamese and provide an interesting blockchain learning experience for Vietnamese.
solution: Translate Blockchain Education Alpha Program course into Vietnamese, create doodle videos for each unit and publish content to Cardano Vietnam community.

title: Cross-DEX order aggregator - Trades seamlessly across DEXes and liquidity pools on Cardano
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-e2a1ae/png)

DEX liquidity on Cardano is fragmented across protocols and not easily accessible to the public, leading to capital inefficiency, higher volatility, and missed arbitrage opportunities
solution: Open-source Smart Order Router framework to connect liquidity across DEXes, empowers users to deploy their own arbitrage strategies and bring true decentralization to the Cardano Defi ecosystem

title: Promoting Global Adoption of Cardano for Daily Commerce
problem: Global adoption of cryptocurrencies for daily commerce is minuscule (<0.3%), partly because of the value lost converting from and to fiat.
solution: We will create a globally-scoped freelancing platform that pays people in Cardano, enabling efficient purchases of goods and services with Cardano, and jumpstarting Cardano adoption.

title: Many blockchain developers think outside the box (which is fabulous), but let's fill the box first! Use currently available tech that can give normal people an on-ramp - "Tokenized and liquid Real-estate investments for every income level".
problem:
The potential of Blockchain, particularly within Cardano's ecosystem, is to create a robust solution that addresses skeptics' demand for applications accessible to all. So, where are all the people?

![FCG Architects](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-17-050837-6bb94a/png)
solution: Enable inclusive Cardano engagement, particularly for individuals with limited financial resources, by introducing accessible avenues into the realm of real estate through tokenization.

title: NEWM x Nucast - Music Video Festival - Annual Recurring Event
problem: Cardano needs more digital and IRL events that don’t seem blockchain or DeFi-related to create memorable initial touchpoints/experiences with a wider base of both crypto and non-crypto users.
solution: Festivals have long been a great marketing tool and participation opportunity that captures the love and attention of audiences. We propose making Music Video Fest 2023 an annual recurring event.

title: MobileDEX : Decentralized Exchange with Ghanaian Mobile Money Payment Options.
problem: The solution tackles the issue of financial exclusion by providing access to digital asset trading for individuals without traditional banking services.
solution: Our solution is a Cardano-based DEX that enables Ghanaian mobile money users to securely trade digital assets. We foster financial inclusion, providing accessible investment opportunities.

title: Smart Places: Real-World Utility for Businesses with Location-Based NFT Incentives
problem: Businesses lack practical ways to leverage NFTs for real-world utility and struggle to offer location-based incentives to attract customers.
solution: Create an intuitive platform for businesses to effectively attract customers by utilizing location-based incentivized NFTs, enhancing engagement and foot traffic to their establishments.

title: cmag.io | A Digital Magazine To Showcase Artists, Developers and Builders on Cardano and in the Wider Web-3 Industry
problem: Artists, developers and builders in our industry lack a formal outlet to showcase the work they're doing which leads to much of it being overlooked.
solution: I want to provide a formal platform (digital magazine) for artists, developers and builders, both from our community, and the wider web-3 industry, to showcase their work, their goals and their ideas.

title: Updatable Tokenised Credentials: DID Proof of Concept & Adoption Case Study
problem: a tool set like DIDs can be hard to adopt without substantial case studies of their usefulness
solution: using CIP68 NFTs create updatable DID credentials for interaction with smart contracts such as treasuries and vesting contracts, to enable more complex verification of credentials than currently used

title: Harmonica: chatbot for LLM-powered deliberation in Cardano DAOs
problem: The core problem Harmonica aims to solve is the inefficiency and limited accessibility of current methods for group decision making in decentralized networks.
solution: Our open-source Discord chatbot uses LLM to facilitate asynchronous group decision making, synthesizing participants' inputs into votable options / proposals.

title: Pool.pm Visual Explorer - Open Source Improved Reboot towards a sustainable community innovation platform
problem: Cardano lacks an original, community oriented and evolved Open Source explorer, while pool.pm reached its limits in term of self-funding, performance, technical debt and evolution velocity.
solution: The proposed solution is to rewrite pool.pm based on past experience, focusing on open source, performance & modularity to transition it towards an innovative, scalable & collaborative platform.

title: Catalyst Africa Town Hall: Bridging the Gap for Continental Expansion
problem: Inadequate infrastructure and limited resources impede the expansion of Catalyst Africa Town Hall, restricting its ability to reach and engage audiences in remote corners of the continent.
solution: **Providing CATH with resources and infrastructure to achieve widespread participation and engagement of Africans in CATH meetings, fostering inclusivity and collaboration.**

title: Help NMKR to continue operations & develop NFT Infrastructure
problem:
![Group-1956-6b62f3.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Group-1956-6b62f3/png)

With over 2 Million NFTs minted, NMKR has been the go-to place for businesses coming to Cardano.

**The current market situation has made it very difficult for us to continue developing like before.**
solution:
By getting this proposal funded, we will **expand the runway for NMKR** significantly, and allow us to continue developing Tools for the ecosystem.

**In addition, we'll make NMKR Studio 100% Open Source.**

title: Crypto magazine published by Japanese polular Publisher "Futaba-Sha"
problem: Cardano's image in Japan is currently unfavorable, with FUD attacks by medias/SNS. The absence of unbiased analysis from influential publishers is impeding Cardano's adoption and causing disruption
solution: To promote Cardano's merits and facilitate its adoption, we will launch a dedicated Crypto Magazine that highlights Cardano and provides comparative analysis with other major blockchains

title: Open-source sign-in framework: Sign-in with wallet and/or CNFTs
problem: No open source framework exists to sign-in to dApps using your wallet or a CNFT. Developers must implement it manually, increasing development time and introducing security risks.
solution: An open source JS framework that allows developers to implement sign-on/sign-in with wallet and CNFTs, and easy integration to existing user management systems.

title: GooDanoMap: Google Maps Companion
problem: In most african country, town planning is not developed. Places don't have addresses. Despite the efforts made by Google to identify places, there are many centers of interest that are not identified.
solution: **GooDanoMap** will be a mobile application to provide deliverers and travelers with points of interest so that they have the best experience during their activities.

title: UMEME
problem: The problem we want to solve is the lack of a platform that can allow electricity distribution company subscribers to pay for their electricity without going to the payment counter.
solution: A mobile platform which provides payment methods so that customers can pay for their electricity without having to travel. ADA payment integration is also supported.

problem: There are many developers who really want to write smart contracts and build projects on Cardano. But Haskell is a big barrier for developers from comparative programming languages.

problem: Devs who join the Cardano ecosystem to write either games (card game, board game, etc.) or gamification (identity, traceability, commemorative NFTs, etc.) use-cases need templates to get started
solution: Will write templates for various game & gamification to help builders making it not only more likely that they build their project, but also making it easier, faster and in the Cardano ecosystem

Paper prescriptions are error-prone, time-consuming, and risky. Illegible handwriting and delays affect patient safety and care quality. These errors contribute to approximately 7,000 deaths a year.

solution: In an ideal setup, doctors/clinicians can use an ePrescription app to generate legible prescriptions digitally, enhancing accuracy, patient safety, and cost-effectiveness.

title: FarmTech Solutions: Empowering Nepalese Farmers with Digital Tools
problem: Limited use of digital tools and technology in Nepal's agriculture sector, leading to lower productivity, restricted access to resources, and limited knowledge sharing among farmers.
solution: Develop a mobile-based farming platform: Providing Nepalese farmers with a user-friendly app for accessing real-time agricultural information, market data, and advisory services .

title: DripDropz Mainstreet Suite Licensing
problem: Money Transmitter Licenses are required to move forward, and the investment landscape has shifted dramatically.
solution: Ask the Cardano community to support the acquisition of Mainstreet’s money transmitter licenses and contract costs.

solution: Sundae Labs, in collaboration with Yepple, will use their experience with Hydra to create a Point of Sale UI for CNTs, and MAV100 will work with their Cardano user base to test it in the real world.

title: An Esports Platform Powered by Cardano
problem: Cardano lags in attracting traditional gaming users, hindering its potential in leveraging blockchain for online gaming, a promising industry for mass migration.
solution: Our platform aims to seamlessly introduce traditional video gamers into the realm of blockchain gaming, with a specific focus on welcoming them onto Cardano.

Establish a Web3 work marketplace to offer affordable Blockchain services, connecting project owners and freelancers, thereby accelerating the growth of Catalyst and Blockchain startups

problem:

title: Socious: Extended Quadratic Funding for Open Source Projects
problem: Existing crowdfunding platforms [favor a few wealthy individuals](https://cointelegraph.com/explained/quadratic-funding-the-future-of-crowdfunding-explained), neglecting community voices. title: Standardizing Seamless Blockchain Integration for Unity Game Engine
problem: NO SDK’s, API’s or services available on Cardano that allow game developers to get started right away or at best from within the game engine.
solution: A modular web3 Unity Engine tool that simplifies blockchain integration, enhances user experience, and empowers game developers in innovation.

title: NEWM Community - Cardano Is Not a Ghost Chain - Worldwide Marketing Push for Cardano
problem: Coordinate and execute a highly-focused marketing campaign utilizing the collective resources of all prominent Cardano stakeholder groups. Bringing more people and businesses into the ecosystem.
solution: Coordinate and execute a highly-focused marketing campaign utilizing the collective resources of all prominent Cardano stakeholder groups. Bringing more people and businesses into the ecosystem.

title: XFORGE: Building the ultimate mint platform for Cardano native assets, allowing creators to set up sales pages with ease.
problem: There is a lack of mint platforms that have the combination of these qualities: user-friendly, affordable, secure, no-code, and multi-signature. Setting up sales pages requires technical expertise.
solution:
We are building **the ultimate mint platform**. Our solution bridges the gap between complex minting processes and user convenience, with low service fees ensuring accessibility and ease-of-use for all.

![Catalyst-Proposal-light-1-0bae54.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Catalyst-Proposal-light-1-0bae54/png)

title: Bring Decentralized Organization tools to the front of the community
problem: Managing decentralized communities with existing tools requires heavy manual procedures and training, and poor Cardano integration makes rewards and contribution-recognition possible but impractical.
solution: Implement project & payout management and contribution-tracking, to boost efficiency, recognize efforts, manage incentives, and enhance community trust. With on-chain record-keeping transparency

title: Research: Strategically Competing with Mobile Money Markets in Malawi
problem: Mobile money is commonly used in southeast Africa. Cardano hasn't yet disrupted this market. There are untapped opportunities to improve people's ability to move money as well as Cardano's reach!
solution: I see these transactions all the time. My solution is a local survey & detailed report about how Cardano wallet providers could work to make the switch to a Cardano-based solution as easy as possible.

title: Cardano Media
problem: The Cardano ecosystem is expanding day by day, and the amount of information shared is also increasing. We want to create an all-in-one platform to help users access information as quickly as possible
solution: Up-to-date videos of influencers in the ecosystem give a comprehensive view of what is happening in the network. Based on the Youtube platform, we create an elite version of these influencers.

title: Scradabble.xyz - the ADA word puzzle game
problem: Scradabble.xyz is a word game built on Cardano. It is a collectible NFT letter tile that can be used to create NFT words and combos. This proposal brings the game from its PoC stage to public release.
solution: Various quality of life improvements are required to make the game customer ready. This proposal is to provide the development resources to complete the game.

title: MITHR - Reforestation and Help for Terrestrial Ecosystem
problem: Help with deforestation, wildfires, unsustainable energy, water depletion, undervalued resources, and cryptocurrency adoption, giving trustworthy, honest, and immutable proofs.

title: Cardano Calendar Mobile App For IOS & Android
problem: Majority of daily internet usage occurs on mobile devices. There are currently no popular mobile platforms that allow users to view events taking place in the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Cardano Calendar Mobile App will address the need for a mobile app built to view all of the events taking place in the Cardano ecosystem. We will launch on both Android and IOS platforms.

title: Token-Based Loyalty Program for Pharmacies
problem: Current pharmacy loyalty programs in Germany lack digitization, resulting in potential loss of physical cards, ineffective customer data tracking, and privacy concerns.
solution: We'll create an MVP for a blockchain-based pharmacy loyalty program using Cardano based tokens, enhancing privacy and user convenience.

title: Stress free zone in Cardano Ecosystem
problem: The biggest problem is stress and low life energy while creating and implementing our projects and in our lives general. With my workshops, we will solve the problem of stress and low life energy.
solution: I will hold monthly workshops lasting 3 hours and weekly practice lasting 75 min. where members will learn about tools that help us deal with stress and deal with stressful situations more easily.

title: Bridging Blockchain Worlds: Bitcoin Ordinals on Cardano for Enhanced Liquidity
problem: The current lack of interoperability between blockchains limits the reach and diversity of digital collectibles marketplaces. We seek to bridge them in innovative ways.
solution: We will integrate Bitcoin Ordinals into our Cardano Marketplace, allowing users to trade and transact digital collectibles across multiple blockchains. In doing so recruiting more Cardano users.

title: If you build it, they will come. Just build things people NEED or WANT.  Like authenticated CV's or awards or authenticated participation.
problem: Increase traffic & use cases of blockchain based campaigns on Cardano with Enterprise level marketing & authentication tools. Create exciting new use cases for the blockchain. FamilyHistories on chain
solution: As we have built an Enterprise/SaaS platform that allows brands, creatives or IP holders web2.5 -Web3 platform and tools that aid in building web3 applications.

title: Revolutionary pro-community NFT Smart Contract. Splitting service fee between multiple parties, on-chain affiliate, precision in lovelaces without any rounding up to the detriment of creators or users.
problem: Lengthy and expensive barriers of entry causing monopolization of Cardano NFT space and uncompetitive environment compared with other blockchains.
solution: Developing a smart contract that fairly rewards all parties involved in the selling process thanks to advanced UTxO management. Our solution will reduce the current market entry barriers.

title: IRONSKY NFT GAME | Cardano's game to build on Mobile
problem:
![Ironsky](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/IRONSKY-GAME-93fd71/jpg)The Cardano ecosystem has few NFT games, not keeping up with Metaverse trends, and will lose its competitiveness with other crypto ecosystems, with very few games on Cardano for ADA holders to join

![play ironsky](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/2023-07-17-00.05.48-a65433/jpg)

solution: A self-service web app whereby event companies can replace the use of paper tickets with an NFT-based, in-person usage tracking system that is compatible with their existing check-in software.

title: OpShin Core - Developing Python Smart Contracts
problem: Writing Smart Contracts on Cardano in Plutus/Haskell is difficult. Alternatives like OpShin (Python) are not well funded and currently have no dedicated developers pushing the project forward.
solution: By hiring a part time developer, the OpShin project can make progress in the desired pace such that it will truly enable onboarding of new developers into the ecosystem.

title: MLabs – SPO-anywhere – Easy Stake Pool Deployment with NixOS
problem: To maximize decentralization, stake pool operation should be extremely accessible. Yet, current practice involves many steps and is hardly simple for non-experts, leading to a lack of SPO diversity.
solution: We will create a NixOS configuration and scripts to generate the files needed for SPO deployment. We will leverage nixos-anywhere to make our NixOS configuration deployable on any Linux-based machine.

title: Using low-cost HSMs (e.g. Yubikeys) for easier and safer self-custody
problem: Self-custody is a daunting task for beginners, with many ways to make mistakes and lose funds. This proposal uses Yubikeys to make the process more forgiving of user error. See [prototype](https://wipcrypto.com/catalyst/prototype-mobile) & [whitepaper](https://wipcrypto.com/catalyst/whitepaper).
solution: This proposal protects keys from physical loss, theft, fire, flood, etc. by securely encrypting seed phrases with HW-bound keys on multiple Yubikeys, then replicating them online. More in [whitepaper](https://wipcrypto.com/catalyst/whitepaper).

solution: **Are current DAOs are really DAOs?** The goal is to produce detailed research and documentation of what it might mean to autonomously organize in a truly decentralized way! Can we maximize experiments???

solution: We will make it easy to integrate Atala PRISM DIDs with existing SSI applications and services, by adding did:prism "drivers" to the Universal Resolver and Universal Registrar open-source projects.
