title: Embed Voteaire On-Chain Voting In 3rd Party Sites
problem: Projects in Cardano want to integrate on-chain voting seamlessly into their websites. The challenge is to maintain vote integrity while also making the voting processes intuitive and easy-to-use.
solution: We will build a react component that will enable projects to embed Voteaire ballots within their own website. This makes it easy for a project to provide on-chain governance to NFT or FT token holders

title: DAO Governance x Atala PRISM - By MuesliSwap
problem: Current governance solutions require a utility token for balancing voting power. DIDs could instead be used to ensure no one votes twice. This also opens new possibilities regarding vote weighting.
solution: We will integrate Atala PRISM DID into custom on- & off-chain voting systems (incl. development of SCs, BE, FE) that can be used for treasury management and protocol parameter update mechanisms.

title: Minting NFTs in L2 of Cardano: Milkomeda Implementation
problem:
![Progetto-senza-titolo-1-683be5.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Progetto-senza-titolo-1-683be5/png)

At present, the absence of an NFT minting tool on Milkomeda creates difficulties for developers in testing their solutions. Moreover, to onboard users, we must provide them access to minting tools.
solution: We are the exclusive platform for minting on all Cardano chains, including mainnet and testnet. With the addition of milkomeda, we can boost its adoption among users and developers.

title: WowTalkies - Revolutionizing Fan Engagement on the Cardano Blockchain
problem:
![WowTalkies-new-logo-140ad1.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/WowTalkies-new-logo-140ad1/png)

Limited platforms exist that connect Movie fans, Artists and Studios in a rewarding, interactive, decentralized manner.
solution: WowTalkies, a comprehensive user-friendly fan engagement platform that leverages AI/ML, blockchain and AR/VR to revolutionize how fans interact with movies, artists, and communities.

title: BlockCred shortens long wallet addys with authorised web 2.0 email addresses and social media handles for secure, decentralised trading on the Cardano blockchain.
problem: Handles on the Cardano blockchain are not authorised, with many established brand names, emails addresses etc, bought by unassociated wallets. This opens up opportunities for scamming and fraud.
solution: BlockCred shortens Cardano wallet handles with personally authorised email addresses and social media handles, using a decentralised database, to provide users with a secure and trusted trading system

title: Spectrum Network | Testing Protocol at Scale
problem:
![Square-post-2789f8.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Square-post-2789f8/jpg)

Cardano lacks a decentralized mechanism that enables programmable cross-chain communication with other blockchains. E.g. it is impossible to make a smart contract to swap native ADA for native ETH.
solution: Spectrum Network protocol serves as a trustless programmable cross-chain layer that allows cross-chain messaging between Cardano and any other connected blockchain or general data source.

title: "Cardano: Empowering the Future of Blockchain Technology - Introduction Event at NTHU"
problem: Lack of awareness and understanding about Cardano's potential and benefits in the blockchain industry and its impact on various sectors.
solution: We will organize an engaging event at NTHU to introduce Cardano, educating and inspiring attendees about its potential and applications.

title: Empowering Financial Literacy through an Interactive Cardano DApp Game: Educate, Engage, and Earn ADA
problem: Lack of financial literacy & adoption of cryptocurrencies.
solution: Engaging DApp game on Cardano blockchain educates users, promotes financial literacy & crypto adoption.

title: Sustainable High Molecular Weight Inhibitors (Phaseolamins) for regulation of glycemia in diabetes and metabolic syndrome, powered by Catalyst and Cardano.
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-4b52c9/png)

Diabetes and metabolic syndrome are common diseases, together affecting more than 1,5 BILLION people worldwide (IDF, 2022) and drastically affecting their quality of life and well-being.
solution: We will produce High Molecular Weight Inhibitors that have been proven effective for regulating glycemia. We will produce such a product from Chilean native sustainable sources (Phaseolus Vulgaris).

title: Spot Converter: Buy Cardano NFTs with Any Crypto
problem: Cardano NFTs are not accessible to holders of other cryptocurrencies, limiting their market and adoption.
solution: We will build integrate an API that enables spot conversion and transfer of any crypto to buy Cardano NFTs

title: Packaging Cardano-Node for Guix, A Functional Package Manger
problem:
- Code built from source is more secure, but difficulty compiling leads people to use prebuilt binaries
- Binaries built from source differ greatly depending on build environments and installed software
solution: Guix is an advanced functional, source-based package manager. Packaging cardano-node for Guix will make compiling from source trivial and will produce bit-for-bit identical binaries every time.

title: Catalyst Completed Project NFTs
problem: Catalyst Project Completion is critically important to the success of the experiment, but the current project completion experience is anticlimactic, unceremonious, & difficult to track and share.
solution: Completed Projects mint custom "Project Completion'' NFTs via NMKR API & LidoNation Catalyst Explorer. Minting a completion NFT is a celebration, a ceremony, a shareable trackable community artifact.

title: FiDa - Obtain Class IIGB regulatory status in the Bermuda Monetary Authority.
problem: We need regulatory authorization by the [BMA](https://www.bma.bm/) in order to trade insurance contracts and onboard. Bermuda is a global leader in financial regulation related to the use of Blockchain & Crypto currencies.
solution: FIDA aims to achieve regulated status by complying with all requirements and for the regulator to be comfortable with the platform’s structure at policy through their sandbox environment.

title: [MAYZ Protocol] Open Orders
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-891891/jpg)

The lack of a decentralized smart contract to **Create, Manage, and Invest in Cardano Funds.**
solution: The proposal aims to enhance user participation in **Cardano Funds** through simplified processes, including ***Open Order Contracts*** and ***Delegation Contracts.***

title: Gain knowledge, Obtain incentives
problem: More economic motivation is needed so that those who are new to the Cardano ecosystem can learn and evaluate the projects on Cardano.
solution: We will organize training sessions for new members of the Cardano ecosystem on how to evaluate projects, and there will be rewards for outstanding individuals after each training session.

title: Migrate our Full Value Business Valuation Tool onto the Cardano Blockchain
problem: Current business valuation models miss up to 80% of a company's value. Meaning founders/leadership teams lose out significantly when raising investment funds, growing and selling their businesses.
solution: Convert our Full Value Dashboard tool to an interactive blockchain-enabled, website-based solution. Allowing companies, at scale, to assess, grow, evidence & leverage their full value

title: DLT360: Blockchain Application Catalogue for Business and Industry
problem:
**Industrial customers do not have a single go-to point to get a comprehensive overview of existing solutions, tools, builders and already developed industrial solutions on Cardano**

![Screenshot-2023-07-11-at-12.11.15-f23d41.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-11-at-12.11.15-f23d41/png)
solution: **An industry-focused application overview of Web 3.0 applications, tools & development-companies building on Cardano incl. distribution to decision-makers in relevant early adopting industry sectors.**

title: CWIC (Cantonese Women In Cardano)
problem:
![Toxic1-ee38a4.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Toxic1-ee38a4/jpg)

There are not enough women involved in Cardano and cryptocurrency in general, and this is made worse by an often toxic and unwelcoming male dominated culture.
solution: Encourage the active participation of Cantonese women in the blockchain space by creating a supportive & inclusive environment through education, mentorship and community-building initiatives.

title: Marlowe Runtime SDKs
problem: Marlowe is a brand new framework for building and running financial contracts. Marlowe Runtime is the backend for interacting with the blockchain. We need SDKs to easily interact with the backend.
solution: Create idiomatic SDKs in Rust, Python, Go and Javascript to easily interact with Marlowe Runtime. This will facilitate adoption of the framework by developers in the ecosystem.

title: Dumpling Twitter Space
problem: A decrease in educational spaces in the Cardano ecosystem resulted in limited knowledge sharing and decreased morale among community members.
solution: Provide educational content and boost community morale through consistent and engaging Twitter Spaces with Cardano’s best moderator and cohost.

title: ADIUVAT: Find your place.
problem: We aim to address the issue of limited purchasing power by offering a service/dapp that simplifies people's daily interactions, such as paying for their activities or services.
solution: When creating an account, users must allow location access to view nearby bubbles. These bubbles represent various types of establishments. the bubbles provide recreational experiences.

title: NuAuth - Secure and Decentralized Verification Platform for Digital Content Authenticity
problem: Lack of reliable verification for digital content authenticity. Need a secure, decentralized solution leveraging Cardano blockchain for immutable proof of originality, transparent verification process
solution: Secure, decentralized app for content creators. Cardano blockchain and IPFS ensure authenticity. Verify content, trust shared links. Empower creators, build trust.

title: Ethic Code for Catalyst
problem: **Unethical conduct**, **conflicts of interest**, **corruption** and **resource-extraction actors** emerging in our community, mirroring traditional politics worldwide.
solution: Implementing **Ethics Code** in Cardano Governance (Catalyst) community for transparency, integrity, accountability, and effective behavior management, fostering a trustworthy community.

title: Unleashing Cardano's Gaming Revolution for Mass Adoption and Blockchain-Powered Entertainment
problem:
![logo](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/euphorans-party-with-logo-5d09d3/png)

**Unlock Cardano's potential by attracting renowned developers**, leveraging the power of blockchain, and introducing innovative gaming experiences, driving widespread adoption among a diverse audience.
solution: Develop an intuitive API, collaborate with Wildsnake Studios, and streamline game development on Machiavellic to drive Cardano's mass adoption, elevate gaming, and unlock blockchain's potential.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Market Making and High Frequency Trading on Cardano
problem: In traditional finance, trading bots are often used for market-making to boost liquidity. While various bot frameworks exist, they are not Cardano-compatible.
solution: We will provide an open-source bot framework for Cardano to improve MuesliSwap's liquidity. This flexible tool will enable user customization to decentralize market-making on Cardano.

title: AbjaDAO Glossary | Translating Blockchain to Arabic
problem: The language barrier is one of the main reason why mono lingual Arabs in the Middle East & North Africa don't have access to quality educational (and other) blockchain content, causing slower adoption
solution: We are developing, maintaining and propagating the first standardized and methodical Arabic glossary for blockchain terminology, which is being adopted by a growing number of entities.

title: Adoption + Retention & Loss Prevention ( Ruggable.Me )
problem:
The problem being addressed is Cardano's lack of active

- Adoption (From other chains and newcomers)
- Retention (Incentivizing continued participation)
- Loss Prevention (Education about decentralization)
solution: A web based hub that facilitates the exchange of undesirable digitally issued asset from Cardano & other blockchains for value in the Cardano Ecosystem.

title: One Vote
problem: Complexity hinders current voting systems, lacking clarity and accessibility.
solution: nhance voting systems with a bubble heat map, visually representing options and facilitating intuitive participation for improved clarity and understanding.

title: Howey Test
problem: It is crucial for the regulation of cryptocurrencies in the United States and worldwide to determine whether they qualify as securities or not according to the Howey Test applied by the SEC
solution: I want to create a website where all cryptocurrency users can perform the Howey Test on any crypto and find out whether it qualifies as a security or not, simply by answering a few questions from test

title: Cost-Effective Amazonian Solar-Powered Servers: Empowering Cardano Community as Global Blockchain Nodes
problem: High server costs for Cardano SPOs hinder participation. Affordable options using clean energy are needed to ensure network decentralization and sustainability. We aim to give SSH servers for low cost
solution: Solar-powered servers enable sustainable and cost-effective infrastructure, empowering Stake Pool Operators. Enhancing pool performance, expansion, and decentralization of the Cardano blockchain

title: ArtCardano: Sustainable Digital Art Curation and Exhibition for Cardano's Ecosystem.
problem: Lack of curated digital art collections and exhibitions within Cardano's NFT marketplace.
solution: Create a sustainable platform for curated NFT art collections and exhibitions, bolstering Cardano's ecosystem.

title: Web 3, Cardano4Good and Sustainability Impact Report 2024
problem: Lack of accessible research illustrating how web3, blockchain and Cardano connects to real world impact. Inspiring diverse stakeholders to join and support the movement to build an equitable world.
solution: Create the first Web3 and Cardano Impact Report, illustrated with research, celebrating projects and use case applications of cardano4good in context of the wider web3 ecosystem, and the real world.

title: Atala Prism and Self-Sovereign Identity: An Education and Transparency Platform
problem: We're addressing two issues: the lack of awareness about self-sovereign identity and Atala Prism, and the need for transparency in tracking Fund 10 projects
solution: Proposing a website for education, transparency, and tracking Fund 10 projects focused on Atala Prism, promoting self-sovereign identity. Weekly multilingual content

title: ADMN: The Copyright & Trademark Solution for Cardano
problem: Most creators do not know how to secure copyright protection for their works, nor how to license or sell their rights. The blockchain space does not have an infrastructure for intellectual property.
solution:
ADMN is a Copyright and Trademark registration and licensing application.

The solution will integrate Cardano's creative and innovative ecosystem, and provide a framework for licensing and sales.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-custom-field-image-217a0a/png)

title: Cardano Ubuntu Informal Business Credit DApp - Atala Prism-Enabled Cooperative Smart Contracts Credit System
problem: Lack of access to financial credit is deepening the woes of informal businesses in Africa.
solution: Use cooperative smart contracts integrated with Atala Prism to provide financial credit to informal sector businesses in Africa.

title: ADA Express
solution:
- Set a stable and reasonable price according to the current standard of living
- Reduce the rate of kidnapping, thanks to the system of scanning the customer's card before and after each race

title: The FUNINTEC's student Hubs: The cascade effect in the Project Catalyst and Cardano
problem:
![Cascada-cardano-d6d5ba.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Cascada-cardano-d6d5ba/png)

University and high school students in Venezuela need access to or knowledge of Cardano's technology and the catalyst project, representing a problem for its use and massive adoption.
solution:
![Emurgo-Academy-Newsletter-October-2022-1-9be4d7.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Emurgo-Academy-Newsletter-October-2022-1-9be4d7/png)

![Emurgo-Academy-Newsletter-October-2022-2-111462.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Emurgo-Academy-Newsletter-October-2022-2-111462/png)

We will train 30 facilitators in the Cardano network and the catalyst project at FUNINTEC who will then cascade the knowledge to 120 university and high school students.

title: Improve Cardano's News & Media DAO
problem: Currently Cardano lacks a proper DAO focused on news and media. Though TARAX news and media DAO was established for just $500 USD in Fund 8, it had minimal to no success.
solution: The solution is a proper website outside of Discord that utilizes the governance of a DAO to tokenize articles and create news through a token incentive and advertisement platform.

title: Open Transaction Chaining tooling to speed up Cardano dApps - By MuesliSwap
problem: Cardano is generally perceived as a slow blockchain. We want to implement technical solutions for fast transactions (2-3 seconds) based on transaction chaining in openly available tooling.
solution: We will implement tooling required to support fast transaction submission (within seconds) using transaction chaining in the cardano-node, PyCardano and Nami wallet.

title: SPACIOM: Creating Stronger Connections Through 3D Interaction & Digital Ownership
problem: Today's social media & content sharing platforms offer a poor experience due to their unengaging formats, constant competition for visibility, limited creative expression & intrusive advertisements.
solution: Spaciom is an immersive 3D social platform built on key aspects of our human nature to create stronger connections with the people we love & true digital ownership of the things we enjoy.

title: Cardano ecosystem get a physical and mental healthier with yoga
problem: The Vietnamese yoga community don't know about blockchain and Cardano ecosystem. Not much yoga applications in blockchain to help Cardano ecosystem get a mental and physical health.
solution: Introduce the benefits and applications of the Cardano to the Vietnamese yoga community. Also, share online exercises to improve mental and physical health for the Cardano community in Vietnam.

title: Verified Credential API Access
problem: The primary problem I aim to solve is to answer the question: "Until there are companies issuing verifiable credentials, why would one begin to verify them?" I intend to prove value and path to SSI.
solution: I intend to demonstrate **verified credentials (VC)** as a unique Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution for **APIs**. This will add value to the API ecosystem, and a bridge to SSI via Atala PRISM.

title: For the community, by the community: Optimizing the ROI of Catalyst through listening to builders, expert analysis and assessment of Cardano’s Community Grants Fund. Brought to you by Catalyst and Intersect MBO Architects.
problem: Systematic improvements to Catalyst’s Impact and Outcomes require deeply listening to and understanding the key challenges faced by builders, otherwise, we risk “Boiling the ocean”.
solution: Systemic assessment of builders' needs and journey that identifies key levers to dramatically improve Catalyst’s ROI + Workshops with key stakeholders to turn these insights into action.

title: MLabs - Cardano Onchain Languages Benchmark
problem: Cardano smart-contract language ecosystem develops rapidly and offers many languages, without a single and comprehensive performance comparison.
solution: Our solution proposes implementing the same onchain validator in multiple languages, developing a language-agnostic test suite to test the equivalence of validators, and measuring performance.

title: BLOCKTRUST Credential workflow platform
problem: Atala *PRISM v2* provides SSI infrastructure in the form of SDKs, yet we still lack a simple method to integrate our digital identity into all the ideas, projects, and organizations out there.
solution: A no-code SaaS toolbox for building SSI workflows that allow for easy integration. e.g. when a link is clicked, it issues a credential; or when a credential is provided, it generates a sign-in token.

title: NZTwork (Net Zero Token Network): Revolutionizing Carbon Credit Creation
problem: **Energy and environmental data can save money and fight climate change through energy services and carbon markets. We will democratize data so all value is returned to users instead of corporations**
solution: **Data miners collect IoT data and apply it to AI apps that help reduce carbon footprint through energy saving and solar, then monetize performance with rewards and NFTs as credits so users earn**

title: NFBooks: a Pan-African focus NFT library. Proposing a unique and fun reading experience.
problem: In Africa, access to books and ebooks is severely limited. Numerous factors are at play against mass adoption of a reading culture which negatively affect all involved parties (authors, readers, etc).
solution: Create an NFT book library focused on promoting a reading culture in Africa starting in CMR. The platform will greatly expand and facilitate access to books as well as provide incentives to readers.

title: [C2VN]: Cardano developer club in Universities
problem:
University students, as potential blockchain developers, currently lack a positive environment (such as labs, exercises, hackathons, etc.) to practice and gain experience in building dApps.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-b0fe37/png)
solution: We aim to establish an open blockchain club at the University, where both professors and students can engage in creating foundational and advanced labs and facilitating various other activities.

title: NMKR API powers an Open Source NFT Launchpad website Template
problem: There is no ready to use website template for hosting your own NFT launchpad or sale using the NMKR API. This creates a barrier to entry to those community members who do not know how to code.
solution: Create an open-source website template that integrates with NMKR. This template will empower community members, regardless of their coding abilities, to easily set up and host an NFT sale.

title: Wieczorowa Pora - Spaces, podcasts & YT focused on Cardano Community & SPOs
problem: Improving Cardano community engagement through informative and interactive Twitter Spaces and podcasts. Demystifying the technology behind Cardano SPOs.
solution: We will host informative Twitter Spaces and podcasts to educate and engage the community. Spaces will include interviews, news and obligatory educational column.

title: Notiboy : Effective communication on web3
problem: In web3 an identity is represented by an address rather than a username or email-id. This difference in identity is a barrier for effective communication.
solution: Notiboy facilitate effective and efficient communication via address specific notifications and address to address chat application. Connect your wallet and start communicating by maintaining privacy.

title: Kreate - Vibrant Community & Marketplace for Millions of Art Lovers
problem: Cardano is missing out on millions of Artists & Collectors outside of PFPs due to the lack of tooling and a broader Art community. This is an underutilization of the chain's capital and technology.
solution: Kreate is an All-in-One Web3 Art platform, building tools for Artist sustainability, and using a social-focused design to foster the supportive connections that give life to a vibrant Arts community.

title: DLT360: cyberLEAN auditshare - A DAO-like assurance sharing platform for business audit requirements
problem:
**Industries provide ISO certifications in numerous areas, e.g. quality, environment, and cybersecurity. All these need internal audit resources, which are currently not shared between businesses.**

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-ee6cdb/png)
solution: **A DAO-like audit resource marketplace to share audit capabilities and results between businesses and utilise zero-knowledge trust for information and value exchange.**

campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Preserving Heritage with Cardano: A Decentralized Cultural Knowledge Solution
problem: Safeguard cultural heritage against data manipulation, unauthorized access, and missing artifacts and knowledge. Centralized systems often lack transparency and result in limited access and control.
solution: We will develop a Cultural Heritage & Knowledge Management System (CHKMS) in the Cardano artverse to ensure decentralized ownership and preservation of cultural artifacts and knowledge for the future.

title: The Cardano Column on +Web3 Radio Show
problem:
![isologo-Web-3-3000x3000-f95827.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/isologo-Web-3-3000x3000-f95827/jpg)

The global spanish speaking population needs content in Spanish, which is both understandable and engaging for the average person, to lower the barriers of getting into the ecosystem.
solution: A Cardano column at a transmedia radio program, aiming to showcase the amazing ecosystem Cardano possesses to put Web3 technologies at work in different Spanish Speaking markets.

title: [3] Student-Driven Demonstration of the Use of SSI and the Cardano Blockchain to Capture their Cardano Blockchain Skills
problem: To build decentralised societies, we need to educate the younger members of our society. However, traditional educational is largely unaware of decentralisation technologies and the methods.
solution: Working with students we will create a learn-by-example introduction to decentralisation technologies, and integrate decentralisation technologies into their learning communities using Cardano.

title: Maternal Mortality Crisis - DoulaID: an app by RootsID
problem: US Medicaid eligible mothers are 3x more likely to have negative birth outcomes. Doulas are proven to help high-risk birth outcomes. DoulaId guides doulas through the difficult Medicaid registration ![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-d82885/png)
solution: [DoulaID](https://www.doulaid.com/) is a [RootsID](https://rootsid.com/) app addressing the maternal mortality disparity crisis in Baltimore City. DoulaID is an app for community doula organizations to enroll culturally congruent doulas with Medicaid

title: Derer NFT Market Place
problem: **Due to limited cryptocurrency access, most African artists face difficulties in promoting and selling their work locally, leading to underdeveloped NFT markets in the region.**
solution: To overcome limited cryptocurrency access, DERER Marketplace will create a platform integrated with local payment options through Endubis Wallet to ensure convenient access to NFTs in these markets

title: Hungry Haste: decentralized and open-source food pickup and delivery service
problem:
Apps like DoorDash charge 15-30% fees on food orders. As a result, the price of an average order skyrockets, but delivery drivers still often struggle to earn even a minimum wage.

![Logo](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Logo-4793fa/png)

![Screenshot-f417e7.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-f417e7/png)
solution: We replace traditional apps with open-source apps and decentralized finance. It helps to reduce the price of an average **pickup** order by 15-30%. Later, we'll add food delivery and better drivers' pay.

title: Adopt Legal Framework for Dispute Resolution
problem: Currently there is no dispute resolution or trial procedure within Project Catalyst. As a result, issues remain unresolved and the ecosystem experiences bad governance.
solution: With community input, we will write a legal code based off the American UCMJ (Uniform Code of Military Justice). See the example link below from the Cardano Forums.

title: Splash Ignites Social Growth For Cardano Builders, Uniting Communities Across Chains To Discover, Collaborate and Thrive
problem: Projects on Cardano struggle to garner global marketing reach and robust social followings despite the blockchain having one of the most vibrant ecosystems.
solution: We are creating a cross-chain web3 directory and token gamification platform, improving project discovery, and incentivizing engagement to boost the marketing capacity of Cardano-based projects.

title: Cardano For the M₳sses - Vietnamese Book for Vietnamese Devs
problem:
Publish the book “Cardano For the M₳sses” in the Vietnamese version to help the Vietnamese Dev Community understand Cardano better and attract more newcomers.

![cardano-for-the-mass-ca5ecc.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/cardano-for-the-mass-ca5ecc/jpg)
solution: We will cooperate with a professional translation correction company in Vietnam to create a high-quality "Cardano For the M₳sses" Vietnamese book

title: Defi & NFT-First Light Wallet by The Ape Society
problem: The #1 barrier to entry for new NFT & DeFi users of Cardano is the lack of a user-friendly light wallet made by a team that deeply understands the space.
solution: Creating a fast, intuitive and reliable wallet for new users in the Cardano ecosystem to use in preparation for the next wave of retail, optimized for DeFi and NFTs.

title: Web3 Monetization of Web2 Media Platforms
problem: The majority of video streaming, film and content creation platforms are in centralized web2 platforms that restrict their users' ability to monetize and distribute content. Creators feel stuck.
solution: A self-service web app and supporting background services that allow creators to configure video token gates in a simple format that requires no coding or advanced understanding of blockchain.

title: Smart Contract for CARDANO Invoice System
problem: There is no widely adopted invoicing system on the Public Blockchain as a source of trust and allowing businesses to transact with each other.
solution: We will make a smart contract for issued invoices stored on the blockchain, as integral part of Cardano Invoice System, which will allow emerging of trust-less business practices .

title: Optim SPO Bonds - a new, market-driven method to bootstrap pools
problem:
![SPO-F-07db1f.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/SPO-F-07db1f/png)

It is **increasingly difficult for a new stake pool to bootstrap liquidity**, provide a competitive return on ADA, and attract organic delegation. **SPO Bonds help solve this through the power of DeFi**
solution:
Optim's SPO Bonds are an on-chain DeFi product

SPOs borrow ADA delegation for fixed duration & interest rate

Funds subsidize interest costs for SPOs & drive liquidity

\*Alternative to CF, IOG delegation

title: Cardano School: a Cardano Community DAO for Educational Content Creation
problem: Education is crucial for the adoption of Cardano and content creators play a big role in educating newcomers , but they don’t really get the monetary incentives to make it worth it.
solution: Create a DAO for content creation, where the Cardano community joins together to decide the content that should be created, and where content creators are incentivized to create it.

title: Wolfram Cardano Exchange Data Infrastructure
problem: The task of collecting high-resolution financial data and making it useful from a wide range of centralized crypto exchanges (CEXs) and decentralized crypto exchanges (DEXs) is a complex undertaking.
solution: Our open-source solution will allow developers to deploy their own data collectors to store trading pair data from CEXs and Cardano based DEXs so they can build applications on top.

title: Domino DAO: Where Impact Measurement, Impact Investing, Impact Evaluation, and Proof of Impact NFTs collide with decentralization for a positive ripple effect
problem: There isn't a Decentralized Autonomous Organization focused on incentivising impact measurement, investing, and verification. Community led approaches struggle to sustainably organize and scale.
solution: Domino DAO as governance for Impact Web3. A decentralized ecosystem for impact investing, measurement, and verification. Providing employment opportunities and ways to upskill and verify impact skills

title: 🎓 StudentReader.io 2.0: Identity, Oracles, and Smart Contracts, with Atala PRISM and AIKEN 🎓
problem: Lack of practical, open-source code and education on Identity and Smart Contract integration hinders potential of decentralized systems.
solution: An interactive smart contract developers course with open-source examples integrating Atala PRISM V2 using AIKEN programming language for smart contracts, and a live demo via our scholarship contract.

title: Rythmeet: A complete P2P music platform for networking
problem: Music can be expensive and is not accessible to all and Cardano lacks attracting people from outside the crypto bubble.
solution: Creating the most complete music platform for musicians where they can network, find instruments, receive scholarships and discover Cardano

title: Socious: NFT-based Gift Cards
problem: Coupon fraud costs US businesses up to [$600M/year](https://www.infosysbpm.com/blogs/bpm-analytics/coupon-fraud-management.html). NFT-based gift cards and coupons can solve this problem, but no viable open-source projects currently exist to tackle this issue. [日本語](https://socious.notion.site/F10-P4-NFT-c682594d8bb54493a34e26cbc9f05c79?pvs=4)
solution: Develop an open-source solution that uses NFTs to create secure and fraud-resistant gift cards and coupons.

title: [2] Upgrade the selfdriven Apps to support SSI & xAPI Standards, and DAO Functionality (Open-Source)
problem: Selfdriven Apps issue community IDs & achievements using Cardano & NFT metadata formats. We aim to align with open standards for interoperability and support on-chain DAO functionality.
solution: This proposal targets aligning selfdriven NFTs with W3C SSI, enabling identities and skills to function as DIDs, achievements as VCs, and supporting xAPI, SSI interfaces, and DAO functionality.

title: Standardizing Health Interoperability: Putting FHIR in Blockchain
problem:
Global health data exchange lacks transparency and accountability, hindering trust. FHIR integrated with blockchain boosts transparency, security, and trustworthiness.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-66708b/png)
solution: By integrating FHIR with the Cardano blockchain, we ensure verifiable and secure health data transactions between providers, enhancing trust and interoperability in the healthcare ecosystem.

title: Auto Stake Pool Setup - Pocket Pool
problem:
Setting up stake pools is hard for non technical people. Its a barrier to more decentralization. We are building a point and click GUI that anyone can use to easily build their own stake pool or node

![Mainnet-2b6bf6.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Mainnet-2b6bf6/png)
solution: We're building the the code to automate setup, repositories that hold up to date node images, a website accessible to anyone to download and run Pocket Pool, and troubleshooting steps if needed.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Sponsored Learning Program for next-generation smart-contract architecture with Stellar Contracts
problem: Learning Cardano dev skills from online documentation is frustrating & lonely. It requires new skills, intuition and mental models. Quality instructors, lessons and support are hard to find.
solution: **A 10-week, online, instructor-led course for all Cardano project contributors to gain intuition, high-level mental models and practical skills. +Rewards for community contribution.**

title: Winter Protocol: Open-Source Traceability & Real World Asset Tokenization
problem: Currently, Cardano does not have a powerful out-of-the-box traceability and tokenization solution ready mainstream industrial and enterprise-level use-cases. This remains a barrier for mass adoption.
solution: Winter Protocol is a **modular, turnkey open source tokenization & traceability suite**, designed to be utilized by Cardano developers targeting mass adoption through small to national-level initiatives.

title: Hardware-Secured Hot Wallets for Live Services (Dexes, Bridges, Side-Chains, Dapps, & more)
problem:
Services & dapps relying on live "hot wallets" are vulnerable to private key theft, enabling adversaries to sign fraudulent transactions. Existing hardware wallets cannot be used autonomously.

![Typical Live Crypto Service: Wallet keys vulnerable to attack even if the Cardano node is run on a separate server.](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/BlockDiagramTypical-eac4ae/PNG)
solution:
A secure-hardware "hot wallet" can prevent wallet keys from becoming compromised while enabling autonomous transaction signing capabilities required by live services.

![Hardware-Secured Crypto Live Service: Wallet keys are stored encrypted on specialized hardware and secured against remote and local attacks.](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/BlockDiagramSecure-450386/PNG)

title: Marlowe Hub: Unifying Platform for Marlowe Smart Contracts, Oracles, and Mediators, Auditors and Developers
problem: Marlowe is a very transparent platform designed for ease of use. The work the IOG team has done has created an amazing platform, but we need to expand on this to make it even easier to use.
solution: Marlowe Hub will be an explorer for all Marlowe smart contracts, Oracles,Mediators and Auditors along with integrations and examples to aid in their usage.

title: Xerberus: Risk Ratings for all Fungible Assets on Cardano
problem: Cardano lacks a source of impartial and fact-based information about the risks of tokens. This lack makes our community vulnerable to exploits, as well as influencers spreading incorrect information.
solution: We provide free risk ratings for every fungible asset on the Cardano blockchain. Public ratings will improve the efficiency of capital allocation in the ecosystem and protect the community from fraud.

title: Catalyst Africa Town Hall Operations
problem: Lack of funding for the Catalyst Africa Town Hall, hindering its ability to sustain and enhance the bi-weekly meetings and provide valuable resources for the Cardano community in Africa.
solution: Seek funding from Cardano Catalyst Project fund 10 to sustain and enhance the Catalyst Africa Town Hall, ensuring valuable resources for the bi-weekly meetings and fostering Cardano growth in Africa.

title: Onboarding Cardano’s next 1 million Web2 users: Connect to dApps by logging in with a social account or email address, via a non-custodial plug-n-play invisible wallet solution for dApps
problem: If a Web2 user wants to start using a Cardano dApp, they need to overcome difficulties such as downloading and setting up a wallet, storing a seed phrase, and connecting the wallet to the dApp
solution:
NuFi will create a plug-n-play walletless experience that dApps can integrate to onboard Web2 users into Cardano; users can connect to dApps simply by logging in with a social account/email address

**<u>![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-custom-field-image-8d92c3/png)</u>**

title: Cardano Staking API Development Proposal – Precise Insights and Analysis
problem: Cardano stakeholders lack access to precise staking insights and real-time and historical staking and rewards data, hampering their ability to make informed decisions and analyze rewards efficiently.
solution: The Cardano Staking API enables Cardano community members to access real-time and historical data, empowering them to optimize their staking strategies and gain valuable insights.

title: First Ever! Real Estate Oracle
problem: With the eventual tokenization of real estate. We will need an oracle to update and manage the historical sales, rental, and property data on the blockchain.
solution: Our solution is to build a real estate oracle that pulls data from the national MLS (Multiple Listing Service) as the first step into the eventual transition to blockchain.

title: Sisu Network Bridge: A secure and user-friendly bridge for seamless cross-chain asset transfers on Cardano
problem:
Limited cross-chain solutions hinder secure and user-friendly asset transfers between Cardano and other blockchains. High demand for cross-chain transfers yet lacks adequate solution.

![Sisu-Network-Testnet-8e7d83.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Sisu-Network-Testnet-8e7d83/jpg)
solution:
We'll integrate [**Sisu Network**](https://sisu.network/) to Cardano

- Enabling seamless communication & asset transfers across blockchains
- Enhancing interoperability, liquidity & user experience
- Scalable, secure & developer-friendly

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: BuildingOnCardano.dev v2
problem: The current BuildingOnCardano.dev website is manually curated, not searchable and has no collaboration or DAO functionality.
solution: Update the BuildingOnCardano.dev website for community curated content, make it searchable, implement the "foot-hold" code examples in many languages, and add support for developer collaboration.

title: GitHub pull request management by Onchain voting with Encryption and Delegation
problem: We want to bring the Vote Coin project to Cardano. Open vote coin standard allows onchain voting with encryption with knowledge based delegation. We want to create github tools for DAO management.
solution:
We will create open source apps to

- Manage votings on cardano
- Index cardano for vote coin standard data
- Manage github pull request to start voting session and approve pull request with approved vote

title: Framework for Authenticity Verification of Tokenized Real-World Assets based on Atala Prism
problem:
![Group-1960-e2ace3.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Group-1960-e2ace3/png)

Absence of a reliable, scalable, and decentralized framework for verifying the authenticity of real-world assets in the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Developing a comprehensive Atala PRISM-based framework for verifying the authenticity of real-world assets prior to their tokenization.

title: PoS Capital - Venture Capital approach for the Catalyst Fund, to nurturing Growth in the Cardano Ecosystem in an ongoing manner - Innovation is not happening once a year!
problem: The problem is that the Catalyst Fund is coming from the treasury and we believe this is not ensuring long-term sustainability for the ecosystem plus innovation happens more often than once a year.
solution: Our solution is a two-category funding model combining an evergreen fund and decentralized community voting. The evergreen solution ensures a sustainable Cardano growth in a ongoing manner.

title: Andromeda Way Agency (AWA) - Web 3.0, Cardano blockchain marketing & consulting agency
problem:
![LOGO---black-background-purple-light_v3-centered-41ed58.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/LOGO---black-background-purple-light_v3-centered-41ed58/jpg)

1. No marketing agency that focuses on Cardano.
2. SPOs need marketing help.
3. The onboarding of businesses is difficult.
4. Artists of all kinds are eager to use free systems to distribute their masterpieces.
solution: We will disrupt the marketing industry with innovative solutions through Cardano and AI. SPOs, startups, large businesses and individual artists. We aim to onboard every business that we work with.

title: ETHERIUM REHAB - RECOVERY WITH CARDANO - 12 STEP PROGRAM
problem: Ethereum users may not understand they need to be rehabilitated. Eth Rehab is needed to serve as an educational resource for a smooth transition to Cardano from eth, because eth users deserve better.![SIX_7B2E462B-5868-4DDA-8A4E-BA9C62AD9986-f631ec.JPG](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/SIX_7B2E462B-5868-4DDA-8A4E-BA9C62AD9986-f631ec/JPG)
solution: Develop a 12 step program that will identify inefficient crypto practices of Ethereum and provide solutions using the Cardano blockchain. The first step to recovery is admitting you have a problem!

title: NEWM - Music Streaming App - Mobile Integration
problem: Streaming accounts for 67% of the overall global music market revenues (26.2B in 2022). Web2 music streaming platforms lack transparency and fairness in their payment models.
solution: A user-friendly, mobile-first music streaming app that uses tokenization to facilitate direct artist & fan compensation, transactions and exclusive access to music content via token-gating technology.

title: Beyond Atala Prism: SSI, Grassroots Participation and Emergent Solutions in DIDs
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-65f451/png)

**While centralized identity solutions neglect many across the globe, the prime capabilities of Atala Prism remain largely untapped**
solution: Widen the reach of Atala Prism through Wada hubs to ensure that comprehensive identity solutions become a reality for Africa, building on the strides already taken in Ethiopia."

title: Ikigai + MLabs – Hydra app SDK and auction service
problem: Cardano Hydra has been used to develop sophisticated applications that benefit from L2 scalability. However, additional work is required to turn these into production-ready services on Mainnet.
solution: Upgrade the hydra auction reference implementation into a production-ready app deployable on mainnet and add UX improvements for commercial viability. Develop a general SDK for similar applications.

title: [CNS] Cardano Name Service
problem: The internet relies on DNS and 13 root servers, but manipulation or attacks can limit access and control.
solution:
Using the cardano blockchain to record DNS records, decentralizing a currently centralized structure.

Using NFTs to secure DNS ownership.

title: Consenz: Community Consensus Measurement & Optimization
problem: Forming consensus in large communities is essential for building trust and allowing collaboration, but it is hard to measure and to be standardized.
solution: Consenz is Agreement Building Platform. It uses the "consensus-meter" - an algorithm for consensus calculation. We wish to open-source its code to invite researchers and developers to optimize it.

title: Integration of Atala Prism with Political Affiliation Systems
problem:
![AfiliacionIDS-d2004f.PNG](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/AfiliacionIDS-d2004f/PNG)

Currently, many countries lack political affiliation systems that allow citizens to maintain sovereignty over their personal data, this is the case of several Latin American countries.
solution: We integrate Atala and political affiliation system into an open-source tool. Citizens will have control over their personal data through a mobile application, preventing misuse by political parties

title: Catalyst Explorer dRep module: Directory, Community, Draft Ballots
problem: dReps are coming to Catalyst, but there's no community tooling for managing off-chain interactions, communication & socialization. Fund 9 funded the infrastructure but not GUI/ Front Ends.
solution: Expand the Catalyst Explorer to provide a home for dReps & their delegators to connect, co-create Draft Ballots, & discuss. The tool would also display dRep profiles & voting history for the public.

title: Sorbet Wallet Debugger, by Sundae Labs
problem: dApp development on Cardano lacks efficient wallet connection testing and issue reproduction, leading to fragile integration and poor user experience.
solution: Sorbet is a Chrome extension allowing Cardano dApp developers and support teams to browse dApps as if they were a specific user, aiding efficient issue diagnosis and enhancing user experiences.

title: Onboarding for Evolutionary Organizations: A primer for DAO contribution
problem: DAOs lack learning resources and proven frameworks for effective collaboration, which stifle creativity, hinder meaningful engagement, and lead to organizational stagnation or demise.
solution:
We will explore and identify patterns of effective collaboration in DAOs.

We will build a project-based learning experience to alter the negative habitual formats and introduce positive ones.

title: dRep interviews - Cryptotexty youtube channel
problem: There is little awareness and information about dRep as a notion. Another problem is that: how diverse and how big dRep participation will be? How to achieve easy and proper voter delegation?"
solution: My solution is to increase awareness about dReps and Cardano governance by making interviews with dReps, dRep candidates and prominent members of Cardano ecosystem

title: Ogmios Clients in Python & C++
problem: Lack of client implementations in Python and C++ for Ogmios limits the accessibility and ease of development for Cardano applications in two popular programming languages.
solution: Implementing Python and C++ Ogmios clients would enable developers in these widely-used languages to easily build applications on Cardano by leveraging the capabilities provided by Ogmios.

title: HSD: Health Screening Database MVP
problem:
**Limited access to personalized screenings delays care. Outdated info, neglecting factors, and insufficient guidance raise costs & risks.** Lack of HSD & localized healthcare provider. recommendations.

![Screenshot-2023-07-16-at-00.18.11-b07d26.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-16-at-00.18.11-b07d26/png)
solution: Creating a Blockchain health screening database w/ personalized recommendations & 3-sided marketplace. Experts conduct screenings, individuals-locals & labs participate. Users pay with utility token.

title: Reusable Identity Verification and Governance Framework Template
problem: Ecosystems and individuals are constrained when “identity verification” (IDV) is not reusable, and credential stakeholders lack transparency to drive trusted adoption
solution:
A reusable KYC-compliance ID verification credential

A governance framework template for trust and transparency

title: gOuroboros: Cardano Ouroboros protocol server support in Golang
problem: The Cardano ecosystem lacks a robust Golang library for communicating with a Cardano node at the protocol level and ledger, excluding a large pool of developers from participation
solution: We will continue developing the gOuroboros open source Golang library for speaking the Ouroboros protocol with a Cardano node and reading the ledger data structures, including server side messages

title: User-Friendly Plug-and-Play EVM Node for Streamlined Cardano Ecosystem Interactions
problem: The complexity and technicality of EVM blockchain interactions deter many from embracing and utilizing this technology.
solution: We will develop a Plug-and-Play EVM Node, simplifying blockchain interactions and fostering wider adoption of EVM technology.

title: Establishment of a Blockchain Research and Innovation Laboratory at KCG College of Technology
problem:
![KCG logo](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/th-ce918c/jpeg)

Limited access to blockchain R&D facility and practical learning opportunities for students at KCG College hinders their ability to understand & contribute to the rapidly evolving field of blockchain
solution: We will establish a dedicated Blockchain R&D Laboratory at KCG College of Technology, providing students with hands-on experience and resources to understand and contribute to blockchain technology.

title: RootsID production-ready GLEIF witness on Cardano
problem:
Cardano needs a robust [KERI](https://keri.one) backer to attract Legal Entities and Organizations that participates on the [GLEIF](https://www.gleif.org/en) ecosystem of vLEI verifiable credentials.

![Image File](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-file-url?url=aHR0cHM6Ly9jZG4uZGlzY29yZGFwcC5jb20vYXR0YWNobWVudHMvMTA0NTc5MzE3NTY4NTU4Mjg5OC8xMTMwMjQ1NTM4MzE5Njk5OTY4L2xvZ28tcm9vdHNpZC5wbmc%3D)
solution: Improve the[ KERI backer](https://cardano.ideascale.com/c/idea/64263) Proof of Concept delivered in Fund 9 to reach production readiness quality, and deploy it as a cloud instance to be adopted by vLEI [GLEIF](https://www.gleif.org/en) ecosystem participants.

title: “Cardano Vietnam News”
problem: The amount of information about Cardano is large, the community does not have enough time to fully update; Difficulty in specialized terms; Vietnam does not have a news channel about Cardano.
solution: We will create original documentary content, publish it into videos of about 3 minutes in length with powerful illustrations on the Cardano Blockchain Youtube channel

title: Cardano's Transactions for Bank credits score
problem: The determination of the solvency of customers for obtaining bank credit does not yet take into consideration the various operations (transactions of all kinds) carried out on blockchains.
solution: Provide users and banks with a tool to leverage operations performed on the Cardano platform in the process of computation of credit score to improve the user's solvency level and financial inclusion.

title: Improving Catalyst Voting: Addressing Low Participation and Random Voting.
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-8a50b2/png)

Inadequate participation and random voting in Catalyst hinder effective decision-making. This results in sub-optimal allocation of funds and diminished outcomes for the Cardano community.
solution: Facilitate onboarding of African Cardano Community members, fostering active participation in Catalyst voting and proposal evaluation.

title: Owning a challenge in a student hackathon about Sustainable Finance to help Cardano ecosystem grow and have new opportunitiesand
problem: There's a lack of knowledge from students about blockchain technology, butpeople don't want to try learning blockchain as they think it's out of their league.
solution: We'll hold a challenge in a student hackathon around sustainability in the Cardano ecosystem, to make students more aware of it, and help them to participate to next Catalyst funds.

title: eUTxO Fundamentals: Building Cardano Smart Contracts [eBook]
problem:
![Pastel-Line-Art-Motivational-Book-Cover-1ea421.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Pastel-Line-Art-Motivational-Book-Cover-1ea421/png)

Embarking on the development of Cardano is hard. The available doc is fragmented across multiple sources, lacking a step-by-step tutorial. Moreover, does not include the recently introduced tools
solution: My proposed solution involves the creation of an eBook specifically designed to facilitate the initiation of Cardano development. It will guide readers through the setup of the development environment

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: CardanoPress: The Missing Documentation
problem: CardanoPress is a growing tool that many projects & builders are using to start their projects but it lacks detailed documentation, especially for those that are not familiar with WordPress.
solution: Our solution is to write and produce detailed written & video documentation for any skill level, from beginner to advanced users to be able to use CardanoPress to its fullest potential.

title: Realfi.info mobile app(s)
problem: Cardano users tend to operate multiple wallets, accounts within wallets and multiple decentralised apps. It is not possible to view a portable, comprehensive portfolio summary in one location.
solution: A mobile app for the handy portfolio valuation tool, Realfi.info, providing portable and efficient access to Cardano data including tokens, staking, liquidity pools, lending, delegations and NFTs.

title: Connecting Tech 2 Business. Promoting Cardano tech startups to business customers for sales, pilot or market feedback.
problem: Technology driven teams lack at times the business knowledge and connection for a successful go to market research, strategy and sales. Especially when we deal with a new technology like blockchain.
solution: Provide business development activities to prepare & connect tech startups on Cardano with prospect clients in order to support market analysis/feedback loop, pilots and actual sales.

title: SPO Relay Node Security - Vulnerability Assessment of Relay Node Security
problem: Our objective is to identify vulnerabilities that presently exist in various Cardano relay nodes & establish a baseline of vulnerabilities to help SPO's strengthen node security.
solution:
- Vulnerability Scans: Identify vulnerable/misconfigured relay nodes.
- Threat Intel: Aggregate data from the dark web to increase visibility of potential risks.
- Analysis: Recommendations for remediation.

title: Nucast - Reinventing Video Rentals With a Smart-contract Based Content Rental Platform
problem:
Video NFT owners & creators face a lack of opportunities to generate ongoing revenue from NFT media content, which severely limits their long-term profitability.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-9be582/png)
solution: With a decentralized content rental marketplace, users can enjoy true ownership and customizable video rentals. This creates a new option to monetize content and earn ongoing rental income.

title: Cardano-Africa French Community
problem: Lack of sufficient resources on the Cardano Blockchain in French to facilitate the active participation of French speakers in Africa to actively participate in the development of Cardano.
solution: We have created a knowledge sharing platform in French dedicated to Blockchain Cardano, where users discuss, ask questions, share articles, publications, events, research.

title: DeFi on Hydra and Mamba (Bynet Protocol continuity)
problem: We want to initiate speed and scalability improvements inside Bynet Protocol. We see: Slow DEX transactions on L1, lack of scalable and secure L2 products on Cardano, lack of real Hydra use cases.
solution:
Our goal is to introduce the concept of decentralized matchmaking machines. Bynet Layer 2 aims to bring scalability. We especially look at Hydra.

![Scalability Solution for Bynet DEX](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Zrzut-ekranu-2023-07-12-o-15.01.04-af44e9/png)

title: Developers Reward program DEV$
problem: Developers are not incentivized to work with Cardano technology, there is no reward for choosing to focus on this technology. No monetary incentive compensation is offered to use Haskell and Plutus.
solution: DEV$ is the first Reward program focused on developers. The main objective is to incentivize the participation and usage of Cardano tools like Haskell / Plutus. The more you use it the more you earn.

title: A "Plug-and-play" solution for Gaming, to SEAMLESSLY harness Cardano's power
problem: Game developers lack easy-to-use tools that SEAMLESSLY integrate blockchain and NFT tech. This limits their ability to innovate and offer superior security, versatility, and additional sustainability.
solution: We will create a user-friendly plugin for game developers to seamlessly integrate NFT-based account and asset creation (such as player characters) into their games with minimal blockchain knowledge.

title: Adosia Open Governance Model
problem: Built ‘In Private’ Governance models exist everywhere. Project Catalyst is a sandbox for innovation. Institutional design is at the heart of Voltaire.
solution: Build a Governance model in public and document the pathway for future iteration.

title: DEFORESTATION CONTROL IN KALEHE
problem: Heavy rain battered over Kalehe and caused the disappearance of forest ecosystems and landslides. Due to deforestation, we thought of reforestation and production of NFTs to monitor the trees.
solution: The reforestation of the affected villages and the establishment of a tree management system, NFT will help to fight against landslides and thus save human lives and ecosystems

title: Establish Coin Media
problem: The mainstream media provide content and report on bad news in crypto ecosystems. How do we tell our story and present the amazing real-world impact made in the Cardano ecosystem?
solution: Establish Coin Media and build a strong student audience base whilst developing preparedness among the younger generation for interest in blockchain, web 3, and the digital future.

title: Arabic Work DAO
problem: Challenges like internet connectivity, language, censorship, government financial exclusion, etc impede most of the Arabic community when trying to interact and work with global communities.
solution: Building an Arabic work DAO, concerned with collectively helping those of Arabic background to build better competence, encourage and assist each other,and collectively solve work and community issues

title: PAAS - Smart Contract As a Service. A Quick and Low Cost Approach to Build dApps.
problem: Develop a **good smart contract** is hard, many projects are **stuck and failed** at this step. We need a platform to provide **quality Plutus scripts** via **network APIs** that multiple dApps can fetch to use.
solution:
We propose a smart contract as a service platform to publish **verified Plutus scripts** for multiple dApps to use by fetching **platform APIs** in time. **Write once run anywhere**.

![PaasArchitecture-6f4110.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/PaasArchitecture-6f4110/png)

title: RATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF PLASTIC WASTE IN NYIRAGONGO TERRITORY
problem: The fight against global warming; but also the lack of training and insufficient information on the rational management of plastic waste in Nyiragongo. And the lack of information about Cardano.
solution: Respond to the problem of insufficient information and training in the rational management of waste in Nyiragongo territory. This project consists in training the populations of Nyiragongo.

title: Decentralized Seed Phrase Manager
problem: Losing access to a digital wallet can be devastating financially, and keeping a seed phrase safe is currently error-prone and stressful.
solution: We propose a novel solution that securely stores & recovers encrypted seed phrases on-chain. By leveraging Cardano, we aim to reduce digital asset loss associated with existing seed phrase management.

title: Establishing a Blockchain Research Laboratory for Technical Education and Innovation at Thakur College of Engineering & Technology (TCET)
problem: Lack of dedicated infrastructure for blockchain research & education hinders the exploration, implementation of blockchain technology in the academic environment limiting opportunities for students.
solution: A dedicated Blockchain Research Laboratory at TCET, equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, curriculum development, student projects to bridge the gap in blockchain education, foster innovation

title: Decolonising financial compliance
problem: Indigenous Tribes (e.g. Māori) need to take control of critical nation-building technologies to overcome systemic barriers to accessing economic development tools like finance
solution: Build ecosystem governance frameworks and technology for Āhau, using TribalDIDs methodologies, to interoperate with financial and compliance systems removing nation-building barriers in Aotearoa/NZ

title: "FlutterBuzzerz: Battle! - Phase 1: The Crystalline Cavernz!" is a Fun, Engaging Cardano Blockchain Game featuring collectable Game-Asset NFTs! Free-To-Play, Play-to-Earn!
problem: Let's face it - regular folks are still far from understanding, let alone adopting, blockchain tech, mainly due to L.o.F - Lack of Fun! Most dApps being built, while foundational, lack fun-factor!
solution: I'm developing a Cardano Game called "FlutterBuzzerz: Battle!" Fund 10 focuses on "Phase 1: The Crystalline Caverns" For regular folks, GAMING is the best way to drive Cardano Blockchain adoption!

title: Spreading Cardano All Around Turkey
problem: The fact that there is almost no work and documentation on Cardano and Project Catalyst in Turkey bothered me as a developer and I wanted to put an end to this situation.
solution: As a solution to this problem, I will introduce Cardano and Project Catalyst on various platforms, and while learning the written sources, I will also translate them into my own language.

title: Green DAO: Empowering Sustainable Initiatives on the Cardano Blockchain
problem: Green DAO aims to address this by leveraging Cardano blockchain to empower and fund sustainable projects, fostering collaboration for a greener future.
solution: Green DAO will create a Cardano-based decentralized autonomous organization to fund and support sustainable projects, addressing the lack of coordination and resources in the sustainability sector.

title: Cardano Hub Surabaya and Cardano Workshop Jakarta
problem: There isn’t any space Hub in Indonesia that can connect people, real businesses to Cardano chain in Indonesia. Increase in real use cases and new understanding that integrate to Cardano Blockchain.
solution: We will provide space to meet regularly that can connect professional, entrepreneur, and educator to have interest in Web3 specially in Cardano Blockchain.

title: Women: The real drivers and implementers of DeFi / RealFi solutions and strategies in the local context of Africa. Let's put them at the front stage!
problem: Women are the designers & implementers of local community-run DeFi solutions in the African context. There is a need to provide them with tools to translate all that knowledge onto the Blockchain.
solution: Launch a multidimensional marketing campaign to enroll more WOMEN Entrepreneur and devs for our Plutus training program, teaching them Haskell and Plutus and introducing them to the Cardano Ecosystem.

title: Audit for Open-source LBE for DAOs
problem: Audit & open-source our Price Discovery / Liquidity Bootstrapping smart contracts to allow DAOs to have fair token launches.
solution: We have been working on LBE / Price Discovery Event contracts for the past 5 months. They are complete, robust, and battle tested. The last step before we open source them is to receive an audit.

title: Oxford University student hub ‘CardanOx’ events and student onboarding
problem: Educating students about Cardano in a way that can enrich their lives. With Oxford being such a research heavy institution, the principles of Cardano aligned incredibly with the university.
solution:
We will run Cardano events for University of Oxford students and researchers (including postdocs).

We have been operating successfully as a Cardano student hub for over a year now.

title: Clarity DAO Treasury Defi Integrations
problem: Currently, on-chain organizations created with the Clarity Protocol do not have an easy way to have their treasury assets participate in defi.
solution: In order to execute this proposal, we will create custom plutus scripts and turn them into templated smart contracts proposals, similar to what we have done for sending treasury assets.

title: Terraform support for Blockfrost.io
problem: We aim to streamline the management of Blockfrost.io services by creating a Terraform plugin, simplifying infrastructure automation, ensuring consistent deployment for Cardano blockchain applications.
solution: We will develop a Terraform plugin for Blockfrost, enabling users to automate, manage, and consistently deploy infrastructure for Cardano blockchain via a unified IaC approach.

title: Intergrate BitBox02 Hardware wallet into Cardano Wallets and Dapps
problem: Hardware wallets are important tools for keeping your assets safe, we should use open source Hardware wallets and intergrate them into Cardano so Ledger isn't the only choice anymore.
solution: BitBox02 is an open-source hardware wallet and has been proven to work with Cardano, we should expand its utilities to suit our needs. It's not good for Cardano to rely on only one hardware wallet.

title: Seniors Ideate
problem: New technology is usually targeted at the youth. Seniors are left out although they have the brainpower and free time to ideate and develop projects to improve the communities they live in
solution: Grow a core group of senior professionals in Ghana through a gradual onboarding process to participate in the Cardano community in various capacities and to replicate the process among their peers

title: New Football Ecosystem: BitSphera
problem: There is not yet an online platform where football players around the world can play physical football completely freely with each other despite geographical distance and other differences.
solution: We'll build a dApp where football players through the internet can use their real soccer skills to interact with other players by training, creating & participating in challenges, trading, and betting

title: Upgrade Cardano wallet js for Babbage
problem: Typhonjs is a pure-js Cardano wallet library. With the impending Vasil hard fork, developers will need Vasil compatibility in order to create more efficient smart contracts and DApps.
solution: Upgrade Typhon Js library to support changes of the upcoming Vasil hard fork, mainly Reference scripts, Plutus V2 support, and inline Plutus Datum

title: Art Beyond Borders: NFT Global Youth Art Competition & Marketplace leveraging NMKR
problem:
Emerging artists from developing economies lack access to the global art market and recognition for their work. NFTs could help, but [82% of Gen Z see them as scams](https://uk.pcmag.com/old-cryptocurrency/138289/the-kids-are-alright-82-of-gen-z-thinks-nfts-are-a-scam).

![Art-Beyond-Borders-_-NMKR-NFT_Youth-Art-Competition_Cataylst_Cardano-Summit-2326c5.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Art-Beyond-Borders-_-NMKR-NFT_Youth-Art-Competition_Cataylst_Cardano-Summit-2326c5/png)

title: HarmonyAI: A Privacy-Centric Mental Health Chatbot - Advancing Artificial Intelligence on Cardano
problem:
HarmonyAI solves the problems of timely support and limited availability of mental health professionals by providing a private and always-available DApp using an advanced federated learning setup.

<https://youtu.be/QGdewv1dMLA>
solution: HarmonyAI will build a private and scalable chat bot infrastructure on Cardano, enabling seamless integration and utilization of federated learning technologies for mental health applications.

title: Maya Protocol integration - Cross-chain swaps
problem: Cardano is still very isolated from all other blockchains. There is no permissionless decentralised way of swapping to Cardano from for instance native Bitcoin or Ethereum. Maya wants to change this.
solution: Maya Protocol will be integrating the Cardano Blockchain later this year. Maya Protocol is a cross-chain liquidity protocol, allowing users to swap between native assets such as BTC, ETH, and more.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
