title: Val U Swap
problem: Val U Swap allows vendors to easily tokenize their products so they can have a direct relationship with their customers and avoid centralized middlemen with high commissions and control.
solution: Val U Swap is a decentralized, open source, self custody marketplace for buying and selling tokenized assets on the Cardano blockchain. Peer2peer swaps will be used for trade execution and settlement.

title: ChatGPT Plugin fine tuned with Atala PRISM Documentation, OpenAPI Spec and W3C standards.
problem: Learning any new technology is challenging, particularly transformative technologies such as SSI require of you to update your mental models and documentation may not be enough to achieve that.
solution: A ChatGPT plugin fine-tuned with Atala PRISM Documentation that can be consulted about SSI to resolve questions as a tutor and produce working code to help you kickstart your projects.

title: dRep TV Hub - to connect 100 dReps <=> thousands of Voters (available in English, Japanese and Vietnamese)
problem:
- **dRep** currently does not have an official channel to engage with thousands of voters (500-1000 unique wallets/proposal)
- **Voters** lack the correct information to delegate their votes to the trusted dRep

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-4c7287/png)
solution:
- We will create an official youtube channel to introduce dRep to Voters and PR in the community.
- We will interview in main language and translate subtitles into Japanese, Vietnamese, and English.

title: Solve Property Industry Problems : Utilize Cardano for Water and Electricity Meter Locations and Secure Long-term Storage of Essential Property Information
problem: Aims to Alleviate Water and Electricity Billing Challenges, Safeguarding Critical Property Data for Governments, Municipalities, Consumers, and the Real Estate Industry.
solution: I propose a property dApp Proof of Concept on Cardano for governments, businesses, and municipalities to securely store and authenticate property details using blockchain.

title: [C2VN]: Cardano Coffee Lounge in Universities (P2)
problem:
**Most people, even IT students,** have a limited understanding of Blockchain technology, specifically Blockchain Cardano. They frequently confuse **cryptocurrencies with blockchain** concepts.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-bba357/png)
solution: **Host weekly coffee meetings** to exchange information about Catalyst, Programming (Haskell, Plutus, Marlove, ...) on Cardano in a close and friendly environment at University’s campus

title: UCTalent.io - Cardano Web3 Talent Platform, where users build profile, grow network, own future!
problem:
Tech talent struggles to find jobs during recession or downtrend, as startups cut hiring budgets.

Recruitment are always very inefficient that only [2% applicants](https://hbr.org/2019/05/your-approach-to-hiring-is-all-wrong) is offered
solution:
UCTalent, Cardano's 1st web3 talent platform, attracts top talent with referral rewards & pays in crypto through smart contracts.

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-custom-field-image-fce0f0/png)

title: Cardano Beam - GPS based Assets
problem:
Ticketing and Location-based rewards platform for IRL events. A Web3 platform that rewards users for their presence whilst giving a tool for event organizers to sell NFT tickets and track attendance

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-file-url?url=aHR0cHM6Ly9saDYuZ29vZ2xldXNlcmNvbnRlbnQuY29tL2t1SXlucVhVdlNGTl9uYTdJWDVLZ1ZSYWI3SFZoX016Slk1Y1hESGs1WER0dDA2OUJHbFY4d0JPcEFoSy1BN2JFUTN4RHFPbC1wTUh2UzNKZExVTTRHZ2lwOWF4eGsyVjJRMkczVlMwamo2a3ZUSzFRbERTaEJmQ25BNERhaVlYV3dReHc5Mm0yTmxsNmFWcDA4UllzcEE%3D)
solution: Location Based smart contracts and NFTs tickets for IRL events. A platform on Cardano with no rival on other blockchains, offering ticketing and location-based solution for events and non-crypto users

title: Subbit.xyz : Featherweight channels for pay-as-you-go subscriptions & first plugin with Dandelion.
problem:
![logo](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/logo-ca766f/png)

Decentralization must extend beyond the base layer to the services built on top. There are two key impediments: sustainable financing of services and technical complexity.
solution: Subbit.xyz introduces tools that enable fair pricing of services and minimizes risk to consumers and providers. It provides a blueprint that other developers can integrate, emulate, and extend.

title: Promoting Cardano in the highland
problem: To expand its reach, Cardano engages in volunteer projects to build schools for children in highland. Promoting these events via media and online platforms to make Cardano popular in Vietnam.
solution: Building schools for children in the highlands, through this event to promote Cardano on magazine and social media to the community.

title: DAO 4 expert groups. Design a DAO model & tools needed to bring together a network of experts to collaborate around specific topics.
problem: What will be the best DAO structure & tools to bring together a group of experts around a common subject and make them engaged and provide rewards?
solution: Developing a framework & defining tools to build a DAO for a network of experts. We will use a specific use case of climate experts DAO around climate action for Earthtrust.life.

title: Chain Lobby - A multi-chain Web 3 Social Media Platform built for the masses to connect
problem:
![ChainLobby](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-12-at-21.21.26-642d6e/png)

The entry in to Blockchains has a steep learning curve. Current platforms isolate and silo people with poor discoverability and a high friction for onboarding.
solution:
![Screenshot-2023-07-12-at-21.21.41-8354e5.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-12-at-21.21.41-8354e5/png)

Create a central place for web3 communities to share resources, learn, engage & grow community. Bridging the gap between blockchains; helping people discover the World of crypto.

title: DripDropz Open Source Voting Petition Management
problem: Cardano does not currently have an open source petition management tool for adding candidates or issues to a voting platform.
solution: DripDropz will add petition management features to its existing Open Source Voting stack.

title: 🇻🇳 Developing a trial auction platform to help users avoid the risks of losing money and missing out on successful auction opportunities due to lack of experience in auctions on exchanges.
problem: NFT collectors are facing a big problem when they are not familiar with the rules of auction on the Blockchain platform leading to disastrous consequences when they cannot buy the NFT they want.
solution: We will develop a trial NFT auction platform, giving everyone the opportunity to experience a real NFT auction, and helping people gradually approach the web3.0 platform.

title: Provide infrastructure to enable biodiversity getting economic value
problem: We live in a period of mass extinction of species. Interests of species are not part of most decisions. Cardano is in the unique position to contribute to an economic value model for biodiversity.
solution: The Cardano community needs infrastructure to get to such an economic value model for species. Considering responsible use of Cardano's capacities the required tokenization should be done only once.

title: 45B - PayMeInADA - A Global Map and Directory of Businesses taking payments in ADA - Facilitating Adoption, using Marlowe
problem:
![45B-PayMeInADA-2-2c01a2.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/45B-PayMeInADA-2-2c01a2/jpg)

Cardano has a technically solid blockchain, ready for payments adoption. We need more day-to-day user-friendly tools to facilitate ADA holders to find each other, network and grow together.
solution: A simple map-based App for ADA holders to find any retailer willing to take ADA. Where businesses can get listed easily and in a geo-referenced way to reach their Cardano audience and interact.

title: Enabling Multi-Marketplace NFT Listings: A New Open-Standard for Cardano
problem: **NFTs on Cardano are confined to single marketplace listings, impeding fair competition, curbing artist visibility, limiting seller options and reducing opportunities for developers.**
solution: **We’ll develop a standard for a neutral smart contract-based service allowing multi-marketplace listing of NFTs, enhancing exposure, preventing marketplace monopolization and increasing opportunities.**

title: Creating Sustainable Change: Increasing Awareness and Promoting Environmentally Friendly Habits in Our Communities
problem: Insufficient action on climate change: A pressing problem endangering the environment and demanding urgent solutions.
solution: Implement sustainable practices: Educate, empower, and inspire individuals and communities to adopt eco-friendly actions, creating a greener future.

title: Soulbound Tokens in Cardano
problem:
![AdaSouls-iso-2-1c0635.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/AdaSouls-iso-2-1c0635/png)

DAO governance tokens are transferable, thus voting power can be purchased.
solution: AdaSouls is the first platform to issue Soulbound Tokens (tokens that are not transferable) in Cardano.

title: London Cardano Summit 2023 - A model on fusing entertainment, storytelling and community celebration.
problem: Government public budget cuts, stagnant salaries, a cost of living crisis in UK and rising inflation = challenges for unity. Community celebrations are scarce and increasingly expensive.
solution: Bring together the Cardano community, impact driven changemakers, and local artists and poets for the London Cardano Summit 2023 - for a night of entertainment, storytelling and community celebration.

title: Catalyst Hackathon (Festival of Innovation)
problem: There is a lack of interest from the students about Blockchain, which shows that they are not exposed to this world, especially through their studies.
solution: Organize a Hackathon in an innovation festival in Switzerland to incentivize the people about the Blockchain world. The goal is to find ideas to integrate Blockchain in the education of the students.

title: Profiler v2.0: Advanced Investigation and Tracking Tool for Cardano
problem: Addressing scams and fraud in Cardano by simplifying on-chain analytics. Providing advanced and user-friendly tools for investigating and tracking suspicious activities and enhancing transparency.
solution: We're building Profiler v2.0, an advanced Cardano investigation and tracking tool, offering insights to identify fraudulent activities and safeguard funds, enhancing blockchain transparency and trust.

title: Cardano Stake Pool Owner Behavior - Academic Research
problem: A little academic research about Cardano Stake Pool Owner Behavior to answer why they chose Cardano to run a pool (node), what their expectations are, and which success factors are important to them.
solution: Make academic behavior research with professional methodology, implement results in multi-channel communication, especially publish in local mediums (submit a paper in Scopus Indexed Journals).

title: Automatic bookkeeping and automatic Yearly Statements with smart contracts
problem: Record keeping and bookkeeping with yearly statements for tax purposes and other is a huge and a costly task of every small and medium sized businesses. An ever increasing burden.
solution: Smart Contracts can probably solve the huge burden of bookkeeping and making tax statements to gov. agencies. An automatic solution would be a great benefit for small businesses and gov. oversight.

title: Potential Catalyst survey in Japan for truely decentralized DAO system on Cardano.
problem: The catalyst is quite unique and large advantage function on Cardano compared to other public block chain. However, still catalyst is not so popular for ordinary ADA holders.
solution: We will search poteitial catalyst proposer and supply small fund to encourage Catalyst proposal or mini Cardano project. I already receive several possibilities from Japanese ADA holders.

title: Kakuma Studios: the first recording studio in UNHCR - fostering hope with music and blockchain
problem: Talented refugee music artists and creatives lack a dedicated studio space to create music and content. They do not even have the basic technology to participate in the NFT space or Cardano community.
solution:
![Project: SIMBA](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Project---SIMBA-Banner-2392bb/png)

We will establish a self-sustaining recording studio in Kakuma Refugee Camp, providing accessible resources for aspiring artists. We'll also provide the education and means to participate in Cardano.

title: CIPs for a Sustainable Future: Funding Community-Driven Proposals Aligned with SDGs
problem: Limited funding and support for community-driven Cardano Improvement Proposals (CIPs) aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
solution: Establish a program to fund and promote community-driven CIPs that address global challenges and promote sustainable development aligned with the SDGs.

title: BASICS: Blockchain & Cardano (Blockchain & Cardano for Dummies Web-Based Media)
problem: Understanding blockchain technology is challenging, especially for those without a background in IT. This knowledge gap slows down adoption and limits the benefits blockchain can bring to our lives.
solution: An online media platform that simplifies the concepts in plain English. We create easy-to-understand articles, videos, and podcasts, making blockchain accessible even to a 5-year-old.

title: Clarity <> NMKR: Governance Token Creation Integration
problem: The Clarity Protocol lacks a user-friendly solution for DAO creators to launch governance tokens, hindering their ability to tokenize and establish decentralized governance efficiently.
solution: By integrating with NMKR APIs, we will offer a seamless and user-friendly solution for DAO creators to generate governance tokens with appropriate properties, ensuring smooth interaction with Clarity.

title: Cardano explorer improvements (Cexplorer.io)
problem:
Ensure independent diversity across Cardano explorers.

We want to fully support Voltaire governance features and further ensure the development and maintenance of the favorite explorer and SPO tooling
solution: Maintain and develop Cexplorer.io with upcoming changes in ecosystem, governance support.

title: Pay with Credit Card on Cardano
problem: Cardano needs an open-source repo to accept Credit Card payments for digital products. Very few projects have this on Cardano and, as a result, are missing out on a large market of non-crypto users.
solution:
Open source a NextJs repo with a payment processor and smart contracts to accept credit card payments for NFTs & other digital payments. Sell products to non-crypto users. A working demo is available

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-file-url?url=aHR0cHM6Ly9saDMuZ29vZ2xldXNlcmNvbnRlbnQuY29tL0czdjhHcy1yWHdEU3pvbDNQLU9oWmllRHR4bWh0SWVYRERVMjc2cjI2T1pUMFZnblluOEFJZmVHVXpWSzUwck90ZDJnQXNWYjlkelRadW1qUGFpb2Jsc0RaRWFfNVdaVi0tWnBSMDBsdEo2NDlWdXNVMFlVa3I2dG9NNGM2bTczVl9TSmtRU3JjWHc4VmYwZDdudVJrREE%3D)

title: Landano: Integrating ProofMode Certifications with Land Right NFTs
problem: 5 billion people worldwide have rights to land but lack proof. In Ghana these rights are often issued verbally. Therefore, rights holders are vulnerable because they lack durable, trustworthy records.
solution: Landano will leverage ProofMode technology to capture audio-visual proofs of verbally-issued land conveyance rights. Proofs will be integrated into Landano land right records and protected from loss.

title: PamanKripto Media Initiatives: Cardano Indonesia Social media bridge to public branding and business latency speed up in Indonesia and Asia
problem:
![pamanbulatlogo-b948f0.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/pamanbulatlogo-b948f0/png)

There is a very limited media who can survive the web 3 ecosystem in Indonesia to articulate and present the real value of Cardano.
solution: Fast forwarding the information resources by Cardano Indonesia and attracting more business owners, professionals, newcomers, and advanced crypto investors, and getting them onboard Cardano Ecosystem.

title: Passkeys as Read Only Wallets
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-073a91/png)

Certain types of decentralized applications do not require the user to send txs.

However their users still need a full wallet to become an entity on the blockchain.
solution:
This Proposal uses passkeys (WebAuthn) to emulate a single address read only wallet.

This allows for rapid on boarding of users with no blockchain expertise.

title: Cardano Quizzes
problem: The Cardano ecosystem needs innovative methods to enhance education and boost adoption. Engaging products are crucial to promote learning and understanding of Cardano, fostering community growth.
solution: Develop interactive quiz games for Cardano with a dedicated website. Self paced quizzes, live tournaments with leaderboards, gamification, prizes in ADA catering to all from beginners to experts.

title: Cardano Vietnam SPO Association
problem:
The absence of a dedicated Cardano SPO association in Vietnam, particularly to assist single and new SPOs, hinders the push for stronger decentralization in the Cardano Blockchain

![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-5795e6/png)
solution: Form a Cardano SPO Association in Vietnam to foster SPO support, enable information exchange, share pool operation expertise, and arrange events that connect SPOs with ADA holders.

title: Integrate Cardano blockchain to PitchTalk - platform for communication between projects, investors, and communities
problem: PitchTalk aims to fill gap between projects and strategic partners, VCs and ecosystems, so VCs can empower their portfolio with strong projects, while projects can find right partners and advisors.
solution: We want to onboard projects that are built on Cardano to make their products more powerful. As well as connect funds and strategic partners from other ecosystems with Cardano-related projects.

title: Innovation Fund Research - Nodes and Connections
problem: We lack an overview of interactions between the Catalyst community roles in different funding stages.
solution:
I am opening a discussion space to gather all the knowledge about different topics from roles to connections.

Together we will organize Catalyst research on Miro Board for visualization.

title: DLT360: twinSHARE – Industry-agnostic IoT/Digital Twin Manager among non-trusting parties
problem:
**Conflicting interests regarding confidentiality, IPR, cybersecurity and liability make access and life-cycle-managing of IoT devices & Digital Twins very difficult. AI is increasing the challenges**

![Screenshot-2023-07-11-at-12.11.15-a53ca2.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-11-at-12.11.15-a53ca2/png)
solution: **TwinSHARE utilizes Decentralized Digital Identity (SSI), Blockchain and Smart Contracts for satisfying the needs of the involved non-trusting parties. This Concept prepares the path to implementation**

title: Enable use-cases that require frequent message signing by introducing a safe standard for message signing without wallet prompts
problem: Use-cases that require users to sign message frequently have a poor UX because wallets will ask the user to confirm the message signing every time
solution: We will improve the UX by creating a spec to define a flow for users to enable auto-signing messages in cases where the wallet can know it is safe to do so

title: ADABET.iO | Cardano Betting DApp Platform | Phase 2
problem:
![adabet logo](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/logo-adabet-819039/png)

**Currently, most of the profits belong to the bookmaker and there is a lack of transparency, the rights, assets of the bettors are violated by the unreliable centralized traditional betting platforms**![adabet inplay](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screen-Shot-2023-07-14-at-16.17.11-f94149/png)
solution: We build the ADABET.iO platform applying Defi to ensure property rights and increase the benefits for bettors. With the WEB3, &Cardano's tech apply to ADABET to change the traditional betting platform

title: Open Source Fiat & Token Accounting System Solution
problem: Cardano lacks a suitable framework for accounting when fiat is taken for a service that is rendered on the blockchain.
solution: Build an open source tool that will also live as a SAAS application to help Cardano businesses receive fiat and then render a service on chain.

title: Paima onchain game integration of Frontend Game Engines & Novel Technology
problem: There exists sdks for Unity in the ecosystem, but integrations into other game engines are still missing, as well as good integration with other features often using in web3 games like GPS
solution: We will integrate support for Paima Engine (engine to build games and gamification use-cases) into as many of the remaining platforms as we can

title: Pond - Pooled incubator with smart-contract loans
problem: Connecting angel investors with innovative ideas in incubators is crucial for fostering economic growth. However, the process of securing funding often presents challenges.
solution: At Pond we have the knowhow to connect borrowers and lenders, using (N)FTs as collateral. We want to use this knowhow to create our own incubator, connecting ideas with the funds to realise it.

title: Project Community Verification - NFTPass
problem: Community member verification for live events is difficult and makes it hard for projects to share verified community member rewards
solution: Create a user-end verification mechanism that allows users to verify themselves enabling projects at events, to focus on interacting with their community instead of scanning them.

title: Global Birth Certificate Issuance Processes: An Open Library and Reward Program
problem: International identity projects face extensive research due to the absence of a unified list of birth certificate issuance processes worldwide.
solution: We'll launch a GitHub-based open-source JSON library, streamlining birth certificate processes internationally to facilitate identity projects. During the project participation will be incentivized.

title: Integration of Rare Perks NFTs into a Cardano Based Ticketing Platform
problem: Currently we do not have a web3 method to claim tickets to Rare Evo via our Perks Pass NFT. This year we had to use the e-mails of our holders as the alternative.
solution: Rare will utilize Project Catalyst funding to build an events ticketing and rewards claim portal for the Rare Perks NFT collection.

title: FiDa - Oracle integration for Parametric Insurance Contracts
problem: The process of executing claims on an insurance contract is typically time consuming and expensive, by leveraging auditable, secure data from an on-chain oracle we will automatically execute claims.
solution: Integrating Oracle (Charlie3 or Wolfram), data in-place of the signed confirmation of policy claim validity for contracts removes friction and dispute costs from policy contracts.

title: Blocklog linked Leader status and Epoch leader notification service - Multilingual Support and Maintenance.
problem: When checking the leader status of the “blocklog” developed by Guild Operators (block generation result or next epoch slot leader), it is necessary to log in to the server and check it each time.
solution: Detect updates of Guild-db (sqlite3) with a python script and notify the status to any platform (Discord/Telegram/Slack/LINE).

title: Nurturing Roots in Africa: The Evolution (Education)
problem: Wada hubs made huge progress with Nurturing Roots part 1, but are not yet able to fully sustain themselves. The next level of educational support is needed to continue on 3 yr path to independence.
solution: Funding the next level of educational support for Wada hubs across the continent will uplift local hubs by equipping them with their own minimal developer base and fortifying our developer community.

title: Enhanced Catalyst Proposals: Proposal Deposits and Bad Actor Penalties
problem: High spam and low-quality proposals in Catalyst, hindering the effectiveness of the decision-making process.
solution: Implement barriers to entry, such as a cost to submit proposals, and introduce bad actor penalties (slashing) to discourage spam and ensure quality submissions.

title: Ada Payments In Africa
problem: It is not easy to use your crypto in day-to-day life. You need a service provider willing to accept payment in crypto, one must exchange crypto for fiat to make their assets useful in everyday life.
solution: A user can on-ramp and pay for goods and services in ADA (or other Cardano native tokens) and the service provider will receive their money as fiat in their preferred mobile money account or wallet.

title: SPOUSE: Open and Self-hosted SPO Security Evaluation Tool
problem: SPO's run critical infrastructure. Protecting this infrastructure is paramount, yet monitoring your security is a lot of manual work that every SPO does on their own (and sometimes not at all)
solution: We propose to create an open source tool that allows SPOs to self-test their pool setups against common security issues without needing expert pen-testing knowledge.

title: CODI: Community-Owned Data Insights; Powered by Cardano
problem: There is no trust between data owners so proprietary data is wasted in silos. Combined in a trustless manner, using ZKML, this data can massively benefit data providers and consumers.
solution: Basket of datasets is priced by training a foundation AI model and calculating ZK-verified accuracy on a public testset. This is a proxy for data value => access to the model can be bought and sold.

title: DAO - Evaluation of Funded Proposals
problem: There is no independent organization established by the Community to evaluate the results of sponsored proposals and assess their usefulness to users.
solution: Set up a DAO platform where Cardano community members can provide feedback on products generated by sponsored proposals. Assess whether these products really contribute value to the Cardano ecosystem.

title: Combat climate change >> Planting Mangrove trees >> Offset carbon emission >> Proof-of-impact thru Cardano NFT
problem:
Climate change is complex, real & requires urgent mitigation in order to save our planet.

One actionable solution is thru "Carbon emission offsetting" with proof-of-impact, backed by blockchain tech.
solution:
To work with a social impact organization and plant 1,000 real mangrove trees in Indonesia and generate CNFTs as proof-of-impact.

>> Social impact org: @CarbonEthics (www.carbonethics.org) <<

title: Fostering Scientific Research on Cardano
problem: Ensuring scientific integrity by combating data manipulation and questionable research practices through Tokenized Research on the Cardano blockchain.
solution: We will create a Tokenized Research platform on Cardano, enabling transparent and immutable sharing of scientific data to combat research manipulation.

title: SPO Campaign in Communities
problem:
In Indonesia, cryptocurrency was introduced as investment assets. Many Indonesian buy $ADA and stake in centralized exchanges. They don't understand about SPO and haven't staked their $ADA at SPO.

![SPO-Campaign-LOGO-1-eb4aee.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/SPO-Campaign-LOGO-1-eb4aee/jpg)
solution: Six times monthly campaign in Indonesian's blockchain communities, so we can introduce SPO to them. We will teach them about how to be SPO in Cardano and also encourage them to stake their ADA in SPO.

campaign.title: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem
campaign.label: F10: OSDE: Open Source Dev Ecosystem

title: Expand PypeDreams - Anti scam community protection tool
problem: Lots of scammers make fake accounts to socially engineer scams.
solution: Expand the Pype Dreams library to create demonstrable proof of provenance for communications.

title: Scrolls - Develop and deploy Custom GraphQL chain indexes
problem:
![Screenshot-2023-07-16-at-15.43.48-0ce0e2.png](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2023-07-16-at-15.43.48-0ce0e2/png)

title: Let's launch on Cardano our accesible market-fit services for event ticketing, trendy brand experiences and fair event-producing network able to onboard brands, artists, workers and audiences to our Cardano F8-backed multi-chain web3 platform!

title: DAO Owned Staking Keys

title: Salesforce-Cardano Wallet Integration: Blockchain-Enabled CRM Solution
problem: Salesforce lacks a solution for blockchain-based crypto transactions, impeding efficient operations. We aim to integrate a Cardano wallet for seamless transactions.
solution: We'll create a Cardano wallet integrated into Salesforce, enabling direct, blockchain-based crypto transactions for efficient operations within the platform.

title: Cardano DevHub: Democratizing Tech Education and Bridging the Skills-to-Employment Gap
problem: Lack of accessible, high-quality, and career-focused tech education that also fosters a sense of community and inclusivity.
solution: We propose Cardano DevHub, a free platform offering tech courses and bootcamps, fostering community, and enhancing employability within the Cardano ecosystem.

problem: Current event experiences lack a continuous engagement cycle. We aim to transform the linear relationship into a dynamic, reward-based cycle leveraging blockchain.
solution: Create a user-friendly Proof of Participation platform to award digital assets for real-world or virtual events, utilizing NMKR API to enable trading on Cardano blockchain.

title: SPO Interview Channel - SPO's Voice Need To Be Heard

solution: **Innovative NFT platform curates African art, empowers artists with fair compensation, and enables art enthusiasts to discover and purchase.**

title: Blockchain-Based Car Insurance Platform
problem: Addressing inefficiencies in the car insurance industry by building an MVP for a blockchain-based solution using the Cardano platform.

title: Proposal for a SuperApp, Metaverse and Network State, a digital governance model along with a comprehensive platform for social interactions and useful online activities decentralized.
problem: Widespread crypto adoption that seamlessly integrates the physical & digital societies is impeded by a lack of an interoperable, user-friendly platform unifying DeFi, gamification, & self-sovereignty.
solution: We're committed to establishing a network state & launching a decentralized superapp for seamless integration of crypto into daily life by bringing real world interactions in our dynamic metaverse.

title: SoundRig: Innovative Music Experience Platform - Empowering Global Music and Disadvantaged Communities
problem:
![SoundRig Music](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/SRHorizontalWebsite-8059d9/png)

solution: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zqzXQVcVzfk>We will build SoundRig to enable independent music artists (new to Web3 tech) to intuitively onboard so they can access the benefits of blockchain; tools for global exposure, and fair compensation.

title: Develop a dynamic, visual dashboard leveraging Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) Standards to comprehensively measure, report, and illuminate the sustainability impact of Cardano-based projects, fostering transparency and credibility.
problem: *Difficulty in understanding, quantifying and comparing the impact generated by sustainable initiatives in Cardano. There is a lack of transparent guidelines, metrics, and criteria for impact.*
solution: *An impact dashboard for sustainability initiatives on Cardano relying on the framework provided by the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) to quantify and compare the quantity of impact being created.*

title: MLabs – CEMScript SDK: get your DApp implementation from annotated on-chain logic state-machine
problem: Apps have common types and logic that must be compatible across tx building, on-chain scripts, and indexing. However, they are often re-implemented in each context because dev tools cannot reuse them.
solution: Define and reuse DApp logic via annotated CEM-machines, resulting in free implementations for on-chain scripts, tx building/ submission/resubmission on L1/L2, tx parsing/indexing, specs, and tests.

title: Academic Research on Catalyst economy - GDP estimation
problem: There is zero knowledge of how big the Catalyst economy is. There is no academic research that can explain how this economy interacts and a minimum understanding of where investment is distributed.
solution: An Academic Research focused on measuring the economy of Catalyst including agents receiving ADA and analyzing internal "GDP", consumption functions, expenses, and "import/export" in the economy.

title: Artboardz: Onboarding Artists And Merchants With NMKR
problem:
Cardano needs to attract new users by providing real-world products and solutions for NFTs.

![Artboardz](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/Artboardz-01-bce52e/jpg)
solution: Artboardz links NFTs to real-world art, provides discounts at real-world venues, and enables AR-guided tours. Artboardz will integrate NMKR Studio APIs, NFT minting, & secondary marketplace solutions.

title: Convert IPFS into Cardano：Amplifying Storage Potential with IPFS
problem: IPFS is a highly durable and reliable protocol to replace HTTP, but it is not widely used because it cannot be stored permanently and requires antivirus protection.
solution: IPFS has a high affinity with blockchain, so we believe that it can be created as a dedicated storage for Cardano using Cardano name value.

title: Atala PRISM Integration for Secure Ridesharing
problem: Improving identity verification in ridesharing platforms with a secure, privacy-preserving, Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) solution.
solution: We will develop an SSI module based on Cardano's Atala PRISM for secure, user-friendly identity verification in ridesharing platforms.

title: Cardano Marketplace Listing Contract
problem: Cardano NFT marketplaces all have their own separate listing smart contracts. Let's build one shared, open-sourced, royalty-honouring smart contract while still allowing for unique fee structures.
solution: I will be leading a team to develop an open-sourced listing contract in cooperation with all marketplace developer teams, still allowing for each marketplace to have unique fees and user fund staking.

title: DReps LATAM - Brasil - Exploration & Community Sensing

solution: Powerful widget inserted into keywords in news content of cryptocurrency websites, displaying real-time price & info about coin or token. All in modal with the relevant information about the currency.

title: Scalus – multiplatform Scala implementation of Cardano Plutus
problem: Cardano Dev is challenging. Haskell: hard to hire talent, bad Dev experience. Aiken: new language, no devs, no low-level control. Neither works on multiple platforms (JVM, LLVM, JS).
solution:
Scalus allows the development of DApps using Scala language.

Scala has a larger talent pool, good dev experience, large ecosystem/community, and is multi platform (JVM/JavaScript/LLVM), on/off-chain.

title: Cardano SPO Club for non-English speaker
problem: Lack of places for SPO to exchange information, exchange and learn from experience in pool operation, and community mobilization in languages other than English.
solution: Set up a Cardano SPO club for SPOs to exchange and learn from each other's experiences. Through this, SPOs grow evenly and create many initiatives that contribute to the development of Cardano.

problem: Intellectual product owners are looking for a free NFT marketplace to experience transactions before engaging with major platforms for profit. However, there are few such platforms.
solution: Building NFT Marketplace MVP that enables people to experience free service of Web3.0 based on Cardano network.

title: 1st Options trading platform on Cardano
problem:
![Image file](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-cd6958/png)

solution: Implement Cardano's 1st options smart contract, creating flexibility and accessibility by making the options Cardano native tokens. As such, they can be traded freely like any other token.
